jobs.description:
About Clarity RCM

Clarity RCM is the nation’s leading revenue cycle platform for dermatology, partnering with independent practices in over 40 states to improve financial performance, streamline operations, and deliver exceptional patient experiences. We are a profitable, fast-growing company with a fully remote U.S. team and a large in-office operation in India.

The Role

US-Based Candidates only. International applicants will not be considered.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Credentialing Specialist who will own provider enrollment, credentialing workflows, and payer setup for dermatology practices nationwide. This is a critical role that requires someone who can make sense of complex, disparate information and turn it into clear, repeatable processes.

The ideal candidate thrives in environments that need more structure. You enjoy bringing order to moving parts, synthesizing information from many sources, and building systems where none exist. You take pride in creating workflows, organizing information, documenting steps, and establishing processes that allow the credentialing function to scale.

You should be comfortable with complex requirements, persistent follow-up, and maintaining accurate, audit-ready documentation at all times. You are tech savvy, proactive, and committed to delivering clean, reliable work that enables providers to practice without interruption.

What You Will Do

Credentialing and Provider Onboarding

  • Own the full lifecycle of credentialing for physicians and advanced practice providers, including initial onboarding, primary source verification, re-credentialing, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Verify education, training, licenses, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and work history with complete accuracy.
  • Ensure all credentialing files meet NCQA, TJC, CMS, and payer-specific requirements.

Payer Enrollment and Maintenance

  • Prepare, submit, and track enrollment applications with commercial payers including BCBS, UHC, Aetna, and Cigna, as well as Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Manage CAQH ProView including quarterly attestations and document maintenance.
  • Process Medicare enrollments and updates through PECOS.
  • Verify that providers are correctly linked to group tax IDs to prevent out-of-network billing issues.
  • Track effective dates and panel statuses and communicate updates to internal stakeholders.

Process Building and Workflow Design

  • Create structure in areas that currently have few or inconsistent processes.
  • Organize credentialing inputs from multiple sources and turn them into clear workflows, trackers, and checklists.
  • Identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and implement improvements that enhance accuracy, speed, and consistency.
  • Document processes and maintain updated SOPs that support ongoing team alignment and scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal teams to keep credentialing and enrollment workflows moving.
  • Support account managers, operations, and revenue cycle teams by providing accurate status updates and resolving credentialing-related blockers.
  • Partner with billing and AR teams to investigate and resolve claim denials caused by credentialing or enrollment issues.

Data Management and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate provider data across CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, and internal systems.
  • Own a master tracker that includes effective dates, expirables, re-credentialing deadlines, panel statuses, and outstanding items.
  • Keep all credentialing records continuously audit-ready with complete and up-to-date documentation.

Licensing Support

  • Monitor expiring state licenses, DEA registrations, malpractice insurance, and board certifications.
  • Communicate proactively with providers to ensure renewals are completed well before expiration dates.

What You Will Bring

  • Experience: 2 to 3 years of hands-on medical credentialing or payer enrollment experience.
  • Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, and credentialing software. Strong understanding of NCQA, TJC, CMS, and standard credentialing requirements.
  • Structure Building: A track record of bringing order to complex or unstructured environments and building processes that scale.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to identify inconsistencies instantly and maintain clean, accurate files.
  • Follow-Through: Persistent and professional when gathering documentation or resolving gaps.
  • Communication: Clear, concise, and confident written and verbal communication skills.
  • Technology Mindset: Comfortable navigating multiple systems and adopting new tools.
  • Judgment: Ability to handle PHI and sensitive information with complete discretion.
  • Mindset: Process-driven, organized, proactive, resourceful, and committed to continuous improvement.

Additional Details

Location: Fully remote role based in the United States.

Compensation: Competitive salary with benefits, commensurate with experience.

Why Join Clarity RCM

At Clarity, you will join a mission-driven, founder-led organization transforming how independent dermatology practices operate. You will help build a credentialing function known for accuracy, speed, and reliability, and you will be part of a culture that values operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.excerpt: Defend the Work.  Shape What Comes Next. Ascendient has spent 30 years building a reputation as the nation’s premier Certificate of Need consulting firm.
jobs.description:
Defend the Work. Shape What Comes Next.

Ascendient has spent 30 years building a reputation as the nation’s premier Certificate of Need consulting firm. When a competitor contests an application and the case goes before an administrative law judge, the testimony that follows must be analytically airtight, strategically defensible, and delivered by someone who has been on that stand before.

We are hiring a Litigation Lead to own that challenge. This is a rare, high-impact specialist role for someone who has been formally qualified as an expert witness in administrative law hearings, withstood cross-examination, and wants to be the person our clients rely on when the stakes are highest.

About Ascendient

Ascendient partners with hospitals and healthcare organizations on high-stakes regulatory and strategic work, including:

  • Certificate of Need (CON) applications across multiple states
  • Contested case litigation and expert witness testimony in CON proceedings
  • Healthcare utilization forecasting and demand analysis
  • Service line planning and financial feasibility studies
  • Strategic planning for hospitals and health systems

Litigation is the highest-stakes, highest-value work the firm does. It demands deep subject matter expertise, composure under adversarial pressure, and the ability to defend a position — analytically and strategically — when opposing counsel comes hard.

The Role

You will lead CON litigation engagements as the firm’s expert witness, working directly with client attorneys to build case strategy, develop the evidence, and testify in contested case proceedings before administrative law judges. You are the firm’s litigation anchor who shapes how Ascendient competes in a hearing room and who helps build the practice for the long term.

You will:

  • Serve as Ascendient’s primary expert witness in contested CON hearings across multiple states, with particular depth in North Carolina
  • Develop and execute litigation strategy in direct partnership with client attorneys
  • Author expert reports and pre-filed written testimony that are analytically rigorous and fully defensible under cross-examination
  • Prepare hearing exhibits and supporting analytical work product tied to CON review criteria: need analysis, financial feasibility, utilization projections, and service area analysis
  • Attend and participate in all phases of hearings, including proceedings that may span multiple weeks
  • Prepare for and give deposition testimony as required
  • Mentor and develop the firm’s Opposition Lead, with the potential to serve as their direct supervisor as the practice scales
  • Help shape the firm’s litigation methodology, standards, and analytical capability over time

What You Bring

Required:

  • Formally qualified and accepted by an administrative law judge or hearing officer as an expert witness in CON, healthcare regulatory, or other administrative law hearings
  • Testified in a minimum of 3–5 administrative law hearings (7 or more preferred)
  • Direct experience with Certificate of Need processes, review criteria, and state health planning frameworks
  • Demonstrated ability to survive rigorous cross-examination and defend analytical methodology under adversarial pressure
  • Experience authoring expert reports or pre-filed written testimony for administrative proceedings
  • Hospital financial modeling and feasibility analysis experience
  • Deep understanding of hospital and health system operations, service line dynamics, and utilization data
  • Familiarity with healthcare data sources: CMS datasets, AHA data, state health planning databases, and similar

Preferred:

  • CON hearing experience in North Carolina (strongly preferred); multi-state experience a plus
  • Background in a healthcare consulting firm
  • Experience with CON opposition work — comments, responses, counter-arguments
  • Ability to be qualified as an expert in both need analysis and financial feasibility as distinct subject matter areas
  • Experience mentoring or developing staff on litigation-related analytical work

Who Thrives Here

You are:

  • Composed and steady under pressure while in a hearing room, in a deposition, and in the weeks of preparation that precede them
  • Analytically precise, with the ability to hold a complex position under sustained cross-examination
  • A strategic partner to attorneys who helps shape the case, not just your testimony
  • Someone who writes clearly and deliberately, knowing your expert report becomes part of the legal record
  • A developer of people who can transfer deep expertise without losing rigor
  • Direct, confident, and credible — in writing, in testimony, and in front of clients

Compensation and Structure

  • $155,000 – $196,000 base salary
  • Short-term incentive compensation: opportunity to earn an additional 15% of base salary annually
  • Remote (USA-based; must be available during Eastern core hours 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM ET)
  • Travel required for hearings, depositions, and client meetings
  • Full benefits including health, dental, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and paid time off
Salary: $155,000 - $196,000 per year

Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland

Ben jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Heb je al minimaal twee jaar vlieguren gemaakt binnen de SGGZ en wil je jouw expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving?

Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.

Wij zoeken proactieve basispsychologen die online behandelen serieus nemen. Professionals die digitaal vaardig zijn, stevig in hun rol staan en ook op afstand een sterke behandelrelatie kunnen opbouwen.

Over Beterggz

Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.

Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters en andere betrokken professionals. We werken digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief goede GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.

Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je zit. Of je nu vanuit Nederland werkt of vanuit het buitenland, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit op orde zijn.

Requirements

Wat ga je doen?

Als online basispsycholoog behandel je cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ. Je voert online behandelgesprekken, doet psychodiagnostiek, stelt samen met collega’s behandelplannen op en bewaakt de voortgang van de behandeling.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar niet geïsoleerd. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een digitaal multidisciplinair team waarin je afstemt met regiebehandelaren, psychiaters en collega-psychologen. Ook denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van onze zorg, kennisdeling en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.

De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.

Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.

Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.

Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Beterggz?

Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.

We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.

  • Erschließe neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten: Du beobachtest kommunale Entwicklungen und Ausbauprogramme, identifizierst neue Zielregionen und baust unser Netzwerk bei Veranstaltungen, Fachkongressen und relevanten Netzwerkformaten weiter aus.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in Beratung und Verhandlung: Du kannst erklärungsbedürftige Angebote verständlich vermitteln, Gespräche strukturiert führen und unterschiedliche Interessen in tragfähige Vereinbarungen überführen.
  • Interesse an technischen und infrastrukturellen Themen: Du kannst dich in neue Lösungen und Geschäftsmodelle einarbeiten und deren Nutzen adressatengerecht vermitteln. Erfahrung aus Telekommunikation, Mobilfunk, Glasfaser, Energie, Smart City oder Infrastruktur ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Homeoffice mit passender Ausstattung: Außerhalb deiner Vor-Ort-Termine arbeitest du mobil oder im Homeoffice. Dafür erhältst du die technische und digitale Ausstattung, die du für deine Arbeit unterwegs und zu Hause benötigst.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum im B2G-Vertrieb: Du erschließt neue Regionen, entwickelst kommunale Partnerschaften und gestaltest deine Vertriebsprozesse eigenverantwortlich.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und gezielte Weiterbildung: Du lernst unsere Standortkonzepte, Kooperationsmodelle und internen Abläufe Schritt für Schritt kennen. Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungen stimmen wir auf deine Aufgaben und deine weitere Entwicklung ab.

**Klingt nach deiner nächsten Aufgabe?

**Du bringst Erfahrung im Vertrieb und in der aktiven Akquise mit, erfüllst aber nicht jeden Punkt unseres Profils? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du Beziehungen aufbauen kannst, gerne auf neue Menschen zugehst und Lust hast, dich in unsere Themen einzuarbeiten.

jobs.title: Contract Writer - A Book For Those Who Want to Grow in Prayer
jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to develop a theologically grounded book on prayer.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop a theologically grounded book on prayer. This project should present a fresh, distinct approach—one that is rooted in Scripture, attentive to real-life challenges, and meaningfully different from existing books on prayer. Strong proposals will demonstrate a clear audience and articulate how this book meets a particular need with theological depth, practical clarity, and Christ-centered hope.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

TNS est une société de services professionnels qui renforce les capacités de ses clients au sein des marchés Africains, y compris ceux avec des défis importants. TNS fournit une gamme de services de finance, de conformité, de consultant et de conseil dans plusieurs secteurs et zones géographiques en Afrique subsaharienne.

L'opportunité :

Solon entreprend de bâtir un système de développement des joueurs de football à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest - en éliminant les barrières structurelles pour permettre aux talents émergents du continent de s'épanouir. Lancé au Ghana en avril 2024, nous poursuivons la mise en en œuvre de la première phase de ce projet : un programme gratuit de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires de chaque marché cible en Afrique de l'Ouest. La Sénégal est notre prochain marché cible.

Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Sénégal. Le rôle consistera à travailler avec une équipe soudée pour évaluer et développer les opportunités de mise en œuvre du programme. Vous rejoindrez une équipe collégiale, collaborative et curieuse.

Responsabilités :

Le candidat idéal adoptera une approche pratique pour gérer avec succès divers groupes de travail afin d'évaluer la Sénégal en tant que nouveau marché pour la mise en place de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. Il s'agira également d'être capable de répondre avec enthousiasme à un ensemble de demandes et de défis rapides et variés.

Quelques exemples de responsabilités :

  • Évaluation des opportunités. Identifier et évaluer les possibilités de partenariat avec les établissements scolaires en Sénégal afin de mettre en place la première phase de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football - un programme de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires existantes.
  • Mise en œuvre du programme. En coordination avec l'équipe de Solon, mettre en œuvre et développer le programme de formation de base au football avec les propriétaires et réseaux d'écoles primaires identifiés en Sénégal y compris l’éducation nationale ; assurer une supervision efficace pour veiller à ce que le programme réponde aux normes et aux objectifs de Solon.
  • Engagement des parties prenantes. Établir et entretenir des relations avec les principales parties prenantes, notamment les prestataires de services, les représentants du gouvernement, les partenaires donateurs, les consultants et les membres des communautés. Collaborez avec les potentiels partenaires locaux, les experts du secteur et d’autres parties prenantes pour recueillir des informations et promouvoir les intérêts de Solon.
  • Rapports et évaluation. Préparer des rapports détaillés et des présentations pour l’équipe d’encadrement de Solon afin de faciliter les processus de prise de décision.
  • Gestion de projets. Gérer les délais, les ressources et les délivrables pour les projets désignés. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités du projet respectent les normes et les objectifs de Solon, en produisant des résultats dans les délais et le respect des budgets établis.

Qualifications :

Les qualifications de base pour cette mission sont les suivantes

  • Diplôme bac +4 en administration des affaires ; Sciences économiques ; Relations internationales ; école de commerce ou domaines connexes.
  • Expérience avérée en développement commercial ou dans un rôle similaire, de préférence en Sénégal ou sur des marchés similaires.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, y compris la préparation de rapports de projet détaillés et la présentation à un public diversifié.
  • Superbe attention aux détails et application au travail
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe multiculturelle et en rapide évolution.
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la culture, des coutumes et des pratiques commerciales de la Sénégal.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit).
  • Intégrité, bonne capacité de jugement et sens des affaires.
  • Bonne présence et comportement professionnel.
  • Capacité à résider et travailler légalement en Sénégal.
  • Passion ou intérêt pour le football

Une expérience et/ou des connaissances dans les domaines du football, de l'éducation, ainsi que des initiatives de développement de projets dans ces domaines sont souhaitables.

Nature de l'engagement : un engagement contractuel de 6 mois dont la durée peut être prolongée et évoluer plus tard vers un rôle à temps plein au sein de la société.

Horaires de travail : Prendre en compte des possibilités de devoir assister en virtuel à des réunions à des heures de bureau standard de plusieurs fuseaux horaires, en particulier l’Amérique du Nord et le Pakistan.

Lieu de travail : Ce rôle exige que le candidat réside en Sénégal. Il s’agit d’un rôle à distance dans la mesure où la plupart des supérieurs hiérarchiques et collaborateurs seront basés hors de Sénégal. Des déplacements dans toute l'Afrique de l'Ouest peuvent être nécessaires, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels dans le monde entier.

Rémunération : Solon est une organisation de choix qui propose des rémunérations compétitives ainsi que des bonus basés sur les performances et l’atteinte des objectifs.

jobs.description:
Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey — we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.

About the Role

Releaf is looking for an experienced Head of App Development to lead the strategy, architecture and delivery of our native iOS and Android applications. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has built and scaled consumer-facing health or wellness apps, and who understands how to turn complex clinical and patient data into simple, trustworthy mobile experiences.

You will own our app roadmap end to end from technical architecture through to App Store and Google Play release. A core part of this role is our use of health and wearable data: you will need deep, practical experience working with Apple HealthKit, the Apple Health app, and Apple Watch data, alongside equivalent experience on Android with Health Connect and Wear OS.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the mobile experience for a fast-growing healthcare business, working at the intersection of clinical care, patient engagement and consumer-grade product design.

You'll work with a designer to create the UI/UX and then develop it with the developers to connect it to the backend of our bespoke system.Using API. We have a team of over 20 developers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Owning the technical strategy, development and roadmap for Releaf's native iOS and Android applications
  • Leading the design and implementation of features built on Apple HealthKit and the Apple Health app, including reading, writing and visualising health data
  • Integrating Apple Watch data — including activity, heart rate, sleep and other relevant metrics — into patient-facing features in a clear, intuitive UI
  • Building equivalent health data experiences on Android using Health Connect and Wear OS, ensuring feature parity across platforms
  • Working closely with Product, Design, Clinical and Data Protection teams to ensure features are clinically sound, intuitive, and fully compliant with healthcare data regulations
  • Owning app performance, stability, release management and the end-to-end App Store / Google Play submission process
  • Establishing engineering best practice across testing, CI/CD, code review and security for mobile
  • Staying ahead of platform changes from Apple and Google — particularly around HealthKit, Health Connect, privacy frameworks and wearable APIs — and advising the business on their implications
  • Contributing to the wider technology strategy as a senior member of the engineering leadership team

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven experience leading native app development for both iOS and Android, ideally including time as a senior or lead engineer before moving into management
  • Hands-on experience building features using Apple HealthKit and integrating with the Apple Health app
  • Direct experience working with Apple Watch/health data (healthkit) — reading and presenting metrics such as heart rate, activity rings, sleep or workout data within a consumer app
  • Working knowledge of the Android equivalent stack — Health Connect and Wear OS — and experience building comparable cross-platform health features
  • Portfolio of apps that we can test the UI and functionality.
  • Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX principles, particularly around presenting health data in a way that is clear, reassuring and easy to act on
  • Experience managing the full app lifecycle, including App Store and Google Play submission, review processes, and ongoing release management
  • A track record of building, leading and growing high-performing engineering teams
  • Comfortable working in a regulated environment, with an understanding of data protection and patient privacy considerations (UK GDPR, or equivalent)
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders

Desirable

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or a regulated consumer product environment
  • Familiarity with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose at a technical depth sufficient to review architecture and code where needed
  • Experience with remote patient monitoring, chronic condition management apps, or similar health-tracking products
  • Exposure to clinical safety standards or medical device software regulations (e.g. UKCA/MHRA, IEC 62304) is a strong plus, though not required
  • Experience working alongside clinical teams to validate the safety and accuracy of health-related features

We’re looking for someone who is excited to join a busy growing organisation - our team culture is based on support and respect and we take a proactive approach to employee progression and development. The ideal candidate for this role will be happy to roll their sleeves up and can take ownership of this role. In return, we offer flexible working; personalised training and development; private health insurance, Employee Assistance Programmes; access to employee perks and Releaf staff patient benefits.

Our application process starts off with an informal remote meeting followed by a written test. We are an inclusive employer and would welcome applications from a diverse range of applicants; if there is anything we can do to help support you during the interview process, please let us know.

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Description

*Candidates must reside in MA, IL, NY/NJ, NC, or FL

﻿Position Summary

The National Manager, A&D & Commercial Sales is responsible for driving specification activity, commercial project development, revenue growth, and market share across the company's Architectural & Design (A&D) and Commercial Sales channels.

This leadership role oversees a team of A&D and Commercial channel managers and is responsible for coaching, performance management, pipeline development, forecasting, and execution of strategic sales initiatives. The position works closely with the National Accounts Manager and National Accounts Sales Team to support national account growth and maximize project opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on sales leader with experience in specification-driven selling and commercial project development. This individual must be skilled at building relationships with architects, designers, developers, builders, general contractors, and other key decision-makers while developing and leading a high-performing sales team.

Experience within the quartz, porcelain, stone, tile, surfacing, architectural products, or broader building materials industry is strongly preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Business Development

  • Develop and execute strategies to increase specification activity, commercial project opportunities, and revenue growth.
  • Drive sales performance and market penetration across assigned territories and target market segments.
  • Build and maintain relationships with architects, designers, developers, builders, general contractors, and key commercial decision-makers.
  • Identify new business opportunities, emerging market trends, and competitive threats.
  • Drive specification adoption and project opportunities for the company's quartz and porcelain surfacing products.
  • Collaborate with the National Accounts Manager and National Accounts Sales Team to identify and maximize national account opportunities.
  • Support major project pursuits and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment of sales activities with company objectives and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) goals.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of A&D and Commercial Sales Representatives.
  • Conduct regular field travel and joint sales calls to support account development, project advancement, and territory growth.
  • Monitor individual and team performance against established goals.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and support employee development plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  • Recruit, onboard, and retain top-performing sales talent.

Project & Pipeline Management

  • Support project tracking, specification conversion, and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.
  • Partner with representatives to advance projects from specification through project completion.
  • Maintain visibility into project pipelines and key growth opportunities.
  • Drive forecasting accuracy and ensure healthy pipeline development across all territories.
  • Utilize CRM tools to track activity, opportunities, specifications, and project progress.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead forecasting, pipeline reviews, and sales planning activities.
  • Ensure CRM compliance, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Support annual budgeting, territory planning, and resource allocation efforts.
  • Coordinate with Marketing, Operations, Customer Service, Product Management, and Credit teams to ensure customer success and operational effectiveness.
  • Maintain proper stewardship and utilization of company assets and resources.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Product Management, and Operations to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Provide competitive intelligence, market insights, and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, professional organizations, and networking opportunities.
  • Maintain strong communication and alignment with senior leadership.
  • Share best practices and support collaboration across the broader sales organization.

Salary Range

The anticipated total compensation range for this position is between $145,000 and $182,000, which includes a base salary and an incentive bonus opportunity. Base compensation within this range is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.

Location: Remote – Candidates must reside in MA, IL, NY/NJ, NC, or FL and live within reasonable commuting distance of a major airport. Frequent national travel required (50–70%).

Travel: 50–70% Nationwide

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of successful sales experience within commercial building products, surfacing materials, architectural products, stone, tile, flooring, cabinetry, or related industries. Stone Industry experience preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of sales leadership experience managing field-based sales representatives.
  • Proven success in A&D, specification, commercial, or project-driven sales environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and motivate high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of commercial construction, specification selling, project management, and business development.
  • Experience building relationships with architects, designers, developers, builders, general contractors, and ownership groups.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue, specification, and profitability objectives.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM proficiency.
  • Ability to travel extensively throughout the United States.
  • Must reside on the East Coast within reasonable commuting distance of a major airport.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Construction Management, or a related field preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quartz, porcelain, natural stone, tile, surfacing materials, or other specification-driven building products.
  • Experience working with national account programs and large commercial project opportunities.
  • Knowledge of the A&D community, commercial construction process, and project specification lifecycle.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed sales teams.

OUR COMPANY VALUES

People First

We treat one another with fairness and respect, prioritize health and safety, and consistently create opportunities for personal and professional growth.

Accountability

We take collective ownership of our actions, our business, and our future.

Innovation

We embrace fresh thinking and pursue breakthrough ideas that drive value and progress.

Winning Spirit

We approach our work with enthusiasm and a can-do attitude, striving for excellence and celebrating success together as a team.

Why Join Us

Join an industry leader in premium quartz and porcelain surfacing products and play a key role in shaping the future of our A&D and Commercial Sales organization. This is an opportunity to lead a talented team, influence high-profile commercial projects, and drive strategic growth across a rapidly expanding national business.

jobs.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Oregon to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:

jobs.excerpt: Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Artiste technique pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme !
jobs.description:
Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Artiste technique pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme !

Rempli de quêtes, d'exploration et d'activités captivantes avec des personnages emblématiques de Disney et Pixar, Disney Dreamlight Valley est une production originale de Gameloft Montréal créée par une équipe passionnée impatiente de vous accueillir !

Pour en savoir plus sur le jeu :
Bande-annonce :
officiel :

Sous la supervision du Chef technique, et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de programmation et artistique, l'Artiste technique conçoit des outils et développe un pipeline de production graphique optimal pour soutenir le processus de création de son équipe pour le contenu actuel et à venir. Il ou elle veille à répondre à toutes les attentes artistiques et de design, dans le respect des contraintes de performance et des délais de production.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Pipeline et outils

  • Superviser et tenir à jour le pipeline des ressources artistiques, et détecter les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent une version.
  • Développer et tenir à jour des outils de création numérique qui appliquent les conventions de nomenclature, les budgets de triangles, les dispositions UV, etc.
  • Créer et maintenir les paramètres d'importation côté moteur (modèles, compression des textures, etc.).

Performance et optimisation

  • Établir des budgets par asset (nombre de triangles, densité de texels, nombre de matériaux, etc.) par scène ou par classe d'assets, et vérifier les nouvelles soumissions d'assets par rapport à ces budgets avant que les dépassements ne s'accumulent dans tout le projet.
  • Profiler les versions sur le matériel cible et traduire les résultats en étapes exploitables.
  • Optimiser des assets spécifiques en cas de besoin.

Shaders et matériaux

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les programmeurs graphiques pour créer et tenir à jour la bibliothèque de shaders du projet en utilisant à la fois le Shader Graph et le HLSL.
  • Collaborer avec le Directeur artistique pour prototyper de nouveaux effets visuels et travailler avec l'équipe artistique pour les intégrer au projet.
  • Examiner et corriger les bugs de matériaux/shaders (artefacts de profondeur et de tri, artefacts de mosaïquage, réponse PBR incorrecte, etc.).
  • Valider les configurations de matériaux dans différentes conditions d'éclairage et sur les plateformes cibles.

Normes de l'équipe artistique

  • Rédiger et mettre à jour les sections techniques du guide artistique (conventions de nomenclature, spécifications d'exportation, formats de textures, structure des dossiers, considérations d'optimisation, etc.), qui sont cruciales pour les artistes internes et les partenaires en sous-traitance.
  • Former les nouveaux artistes aux outils de pipeline et appliquer les normes.
  • Assumer le triage initial de tous les problèmes d'intégration des ressources.
  • Définir et spécifier les demandes et caractéristiques du nouveau pipeline artistique.
  • Évaluer et recommander de nouveaux outils, plugins et mises à niveau du pipeline.

---

Gameloft Montreal is looking for a Technical Artist to join the team working on Disney Dreamlight Valley, a cross-platform hybrid life-sim/adventure game!

Filled with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring iconic Disney and Pixar characters, Disney Dreamlight Valley is an original Gameloft Montreal production created by a passionate team eager to welcome you!

To learn more about the game:
Trailer:
website:

Under the supervision of the technical lead, and working closely with the programming and art teams, the technical artist designs tools and develops an optimal graphics production pipeline to support their team's creation process for existing and upcoming content. They make sure to meet any artistic/design expectations, in keeping with performance constraints and production deadlines.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Pipeline & Tooling

  • Monitor and maintain the art asset pipeline, and catch issues before they reach a build.
  • Write and maintain DCC tools that enforce naming conventions, triangle budgets, UV layouts, etc.
  • Author and maintain engine-side import settings (models, texture compression, etc.).

Performance & Optimization

  • Establish per-asset budgets (triangle count, texel density, material count, etc.) per scene or asset class, and audit new asset submissions against them before violations compound across the project.
  • Profile builds on target hardware and translate the findings into actionable steps.
  • Optimize specific assets when needed.

Shaders & Materials

  • Work closely with the Graphics Programmers to author and maintain the project shader library using both Shader Graph and HLSL.
  • Collaborate with the Art Director to prototype new visual effects and work with the art team to integrate them in the project.
  • Investigate and fix material/shader bugs (depth and sorting artifacts, tiling artifacts, incorrect PBR response, etc.).
  • Validate material setups across lighting conditions and target platforms.

Art Team Standards

  • Write and maintain the Art Bible's technical sections (naming conventions, export specs, texture formats, folder structure, optimization considerations, etc.), which are critical for internal artists and outsourcing partners.
  • Onboard new artists to pipeline tools and enforce standards.
  • Own first-response triage for all art-to-engine issues.
  • Scope and spec new art pipeline requests and features.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools, plugins, and pipeline upgrades.
  • Expérience de contribution à un pipeline artistique sur un projet livré
  • Expérience de publication sur au moins une plateforme console (Nintendo Switch™, PS5® ou Xbox Series) et expérience pratique avec les contraintes spécifiques à la mémoire et aux shaders de la plateforme
  • Compétence avec Git et SVN, et à l'aise avec les flux de travail basés sur les demandes de fusion

Moteur et pipeline

  • Solide compétence avec Unity (URP), avec une expérience pratique dans plusieurs de ses systèmes (rendu, pipeline d'assets, profilage, débogage)
  • Compétence en C# pour les outils d'éditeur (inspecteurs personnalisés, validateurs, traitements en lots)
  • Expérience en rédaction ou maintenance d'outils de validation d'assets
  • À l'aise avec le travail sur les préréglages d'importation et les substitutions de plateforme (compression des textures, compression des maillages)

Outils de création numérique

  • Expérience de l'écriture de scripts dans au moins un des langages suivants : 3ds Max, Blender ou Maya (exportateurs, outils par lots, validation, nettoyage de scènes)
  • Familiarité avec les flux de travail de Substance 3D Painter/Designer

Shaders et matériaux

  • Solide expérience en HLSL dans URP, y compris les shaders personnalisés illuminés/non illuminés et les mots-clés de shader
  • À l'aise avec Shader Graph et comprend quand l'écriture manuelle en HLSL est une meilleure option
  • Bonne compréhension de la PBR, des espaces colorimétriques et du comportement de l'éclairage sur les différentes plateformes
  • Expérience de débogage des problèmes de shaders sur diverses plateformes

Performance et profilage

  • Expérience pratique avec les outils de profilage et de débogage GPU tels que Unity Frame Debugger et Nsight, et capable de lire une capture d'image fixe pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement GPU courants (appels de dessin, taux de remplissage, coûts des shaders)
  • Expérience de travail avec des budgets par asset et par scène (triangles, densité des texels, nombre de matériaux, surdessin, mémoire) et pour les faire respecter

Normes et communication

  • Expérience dans la rédaction et la mise à jour de la documentation technique liée à l'art (sections du guide artistique, guides des pipelines)
  • À l'aise pour guider les artistes sur les meilleures pratiques techniques et examiner leur travail quant à la conformité au pipeline
  • À l'aise en tant que premier point de contact pour les artistes rencontrant des problèmes avec le moteur
  • Capable de définir la portée d'une demande de fonctionnalité pour un pipeline, rédiger une spécification succincte, l'évaluer et la livrer

Atouts

  • Expérience dans le soutien des pipelines d'installation et d'animation (résolution de problèmes et révision de contenu)
  • Expérience dans le soutien des effets visuels (résolution de problèmes, optimisation et révision de contenu)
  • Familiarité avec Houdini (pipelines procéduraux, HDA) ou autres outils de contenu procédural
  • Expérience avec les shaders de calcul (systèmes d'herbe/particules, instanciation GPU, dessin indirect, etc.)
  • Expérience avec les pipelines d'éclairage (sondes lumineuses, flux de travail de cuisson, outils d'auteur de sondes)
  • Familiarité avec Jira/Confluence pour la gestion des problèmes et le pipeline de documentation
  • Expérience précédente en tant qu'artiste avant de passer à l'art technique

---

  • Experience contributing to an art pipeline on a shipped project
  • Experience shipping on at least one console platform (Nintendo Switch™, PS5® or Xbox Series) and hands-on experience with platform-specific memory and shader constraints
  • Proficient with Git and SVN, and comfortable with merge-request-based workflows

Engine & Pipeline

  • Strong Unity proficiency (URP), with hands-on experience in several of its systems (rendering, asset pipeline, profiling, debugging)
  • Proficient in C# for editor tooling (custom inspectors, validators, batch processors)
  • Experience writing or maintaining asset validation tools
  • Comfortable working with import presets and platform overrides (texture compression, mesh compression)

DCC Tools

  • Experience writing scripts in at least one of the following: 3ds Max, Blender, or Maya (exporters, batch tools, validation, scene cleanup)
  • Familiarity with Substance 3D Painter/Designer workflows

Shaders & Materials

  • Solid HLSL experience in URP, including custom lit/unlit shaders and shader keywords
  • Comfortable in Shader Graph and understands when handwritten HLSL is a better option
  • Good understanding of PBR, color spaces, and how lighting behaves across platforms
  • Experience debugging shader issues across platforms

Performance & Profiling

  • Hands-on experience with GPU profiling and debugging tools such as Unity Frame Debugger and Nsight, and able to read a frame capture to identify common GPU bottlenecks (draw calls, fillrate, shader costs)
  • Experience working with per-asset and per-scene budgets (triangles, texel density, material count, overdraw, memory) and helping enforce them

Standards & Communication

  • Experience writing and maintaining technical art documentation (Art Bible sections, pipeline guides)
  • Comfortable guiding artists on technical best practices and reviewing their work for pipeline compliance
  • Comfortable as the first point of contact for artists who have encountered engine issues
  • Able to scope a pipeline feature request, write a short spec, estimate, and ship it

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting rigging and animation pipelines (troubleshooting issues and content review)
  • Experience supporting VFX (troubleshooting, optimization and content review)
  • Familiarity with Houdini (procedural pipelines, HDAs) or other procedural content tools
  • Compute shader experience (grass/particle systems, GPU instancing, indirect draw, etc.)
  • Experience with lighting pipelines (light probes, baking workflows, probe authoring tools)
  • Familiarity with Jira/Confluence for issue triage and pipeline documentation
  • Previous experience as an artist before moving into tech art

Ce en quoi Gameloft croit :

Nous jouons le jeu pour un monde meilleur. En tant que leader dans l'industrie, nous voulons utiliser le pouvoir des jeux vidéos comme une force positive au changement.

Nous voulons que les Gamelofteurs se concentrent sur l'essentiel: créer du fun et des jeux de haute qualité dont ils pourront être fiers de les partager avec les joueurs du monde entier.

***

What Gameloft believes in:

We play the good game for a better world. As a leader in the industry, we want to use the power of video games as a force for positive change.
If you join us, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to help the environment, make a difference in communities and build a more inclusive world.

We want our Gamelofters to focus on what matters: creating fun and high-quality games they’ll be proud to share with our players around the world.

Chez Gameloft nous créons des moments de joie pour nos joueurs autour du monde à travers des expériences de jeux excitantes. C'est notre mission, et cela l'a été depuis plus de 25 ans.

Nous sommes les fiers créateurs d'Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat et plus de 200 autres super jeux.

Il y a un jeu pour tous, et nous nous élargissons maintenant avec des jeux multi-plateforme sur PC et consoles, avec des jeux tels Disney Speedstorm et Disney Dreamlight Valley, pour offrir à nos joueurs de nouvelles aventures incroyables.

Avec près de 3,000 Gamelofteurs passionnés à travers le monde, nous sommes très fiers de nos différences et nous nous appuyons sur celles-ci pour créer des jeux aussi divers que nous le sommes.

Si vous cherchez un nouveau challenge, et à travailler avec une équipe passionnée et talentueuse, n'hésitez pas à rejoindre le jeu!

jobs.description:
Expert Associations, Education & Social Dialogue

As an expert in the Associations, Education & Social Dialogue programme, you bring proven experience with strengthening institutions, labour market systems and skills development. You understand that sustainable economic growth depends not only on strong entrepreneurs, but also on effective institutions that connect employers, employees, educators and policymakers.  Are you ready to drive change within the Associations, Education & Social Dialogue programme worldwide and make a real impact? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique NGO committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

Who are you?

  • You have a track record of relevant experience with associations, education & social dialogue, preferably with an expertise in

    • Employers and business support organisations (EBSO) and/ or social dialogue for employers and business support organisations.

    • E-learning and AI educations; Incubators and education; Education and didactics (train the trainer); Educational development; Entrepreneurial education; Educational leadership.

  • You are an authentic, resilient, humble and dynamic professional.

  • You appreciate cultural differences and interact with equality and respect.

  • You are eager to operate as a sparring partner in culturally diverse and changing circumstances.

  • You are hands-on and can translate knowledge into a practical plan.

  • You have excellent command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Bonus points for French or Spanish proficiency!

  • You are comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft Office 365.

  • Discover more about the Associations, Education & Social Dialogueprogramme here.

Ready to make a difference?

As an expert at PUM, you play a key role. By sharing your knowledge and experience you’re empowering the sustainable growth of SMEs in countries worldwide. You’re not just an expert - you’re a change maker!

The role

Your application is for a place in our pool of experts for the Associations, Education & Social Dialogue programme, not for a specific project. Once you've joined, you will be matched with up to three projects per year, either on location or remotely. Around one in three projects will be delivered as remote advice, though working solely on remote advisory projects is also possible.
On location, you’ll spend two weeks on-site with the client. PUM covers your flight and visa, while the client takes care of your accommodation, meals, and local transportation. You will also receive an expense allowance.
As PUM expert you not only share knowledge, you also:

  • Empower entrepreneurs, supporting their journey toward sustainable and inclusive business development.

  • Leave a lasting impact on the community: socially, environmentally, and economically.

  • Turn your knowledge into a hands-on project plan.

  • Expand your horizons at sector days and building a network that’s as diverse as it gets.

Eligibility and Requirements

The expert role is a voluntary position. You can apply up to and including the calendar year in which you turn 69.PUM engages experts who reside in the Netherlands, are registered in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP), and have Dutch basic health insurance. Prescreening (VOG) is part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual to foster an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Join us!

By becoming a PUM expert, you’re not just stepping into a new role; you’re becoming a catalyst for positive change. It’s a two-way street of knowledge exchange that makes a global impact. Here’s what’s in it for you:

Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.
Professional network: Be part of a network of approximately 1,200 volunteer experts and let your network abroad grow as well.
Optimal knowledge utilization: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.
International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.
Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfillment.
Stunning office moments: Enjoy regular meetups at our beautiful office in The Hague with breathtaking views.

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may close the vacancy once we’ve found enough qualified candidates.

Highlights

You’ve got the skills! Why not share them? Join PUM as an expert to help build a better future for SMEs and their communities worldwide!

jobs.description:
About DataCore Software

DataCore is a global leader in software-defined storage and data infrastructure, serving more than 10,000 customers worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners and supported by a global team of 400+ employees, DataCore is entering a high-growth phase with a clear mandate to surpass $100M ARR.

We are seeking an exceptional Director - Product Management to lead the strategic vision and execution of our enterprise file system product portfolio. This leader will own the entire product strategy—from market positioning and roadmap direction to P&L accountability—for cutting-edge storage technologies serving Fortune 500 enterprises, mid-market innovators, and transforming SMBs globally.

Reporting to the Sr. Director - Product Management, this leader is responsible for defining and driving market positioning, roadmap execution, competitive differentiation, and revenue targets across all deployment models (on-premises, edge, cloud) while leading a world-class product team.

The Opportunity

This is your opportunity to shape the product strategy for one of the most critical infrastructure domains in the technology industry. You’ll own the entire product vision for our enterprise file system portfolio—from market positioning and competitive strategy to roadmap execution and P&L accountability.

This role combines strategic product leadership, technical depth, and business acumen.

You will:

  • Build repeatable, disciplined product discovery and validation processes that ground strategy in customer needs
  • Drive market positioning and go-to-market execution that establishes DataCore as the category leader in enterprise file systems
  • Own P&L accountability for the file system product line—managing revenue targets, portfolio investment, and strategic priorities
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing product management organization aligned around clear customer and business outcomes

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are seeking a visionary product leader who combines deep technical expertise, demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally, and proven success driving enterprise infrastructure products to market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Product Leadership & Vision

  • Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for the enterprise file system portfolio, driving revenue growth and market leadership
  • Establish market positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies that resonate with C-suite and technical stakeholders
  • Conduct rigorous competitive and market analysis to identify white-space opportunities and emerging customer needs
  • Partner with Sales and CMO to develop segment-specific go-to-market strategies
  • Drive innovation roadmaps that balance near-term revenue impact with long-term strategic advantage

2. Product Portfolio & P&L Management

  • Own end-to-end P&L accountability for the file system product line, including revenue targets and investment decisions
  • Manage the product portfolio lifecycle—from ideation and launch through growth and optimization to end-of-life
  • Develop compelling business cases for new initiatives with clear metrics for success
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and performance metrics to executive leadership and board stakeholders
  • Lead cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Sales, CMO, and Finance to align on business priorities

3. Technical Product Strategy & Architecture

  • Drive technical product strategy with deep knowledge of file system architecture, distributed storage systems, and HPC requirements
  • Partner with VP of Engineering to define technical requirements, establish performance benchmarks, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
  • Lead data orchestration and migration capabilities development to enable seamless data movement across heterogeneous environments
  • Establish product roadmap for optimizing performance, scalability, availability, and security across Linux, virtualized, and cloud-native deployments
  • Build and mentor a high-performing product management team, establishing a culture of customer-centricity and operational excellence
  • Define product management standards, processes, and best practices across discovery, validation, and launch execution

4. Customer Engagement & Market Insight

  • Develop deep customer insight through direct engagement with key accounts, advisory boards, and user communities
  • Drive customer-centric initiatives including:
    • Voice of Customer (VoC) programs that identify evolving needs and drive retention
    • Win-loss analysis and competitive positioning
    • Thought leadership and industry engagement on enterprise storage trends
    • Advisory board management and customer success partnerships
    • Segment-specific positioning and engagement strategies
  • Establish measurable success metrics tied to customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion revenue
  • Continuously improve product strategy and execution based on customer feedback and market dynamics

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a director-level or equivalent leadership role
  • Deep technical expertise in file system architecture, distributed storage systems, and high-performance computing
  • Proven track record of developing and launching enterprise infrastructure products across multiple deployment models (on-premises, edge, cloud)
  • P&L management experience with ownership of revenue targets, budgeting, and resource allocation
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills; experience using data and customer insights to drive critical product decisions

Differentiating Capabilities

The ideal candidate will also demonstrate:

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills; comfort presenting to C-suite, boards, and large customer audiences
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority; strong leadership, negotiation, and collaboration skills
  • Experience with HPC workloads, scientific computing, or AL/ML infrastructure products
  • Familiarity with software-defined storage (SDS), cloud-native storage, Kubernetes, or containerized environments
  • Experience with IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS), Isilon, Lustre, or other enterprise file systems
  • Background in marketing or sales; understanding of enterprise sales cycles and buyer personas

Ready to Lead?

If you're a visionary product leader with the technical depth, business acumen, and leadership experience to drive transformational growth in enterprise storage, we want to talk. Apply now to join our team and shape the future of data infrastructure.

At Alcoa, you are an essential part of our purpose: turning raw potential into real progress. This is an opportunity to bring your extensive cybersecurity experience to a global team and help shape a more secure and resilient future for the technologies and operations that support our business. You have the power to shape things to make them better.


About the Role:


As a Cybersecurity Advisor, (Specialist) you will provide tactical and operational cybersecurity guidance across Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) environments. Working as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert within the global Cybersecurity team, you will influence secure technology solutions, assess and help remediate cyber risk, strengthen governance practices, and support compliance obligations. Based remotely in Brazil and reporting within the Americas structure, you will collaborate with technical, operational, engineering, and business stakeholders across regions, including occasional meetings outside standard local business hours.


Other Responsibilities Include:


  • Provide cybersecurity guidance and assurance for system implementations, upgrades, digital transformation initiatives, and secure-by-design decisions across IT and OT environments.
  • Review and influence security architecture across cloud, applications, industrial control systems, SCADA, IoT, industrial networks, Zero Trust, Identity and Access Management, data protection, and AI governance.
  • Conduct threat modeling, security design reviews, and risk assessments for projects, vendors, business systems, and operational technologies, recommending practical mitigation and remediation actions.
  • Support cyber risk management and incident readiness, including mitigation planning, incident response preparation, post-incident reviews, audits, compliance evidence, and continuous improvement.
  • Advise on security policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks, aligning recommendations with customer needs and recognized practices such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, and IEC 62443.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and collaborative working environment by identifying and communicating risks, supporting speak-up and stop-work decisions when conditions or controls are unclear, and following through on agreed actions.

What You Can Bring to the Role:


  • A bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, STEM, or a related field, or a degree supported by equivalent depth of cybersecurity experience.
  • Significant cybersecurity or information security experience across both IT and OT environments, gained in any industry; industrial, manufacturing, or highly regulated environments are advantageous.
  • Demonstrated capability across at least two relevant domains, such as cloud security, Identity and Access Management or Zero Trust, data protection or DLP, and AI governance, supported by knowledge of NIST, CIS, ISO, or comparable standards.
  • Proven ability to advise internal customers, translate technical cyber risk into business risk, support incident response and risk-based decisions, and influence secure outcomes in complex or decentralized organizations.
  • Strong English communication skills for collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a global team, with flexibility for occasional meetings across time zones and regional travel when required.
  • A strong personal commitment to safe and ethical work, including risk awareness, clear communication of concerns, respect for confidentiality, and the judgment to pause or escalate work when controls or conditions are uncertain; certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC are advantageous.

What’s on Offer:


  • Our Values and Culture: we are driven by strong values. We act with integrity, operate with excellence, care for people, and lead with courage.
  • Safety First: safety is not only a priority, it is part of our DNA. Every activity begins and ends with a commitment to protecting what matters.
  • Community Connection: we believe in the power of collaboration and giving back to society. For this reason, we provide four paid volunteer hours each year.
  • Professional Growth: we provide space for you to develop, explore new possibilities, and turn your passions into a career.
  • Benefits That Value You: we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages designed to recognize your talent and wellbeing.
  • A Place Where You Want to Be: continuously recognized as one of the best companies to work for, we provide a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment.

Additional Information


  • You will only be contacted if you are selected for an interview; this process may take up to four weeks from the closing date of the posting.
  • When applying, please remember to attach your résumé.

About the Location

Recognized as an industry pioneer, Alcoa has established itself as an international company with operations across six continents. In Brazil, Alcoa has three production units, in Poços de Caldas (MG), São Luís (MA) and Juruti (PA), offices in São Paulo (SP), Poços de Caldas (MG) and Brasília (DF). Many of our employees are from the communities where we work, forming a team committed to the company values through and safety at work. Wherever you choose to join us, you'll be joining a global team committed to advancing sustainability and delivering excellence and innovation.

We are values led, vision driven and united by our purpose of transforming raw potential into real progress.  Our commitments to Inclusion, Diversity & Equity include providing trusting workplaces that are safe, respectful and inclusive of all individuals, free from discrimination, bullying and harassment and that our workplaces reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate.   

This is a place where you are empowered to do your best work, be your authentic self, and feel a true sense of belonging. Come join us and shape your career! 

Your work. Your world. Shape them for the better.
