jobs.excerpt: 📌 Role Snapshot• Position: Remote Trial Class Manager (Independent Contractor) — Arabic-speaking market • What you’ll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, assess the child’s needs, recommend the most suitable Kodland program, and support the family through the enrollment decision • Typical schedule:25+ hours/week on average, mostly during after-school / evening hours on weekdays, plus daytime weekend slots • Compensation: Fixed pay per completed trial lesson + performance-based bonuses (clear and structured bonus logic) • Training & support: A structured onboarding process with live training, guided practice, and a short assessment before you work with real families If this structure matches your expectations and availability, please review the details below.
jobs.description:
📌 Role Snapshot

  • Position: Remote Trial Class Manager (Independent Contractor) — Arabic-speaking market

  • What you’ll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, assess the child’s needs, recommend the most suitable Kodland program, and support the family through the enrollment decision

  • Typical schedule:25+ hours/week on average, mostly during after-school / evening hours on weekdays, plus daytime weekend slots

  • Compensation: Fixed pay per completed trial lesson + performance-based bonuses (clear and structured bonus logic)

  • Training & support: A structured onboarding process with live training, guided practice, and a short assessment before you work with real families

If this structure matches your expectations and availability, please review the details below.

1. About Kodland 👨‍💻👩‍💻

Kodland is an international online school that helps children develop practical digital skills and learn how to use technology creatively and responsibly.

  • We teach children aged 8–17, offering programs in Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Digital Creativity, and other modern digital disciplines.

  • Kodland operates globally, working with students and families across Europe, the UK, the USA, CIS, Latin America, MENA, and other regions.

  • All classes are delivered live via Zoom, in 1:1 or small-group formats, with a strong focus on project-based learning.

  • Our mission is to help children grow into confident, logical thinkers with strong technological literacy and problem-solving skills.

🔗 Learn more about Kodland: Kodland — International Online Coding & Design School for Kids (5-17)

2. A Day of a TCM

In this short video, you’ll see:

  • what a typical working day looks like for a Trial Class Manager,

  • when and how TCMs usually work during the week and weekends,

  • how a real trial lesson flows, from the first minutes to the final conversation with the parent.

👉 Please watch this before applying — it will help you decide if this role fits your lifestyle.

3. What Does a Trial Class Manager (TCM) Do? 🎧

A Trial Class Manager (TCM) is responsible for delivering the very first online trial lesson and guiding families through their initial decision about learning with Kodland.

During each trial session, you will:

  • Meet the child and at least one parent via Zoom.

  • Build rapport and ask targeted questions to understand the child’s background, interests, goals, and prior experience.

  • Lead a short hands-on activity (simple coding, game logic, or digital task) using our prepared materials.

  • Recommend the most suitable program and learning format, based on the child’s needs and engagement during the trial.

  • Answer questions, handle basic objections, and guide the family toward a clear “yes/no” decision regarding enrollment.

This role is a combination of:

  • 🎓 Education — explaining concepts clearly and keeping the child engaged

  • 🗣 Communication — listening carefully, asking the right questions, and adapting your approach to each family

  • 💼 Sales — demonstrating value, discussing pricing transparently, and confidently closing when there is a fit

⚠️ Important to note:

This is not a pure teaching role and not a scripted call-center position. You will be provided with structure, materials, and guidance — but you are expected to think independently, adapt to each family, and actively lead the conversation.

4. Requirements ✅

Must-haves

  • Clear, confident spoken Arabic & English

  • A reliable laptop or PC with a working webcam and microphone

  • Stable internet connection suitable for uninterrupted Zoom video calls

  • A quiet, professional workspace with your camera turned on

  • Consistent availability of 20–25 hours per week during prime time

    (weekday afternoons/evenings + daytime weekend hours)

  • Genuine comfort communicating with both children and adults

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales, customer service, customer success, tutoring, or coaching

  • Any prior experience working with children and/or parents

  • Experience working remotely and managing your own schedule independently

5. Schedule & Availability 🕒

When do TCMs usually work?

  • Weekdays: primarily between 16:00–22:00 Egypt time

  • Weekends: primarily between 10:00–20:00 Egypt time

The standard setup includes 5 working days per week, with

  • 1 weekday off, and

  • 1 day off on Friday or Saturday.

Exact hours are negotiable, but consistent weekly availability is required so we can plan schedules in advance and reliably allocate trial classes.

Typical workload progression

The usual setup looks like this:

  • After passing probation period:

    You start with 15 trial class hours per week, plus around 3 administrative hours

    (1:1s, team meetings, internal webinars)

  • As you gain experience:

    Your schedule typically increases to 20 trial class hours per week, plus administrative hours

  • Top-performing TCMs:

    Have the opportunity to increase up to 25 trial class hours per week

📌 Note: Administrative hours are paid at the same rate as completed trial classes.

Availability & professionalism

You set your availability together with your Team Leader in advance, and we expect you to honour the time slots you open, so families are not left waiting.

That said, we understand that unexpected situations and force majeure can happen. We approach scheduling humanely and reasonably — the key expectation is professional communication in advance whenever changes are needed so that everything can be handled smoothly.

6. Compensation & Income Model 💶

This is an independent contractor role with performance-based income. Payments are made in EGP twice per month.

🔑 How Your Income Is Built

  1. Base Payment

    You receive a fixed payment for every completed trial class.

  2. Bonus Income

    You earn a percentage of your total monthly sales.

    The higher your conversion rate, the higher your bonus percentage.

Current Model

  • Base payment:100 EGP per completed trial

  • Revenue bonus:3%, 4.5% and 6% of total monthly revenue (depends on your monthly revenue)

💰 What This Means in Real Numbers

The examples below are based on real internal averages.

📌 These figures reflect a part-time role

  • Early stage / newcomers ~ up to 400$ per month (base + bonus)

  • Stable performers ~ up to 700$+ per month

  • Top performers: can reach up to 1200$+ per month

💡

We actively support our managers with regular feedback and performance analysis, as well as ongoing training, webinars, and best-practice sharing. Our goal is to help you grow into stronger performance and, as a result, higher income.

At the same time, it’s important to understand: income growth doesn’t happen instantly and depends on personal skills, learning speed, consistency, and effort. Progress comes step by step. If you’re motivated to learn, reflect, and continuously improve, this role offers real earning potential — even with part-time hours!

7. Training & Hiring Journey 🧭

We don’t send you straight into real classes. There is a clear and structured training journey before you start working with real families.

Your journey with Kodland:

1️⃣ This page + Application Form

You carefully review this page and submit the application form at the bottom.

2️⃣ Recruiter Interview (≈20 minutes, Zoom)

A short call to check your technical setup, English level, basic fit, and expectations.

3️⃣ Training Phase: Self-Study, Webinars & Practice

You get access to our learning platform with all the core materials needed to succeed as a TCM.

This phase includes:

  • structured self-study materials,

  • live webinars explaining the role, income model, schedule, and tools,

  • practical sessions and guided role-plays with feedback.

4️⃣ Assessment Phase: Simulated Trial Classes

You complete simulated trial classes with trainers and your future Team Lead to confirm you’re ready to work with real families.

If needed, you may receive feedback and a second attempt.

5️⃣ Onboarding & First Real Trials

You sign your contractor agreement, get access to all tools, and start your probation period with real families and clear performance expectations.

⏱ Timeline:

The typical time from application to starting real trial classes is around 2 weeks, depending on training schedules and your participation speed.

8. Is This Role For You? 🎯

You will likely enjoy this role if:

  • You enjoy talking to people, asking questions, and understanding their needs

  • You stay focused on learning and improvement, even when results don’t come immediately.

  • You’re comfortable working evenings and on one weekend day.

  • You are self-disciplined and can work remotely without constant supervision

  • You genuinely care about children’s learning and growth through technology

  • You are motivated by performance-based income and improving your results over time

This role is probably not a good fit if:

  • You’re looking for a traditional 9–5 role with a fixed salary

  • You feel uncomfortable selling, discussing prices, or guiding people toward a decision

  • You strongly prefer not to work evenings or weekends

  • You don’t want to be on camera or communicate directly with parents

  • You find it difficult to manage your own time in a remote setup

9. What Happens After You Apply? ⏭️

  1. You submit the application form below.

  2. Our team reviews your availability, technical setup, and basic fit.

  3. If there’s a match, we invite you to a 20-minute Zoom interview with a recruiter.

  4. After the interview, you’ll clearly know:

    • whether this role is a good fit for you, and

    • whether you’re invited to join the next Welcome Webinar & Training group.

If it’s not a match (for example, due to availability or expectations), we’ll let you know as well.

jobs.description:
About Us

At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

And now we are looking for an Engineering Manager to join us as part of our team.

About the role

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of millions of companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others.

Data Collection Technology is a core technology domain responsible for ingesting, processing, managing, and publishing data to the main platform. It combines a suite of battle-proven legacy data collection tools with a modern data collection platform.
The broader data management platform provides a unified environment for managing and validating data across both private and public markets. It brings together multiple tools and workflows, standardizes quality-assurance processes, and enables scalable automation for data operations.

As an Engineering Manager in PitchBook’s DataTech team, you will be responsible for ensuring your teams execute well and deliver the outcomes they commit to. Your primary focus will be strengthening delivery capabilities and helping teams improve planning, execution and predictability.

You will also ensure effective platform-wide operational processes, including customer support and incident management. People management and team development remain important responsibilities, with successful and sustainable delivery as the primary focus.

Tech Stack: Java 21, Kubernetes/GitOps, Spring Boot, MFE Architecture, OpenAPI, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis

Team setup: 2 teams

Work Environment: ​​flexible

As a qualified expert You will

Own delivery and engineering outcomes for DataTech teams

  • Be accountable for delivery, velocity, quality, reliability and scalability
  • Ensure work is aligned with DataTech priorities, using effective visualization and reporting to understand delivery, identify problems and drive improvements

Ensure strong SDLC execution and technical quality

  • Ensure teams execute effectively across refinement, design, estimation, implementation, testing and deployment
  • Identify execution gaps and work with SDE Leads to improve how delivery works
  • Invest in improving a AI-enabled SDLC, including adoption and evolution of SDD frameworks and practices

Plan and manage capacity

  • Own short- and long-term capacity and capability planning
  • Allocate people in line with DataTech priorities and delivery commitments
  • Surface capacity and delivery risks and drive mitigation

Own product quality, reliability and operations

  • Be accountable for stability, reliability, performance and overall quality
  • Ensure effective platform-wide customer support, incident management, observability and other operational processes
  • Balance delivery with technical health and operational needs

Lead and grow engineers and SDE Leads

  • Manage engineers and SDE Leads through coaching, feedback, growth and performance management
  • Build and evolve teams through hiring, onboarding and shaping the right skill mix
  • Maintain healthy team dynamics and address people issues early

Strengthen ways of working and collaboration

  • Improve engineering practices where they help teams deliver more effectively
  • Partner with Product, Data and other domains to align plans and manage dependencies
  • Contribute to domain-level planning and cross-team collaboration

We’re looking for you if you have

  • Proven engineering leadership experience managing multiple software/data engineering teams
  • Strong track record of delivery, including improving planning, prioritization and execution
  • Ability to use delivery data, visualization and reporting to identify problems and drive improvements
  • Strong people-management skills: coaching, performance management and team development
  • Strong technical judgment and ability to work with engineering leads to improve delivery practices, including effective use of GenAI and SDD
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ownership mindset: accountable for delivery as well as long-term quality and maintainability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Bonus points

  • Experience in DataTech-like domains (data ingestion, processing, curation).
  • Familiarity with Stream-Aligned Teams / Team Topologies.
  • Experience working with Architecture, Platform, SRE and other enabling teams.
  • Experience improving observability, reliability and incident management for backend/data services.

What’s in it for You

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Experience an agile and flexible working environment

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Be among like-minded people

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Feel supported by your HR, and take advantage of our referral bonus program.

Interview steps

  • Pre-Screening with the recruiter
  • Manager screening
  • Tech Interview
  • Architecture interview
  • HRBP Interview
  • Client Interview

Position: Medical Authorizations Specialist

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Full-Time, Remote Work.

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced MedicalAuthorization Specialist to manage the insurance authorization process and ensure services are properly authorised and documented.

The successful candidate will be responsible for verifying authorization requirements, submitting authorization requests, following up with insurance providers, monitoring authorization status, and maintaining accurate records.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review patient information and determine insurance authorization requirements.
  • Submit authorization requests to insurance companies and relevant payers.
  • Follow up with insurance providers regarding pending authorization requests.
  • Monitor authorization status and ensure requests are processed within required timelines.
  • Track approved, pending, denied, and expired authorizations.
  • Obtain authorization numbers and accurately record authorization details.
  • Identify missing or incorrect information that may delay authorization.
  • Communicate with insurance providers to resolve authorization-related queries.
  • Escalate denied or complex authorization issues when required.
  • Ensure authorizations are obtained before services are provided, where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date authorization records.
  • Update internal systems and spreadsheets with authorization information.
  • Ensure all supporting documentation is submitted correctly.
  • Monitor authorization expiration dates and initiate renewals when required.
  • Keep organised records of submissions, approvals, denials, and follow-ups.
  • Ensure authorization information is communicated to the relevant internal teams.
  • Communicate professionally with insurance providers regarding authorization requests.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding authorization requests.
  • Liaise with internal clinical, administrative, and billing teams as required.
  • Clearly communicate authorization updates, requirements, and issues.
  • Proactively identify outstanding items and ensure they are resolved.

Requirements

  • Previous hands-on experience working with insurance authorizations is required.
  • Experience within a healthcare, medical, or insurance environment.
  • Strong understanding of the insurance authorization process.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple authorization requests and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong follow-through and ability to proactively chase outstanding requests.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online systems, and healthcare software.
  • Strong computer skills and ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • Ability to work independently while following established processes.
  • Professional handling of confidential patient and insurance information.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book designed for women navigating the unique season of pregnancy. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A general book for navigating the beautifully joyful, deeply transitional, and physically exhausting season of pregnancy through the lens of the gospel.
  • A targeted book that addresses specific emotional or spiritual challenges that often arise during pregnancy, such as anxiety and fear, body image in pregnancy, navigating pregnancy after a previous loss, or preparing for labor and delivery.

The ideal project will combine in-depth theology with deep empathy, meeting expectant mothers right where they are with the comforting truths of God’s Word.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

jobs.excerpt: Own every product run from production order to live for sale.
jobs.description:
Own every product run from production order to live for sale.

$3,500–4,000/month | Full-time | Remote, US MT overlap
HealthyGut is a supplements brand selling direct through its own Shopify store, Amazon (FBA) and distributor channels. Our product lines include Tributyrin-X, BeSerene IR & Daily, Magnesium-HP, HoloZyme, HCL Guard, HoloImmune and HistaHarmony.

We work with contract manufacturers across Europe and the US, move freight through a mix of domestic and international carriers, and run fulfilment through Shipfusion, our 3PL. Operations are coordinated in Asana, with comms running across email and Slack.

We're a small, focused team building a growing supplements business, and this role is the operational backbone that keeps every product moving from formulation through to live sale.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who owns the end-to-end journey of every HealthyGut product — from the moment a production order is placed with a contract manufacturer, through freight, import and quality documentation, to finished goods checked into 3PL inventory and live for sale across every channel.

This is a coordination-heavy operations role sitting at the intersection of manufacturing, logistics, regulatory/quality documentation and e-commerce catalog management. You'll keep many concurrent product runs moving on schedule, maintain the master records everyone else relies on, and act as the central communication hub between outside partners (manufacturers, freight forwarders, the 3PL) and internal leadership, marketing and inventory planning.

Some overlap with US Mountain Time is needed, but exact working hours are negotiable.

What you'll actually be doing

Production & manufacturing coordination

  • Track purchase orders and production timelines with contract manufacturers for every SKU and run
  • Check in ahead of each reorder to confirm lead times, secure production slots and flag risks to stock coverage
  • Coordinate formula updates and reformulations — ingredient changes, capsule-size constraints, potency targets — including routing R&D contracts and bench testing
  • Source raw ingredients — identify and qualify suppliers, request samples and specifications, gather quotes, and compare options on both quality and cost so the Founder/Formulator can make the call
  • Track raw-ingredient sourcing and documentation, and decisions on existing vs. new material lots
  • Track production invoicing: down payments, proformas, credit notes and final invoices

Freight, import & insurance

  • Solicit and compare freight quotes across carriers for domestic and international lanes, and book pickups
  • Coordinate international air freight and import logistics — customs clearance, customs bonds, TSCA documentation and FDA release
  • Arrange cargo insurance per shipment and confirm full shipment value is covered
  • Act as the logistics point of contact between manufacturers, forwarders and the 3PL

3PL intake & inventory (Shipfusion)

  • Create inbound shipments for every run and component order (bottles, pill cases, glass jars)
  • Create and configure new SKUs — cost, retail price, weight, country of origin, HS/tariff codes
  • Enter and update case sizes, unit counts, weights, dimensions and lot/expiration dates
  • Track check-in and resolve discrepancies — damaged, missing or rejected units

Quality documentation (CoAs)

  • Request current CoAs from manufacturers for each new lot and locate historical ones when needed
  • Edit raw CoAs into public-ready versions, upload both to the shared drive
  • Maintain the master CoA spreadsheet and hand public-ready files to Marketing

Labels, renders & creative assets

  • Coordinate new and updated label designs with manufacturers and the label printer — proofs, dies, estimates
  • Prepare and route label files, convert to web-ready formats, hand off to Marketing
  • Request updated 3D bottle renders for new sizes, formula changes and label corrections
  • Maintain the master label spreadsheet and share assets with distributors

E-commerce catalog & channel updates

  • Update Shopify and Amazon with new ingredient info, labels and imagery when formulas change — timed to sell-through of old stock
  • Add and update product weights and dimensions in Shopify and the 3PL
  • Manage stock states: sold-out flags, backorders, product and instruction pages

Amazon FBA restocking

  • Plan and send FBA replenishment shipments, coordinating quantities with the inventory/Amazon lead
  • Time restocks around Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, and allocate stock between the 3PL and Amazon

Cross-functional coordination & record-keeping

  • Serve as the central tracking hub from order to shelf, keeping leadership, marketing, inventory planning and distributors informed
  • Maintain master tracking spreadsheets (labels, CoAs, HG + Amazon case & lot info) as the single source of truth
  • Consolidate comms from email, Slack and Asana into one organised, auditable task system

Where the role can grow

There's real scope to take on more ownership. Over time we'd like this person to move us from reactive to proactive:

Demand planning & reorder points — reorders triggered by data-driven exhaustion dates and safety-stock targets rather than last-minute days-of-stock math

Landed-cost & COGS tracking — a per-run model covering unit cost, freight, duties/tariffs and insurance to inform pricing and margin

Vendor & 3PL performance management — a supplier scorecard (on-time delivery, quality, damage rates), structured check-ins and a formal damage-claim process

Regulatory & compliance stewardship — an organised library of TSCA, FDA, GMP/NSF and import documentation, with registrations, renewals and audit-readiness tracked

SOP documentation — writing these workflows down so the role is transferable and not dependent on one person's memory

New-product & new-size launch management — a standard checklist spanning formula, label, render, CoA, SKU setup, freight and channel go-live

EU/UK expansion support, packaging & component sourcing, and a central PO/payment tracker tied to production milestones

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ 3-5 years experience as an Operations Manager in the supplements, nutraceuticals, or similar industry

✅ Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented — juggles many concurrent product runs and their moving parts without dropping steps

✅ Fluent, or quick to learn, in logistics and import terminology — freight quoting, customs/HTS/TARIC codes, cargo insurance, 3PL operations

✅ Strong spreadsheet and systems skills — Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, a 3PL platform (Shipfusion or comparable), Asana; Google Sheets as a daily tool

Paid search

Analytics and measurement

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy¿Preparas la prueba de ofimática de oposiciones autonómicas o estatales, con Office 365 o LibreOffice?
jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Preparas la prueba de ofimática de oposiciones autonómicas o estatales, con Office 365 o LibreOffice? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy.

💻 Buscamos preparadores/as de Ofimática para oposiciones

La ofimática es una prueba decisiva, y muchas veces eliminatoria, en las oposiciones de perfil administrativo. Cada administración la examina a su manera: con paquetes distintos, versiones distintas y formatos distintos.

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en ofimática para oposiciones, con especial foco en las oposiciones de las comunidades autónomas.

🗺️ Especial foco: oposiciones de las Comunidades Autónomas

Buscamos especialmente preparadores que conozcan la prueba de ofimática de los cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos de las comunidades autónomas, porque es donde más cambia:

  • El paquete ofimático: unas comunidades examinan de Microsoft 365 y otras de LibreOffice (Writer, Calc, Impress, Base).

  • La versión: algunas fijan una versión concreta del programa y otras la última disponible.

  • El formato: test teórico-práctico, supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla o ejercicios delante del ordenador.

Por ejemplo, la Comunidad de Madrid examina de Windows y Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook y herramientas colaborativas como Teams o SharePoint) con un test de ofimática propio; la Xunta de Galicia y la Junta de Andalucía, en cambio, examinan de LibreOffice. Por eso necesitamos preparadores que conozcan a fondo la prueba de cada comunidad.

No necesitas conocerlas todas. Buscamos a quien domine a fondo la prueba de su comunidad, o de varias.

🗂️ Dos tipos de prueba

📝 Ofimática tipo test: preguntas sobre funciones, rutas de menús, opciones y atajos de cada programa, a menudo con supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla.

🖥️ Ofimática práctica: ejercicios reales con tiempo limitado o pruebas específicas de ofimática.

🛠️ Paquetes y herramientas

Microsoft 365

  • Word · Excel · Access · Outlook · PowerPoint

  • Herramientas colaborativas: Teams, SharePoint y OneDrive

LibreOffice

  • Writer · Calc · Impress · Base

Común

  • Windows (10 y 11), explorador de archivos, Internet e informática básica

🏛️ Otras oposiciones en las que también buscamos experiencia

  • Administración General del Estado (Auxiliar y Administrativo)

  • Justicia (Tramitación Procesal y Administrativa)

  • Sanidad (Auxiliar Administrativo y Administrativo)

  • Ferroviarias (áreas administrativas de ADIF y Renfe)

  • Ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades (por ejemplo, el Ayuntamiento de Madrid)

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Preparadores/as de ofimática para oposiciones, sobre todo de cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos autonómicos.

  • Funcionarios/as con plaza que hayan superado la prueba de ofimática de su comunidad y quieran enseñarla.

  • Formadores/as de ofimática (Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice) con interés en el mundo de las oposiciones.

  • Personas que sepan cómo pregunta cada tribunal: qué versión, qué funciones y qué tipo de supuestos.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar paso a paso, detectar errores y hacer fácil lo que parece técnico.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online de Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice, adaptadas a la prueba de cada comunidad.

  • Preguntas tipo test y supuestos sobre capturas con el formato de cada tribunal.

  • Ejercicios prácticos con tiempo limitado y su corrección.

  • Resolución en vídeo de exámenes oficiales de convocatorias anteriores.

  • Simulacros de la prueba de ofimática.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos, esquemas y guías de atajos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, qué paquete ofimático dominas y en qué comunidades u oposiciones estás acostumbrado/a a formar.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido de ofimática o la resolución comentada de varias preguntas tipo test o de un ejercicio práctico, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. Puedes grabar tu pantalla si te resulta más cómodo. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si dominas la ofimática de las oposiciones y quieres ayudar a otros a superar esa prueba, queremos conocerte.

👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit highly skilled and talented people to join the team to further design, build and scale our platform offerings across a wide range of web and mobile projects which utilize modern technologies such as Data Streaming, Big Data, and Real-Time Statistics Computation and enjoy a work-life balance, supportive and friendly environment.

Location

  • Exposure to Agile methodologies and related management tools (JIRA, Confluence);

Working at Bitso

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Sr. Manager of Corporate FP&A

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Latam
jobs.excerpt: Your Purpose At Bitso, the Software Engineer on the Nexus Squad owns the reliability, scalability, and evolution of our mission-critical pay-in and pay-out systems, the financial backbone that moves billions of dollars worldwide.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

At Bitso, the Software Engineer on the Nexus Squad owns the reliability, scalability, and evolution of our mission-critical pay-in and pay-out systems, the financial backbone that moves billions of dollars worldwide.

You will design and deliver event-driven, high-throughput solutions that ensure every pay-in and pay-out is fast, accurate, and resilient.

Working closely with product, infrastructure, and compliance stakeholders, you will shape the technical direction of a domain where the bar for quality is exceptionally high, resilience is built through continuous learning, and every millisecond of performance matters — for the millions of retail users and the businesses that rely on Bitso to power their financial operations.

Reports To

This role reports to the Nexus Engineering Manager.

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in Java backend development, with a proven track record of shipping production systems at scale.
  • You are familiar with event-driven architecture patterns (event sourcing, CQRS, sagas) and have hands-on experience operating Apache Kafka in high-throughput, real-money environments.
  • You have designed and implemented distributed, fault-tolerant microservices that handle financial or similarly critical transactional data.
  • You have solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.
  • You are comfortable with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • You communicate complex technical concepts clearly in English, written and spoken, to engineering peers, product managers, and senior leadership.
  • You work with a high degree of autonomy and ownership — you identify problems, propose solutions, and see them through to production.
  • You are familiar with AI-assisted development flow and tools (Cursor, Claude, CodeRabbit).
  • You have a strong sense of urgency and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes fintech environment.
  • Financial Domain (nice to have):Familiarity with payment rails, reconciliation or idempotent transaction processing in financial systems is a strong plus.

What You Will Do

  • Own pay-in and pay-out systems: design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that processes financial transactions and moves billions of dollars worldwide.
  • Architect event-driven solutions: design Kafka-based pipelines and workflows that guarantee correctness, ordering, and resilience at scale.
  • Drive technical decisions: lead architecture discussions, define and use patterns, and set standards for the pay-in and pay-out domain in collaboration with the Nexus team.
  • Deliver high-quality code: write clean, well-tested, high-performance Java code and champion engineering best practices through code reviews.
  • Embrace AI-assisted development: leverage tools like Cursor, Claude, and CodeRabbit as part of your everyday workflow, contribute to skills and guardrails development, and apply Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practices to ensure solutions are well-defined, reviewable, and aligned before implementation begins.
  • Ensure system reliability: proactively monitor, debug, and resolve production incidents with a focus on root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: partner with Product, Compliance, and Finance stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into sound technical solutions.
  • Mentor and uplift: share knowledge with fellow engineers, contribute to internal tech talks, and foster a culture of continuous improvement within the squad.
  • Improve observability: instrument services with comprehensive metrics, logs, and traces to enable rapid diagnosis and confident deployments.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Software Architect to lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise‑grade, cloud‑native Java applications. In this pivotal role, you will define architectural standards, mentor engineering teams, drive adoption of modern development practices — including AI‑augmented workflows — and ensure our systems are built for resilience, scalability, and long‑term maintainability.

You will serve as the technical authority across multiple product domains, collaborating closely with product management, DevOps, and senior leadership to align technology decisions with strategic business objectives.

Position Details

Job Title: Software Architect
Department: Engineering – Architecture & Platform
Reports To: VP of Engineering
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Experience: 15+ Years Software Engineering; 5+ Years Architecture

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

  • Define and enforce enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and conventions across all product domains
  • Lead technical design sessions and author Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) for major system changes
  • Establish and refine microservices topology, service contracts, and inter‑service communication strategies
  • Oversee database schema design, migration versioning, and data consistency strategies across distributed systems

Engineering Excellence

  • Drive adoption of SOLID principles, Gang‑of‑Four design patterns, and reactive programming paradigms
  • Establish code quality gates: minimum 85%+ test coverage enforced via CI/CD pipelines
  • Introduce JMH micro‑benchmarking for performance‑critical paths and define SLOs for critical services
  • Own OpenAPI/Swagger documentation standards and API versioning governance
  • Guide proper exception hierarchy design, structured logging, and observability best practices (traces, metrics, logs)

AI‑Augmented Development

  • Champion integration of AI‑assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI, Cursor, Claude) into the SDLC
  • Define guidelines for safe, productive, and auditable use of LLM‑generated code in production systems
  • Evaluate and prototype AI/ML integration patterns: LLM API consumption, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), embedding pipelines, and vector store integrations within the Java/Spring ecosystem
  • Develop internal AI‑powered productivity tooling (code reviewers, test generators, documentation assistants) using Spring AI or LangChain4j
  • Ensure AI‑generated outputs comply with security, licensing, and intellectual property policies

Cloud‑Native & Infrastructure

  • Architect cloud‑native solutions on GCP leveraging Kubernetes, service meshes, and managed data services
  • Define containerisation, configuration management, and secret management standards
  • Lead distributed transaction strategy using Saga patterns, idempotent consumers, and outbox patterns
  • Oversee CI/CD pipeline architecture and promote GitOps workflows

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor senior and mid‑level engineers in architectural thinking, design patterns, and production‑readiness criteria
  • Conduct architecture reviews, technical due diligence, and proof‑of‑concept evaluations
  • Collaborate with Product and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable technical roadmaps
  • Represent the engineering organisation in cross‑functional architecture committees and vendor evaluations

Technical Requirements

Core Java & Spring Ecosystem

  • Java 17+
  • Spring Boot 3.x & Spring Framework 6.x
  • Spring Security (OAuth 2.1, JWT, OIDC)
  • Spring Data JPA / R2DBC / Redis
  • Spring Cloud
  • Reactive Streams
  • Maven & Gradle build tooling
  • Hibernate ORM & Flyway migrations

Enterprise Patterns & Architecture

  • Domain‑Driven Design (Aggregates, Bounded Contexts)
  • CQRS & Event Sourcing (Axon / custom)
  • Saga Pattern (Choreography & Orchestration)
  • Repository & Unit of Work Pattern
  • Specification Pattern for query composition
  • Strategy, Factory, Builder, and Decorator Patterns
  • Dependency Injection mastery (Spring IoC)

Quality, Testing & Observability

  • JUnit 5, Mockito, TestContainers, ArchUnit
  • JMH Benchmarking & performance profiling
  • SonarQube, OWASP Dependency Check
  • OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger documentation
  • Micrometer + Prometheus + Grafana
  • Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin)
  • Resilience testing

Cloud, Messaging & Data

  • GCP (container & serverless services)
  • Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD
  • Apache Kafka
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • gRPC & Protocol Buffers
  • GraphQL
  • REST API design best practices

AI & Machine Learning Integration

  • Spring AI / LangChain4j framework experience
  • LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic)
  • Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
  • Vector databases
  • Embedding models and semantic search
  • AI‑assisted code generation tool governance
  • Prompt engineering & chain‑of‑thought patterns

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of professional software engineering experience with 5+ years in a software architect or principal engineer role
  • Deep expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, and the broader enterprise Java ecosystem
  • Demonstrable production experience with microservices, event‑driven systems, and cloud‑native architectures
  • Strong command of DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed transaction patterns
  • Hands‑on experience with containerised deployments on Kubernetes in a major cloud provider
  • Proven ability to mentor and elevate the technical skills of engineering teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication for both technical and non‑technical audiences

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

Brand Strategy

  • Strengthen and consistently manage the company’s brand across all platforms.

  • Oversee external designers, copywriters and creative specialists where required.

SEO, Website & Digital Performance

  • Develop and execute an SEO strategy to improve search visibility, rankings and organic traffic.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor and market research.
  • Improve website content, structure, user experience and conversion performance.
  • Monitor website traffic, user behaviour, lead sources and conversion data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve website performance and lead conversion.
  • Coordinate website improvements with external developers or specialists.
  • Ensure digital activity is focused on meaningful business outcomes and lead generation.

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, manage and optimise Google Ads and other relevant paid advertising campaigns.
  • Develop campaigns focused on generating high-quality, relevant leads.
  • Monitor campaign performance, budgets, conversion rates and cost per lead.
  • Test and optimise messaging, audiences, landing pages and campaign strategies.
  • Analyse results and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Provide clear reporting on performance, challenges, opportunities and recommended adjustments.

Content, Social Media & Campaigns

  • Develop a content and social media strategy aligned with broader commercial objectives.
  • Oversee the creation of website content, social media content, campaigns and marketing materials.
  • Ensure content is relevant, accurate, engaging and appropriate for a professional healthcare environment.
  • Build brand awareness, engagement and trust across relevant platforms.
  • Manage marketing and campaign calendars and ensure consistent execution.
  • Ensure content supports lead generation and business growth rather than simply focusing on engagement metrics.

Referral & Partnership Marketing

  • Develop strategies to strengthen professional referral relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to generate leads through partnerships, professional networks and community relationships.
  • Develop campaigns and marketing materials that support referral growth.
  • Track referral sources and determine which activities generate the strongest results.
  • Develop sustainable relationship-based lead-generation channels.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Significant experience in a senior marketing, marketing management or brand strategy role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing an end-to-end marketing strategy.
  • Strong practical knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, social media, digital campaigns, websites and lead generation.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable leads and improving digital marketing performance.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and use it to drive decisions.
  • Experience managing external agencies, designers, developers, copywriters or other specialist providers.
  • Strong understanding of the US market and US consumer behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, organisation and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of marketing delivery.

Highly Advantageous

  • Experience within healthcare, home care, behavioural health, ABA or another regulated service environment.
  • Experience marketing services to US-based audiences.
  • Familiarity with healthcare referral networks and relationship-based lead generation.
  • Experience building, restructuring or scaling an in-house marketing function.
  • Experience working with service-based businesses where lead generation and conversion are key performance indicators.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

About Sidekick

At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

The role

A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.

What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.

You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.

You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.

What you'll do

  • Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.
  • Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.
  • Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.
  • Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.
  • Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.
  • Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)
  • Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.
  • Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.
  • You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in
  • Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page
  • Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof
  • Experience briefing editors or creators
  • Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about

We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.
  • Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries
  • You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results
  • You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast
  • Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Work from home

Juno makes conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster

Join us

We’re looking for people who enjoy building relationships and want to grow their career at a law firm that’s doing things differently.

You will lead a team responsible for KYC checks, document verification, screening, and customer compliance, while also handling complex cases and communicating directly with customers when required.
Your role goes beyond checking documents. You'll continuously look at the bigger picture — identifying inefficiencies, improving processes, supporting automation, keeping up with regulatory requirements, and thinking about compliance across multiple levels of the business, including company structures, branches, and different European markets.
You will be the role model for the team: someone who understands the details of compliance, sets the standard for quality and speed, and helps the team become better every day.

Lead by example
  • Perform KYC, document verification, and screening checks yourself.
  • Set the standard for accuracy, attention to detail, speed, and consistency.

  • Keep up to date with KYC regulations, requirements, and best practices relevant to the automotive business across Europe.
