jobs.description:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.

This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.

Requirements

What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

jobs.description:
Role: Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12
Team: Product
Reports to: VP, Product
Location: Flexible (Fully-Remote or Hybrid | Offices in NYC and Miami)

WHO WE ARE

The ASU+GSV Summit
Now in its 18th year, the ASU+GSV Summit is the world’s most important gathering of “PreK to Gray” education and workforce leaders. Held every April in San Diego, the 2026 event drew over 7,000 registrants to tackle the transformation of learning and skills delivery through generative AI, virtual reality, and other emerging technologies.

Frequently referred to as the “Davos of Education,” the ASU+GSV Summit brings together over 850 speakers each year, engaging in over 300 conversations around the future of learning and skills at scale. Past keynote speakers have included former President George W. Bush, Secretary Condoleezza Rice, Prime Minister Tony Blair, Sal Khan, Priscilla Chan, Ruby Bridges, Gloria Steinem, Jane Fonda, and countless others who have inspired our community to take bold action. Leading partners such as Google, Microsoft, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Gates Foundation, Walton Family Foundation, ClassDojo, and others help power this community. Through ongoing engagement and a global stage at ASU+GSV, you’ll help bring together the boldest thinkers reimagining what’s possible for the future of PreK-12 education.

As of July 2025, GSV Summit became part of Hyve Group's portfolio, joining forces with Bett to create the largest and most impactful education innovation community in the world, now reaching an audience of over 100,000 participants across five events on four continents.

WHO IS THE PRODUCT TEAM?

The Product Team is the creative and strategic engine behind the ASU+GSV Summit experience. We design and deliver the program of ASU+GSV, through curated content and experiences that inspire action: from high-production keynotes with global thought leaders to provocative panels, interactive workshops, community activations, and live product demos.

We bridge marketing, strategic partnerships, and community engagement to craft seamless, high-impact experiences for our attendees and partners. We collaborate closely with education leaders, practitioners, entrepreneurs, investors, policymakers, researchers, and thought leaders to shape the conversations that matter most in “PreK to Gray” learning.

Our work is structured around three core verticals—PreK-12, Higher Education, and Workforce—but the real power is in what we call “the magic in the mix.” Program often develops across verticals, so every team member takes a collaborative approach. We lean in to build the right program for the right audience at the right time, staying agile to launch new programs and rethink existing ones as needed.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We’re looking for a highly organized, execution-focused Jr. Product Manager to support the PreK-12 team at the ASU+GSV Summit. Reporting to the VP, Product and working closely with the Director, K12 Product, this role is about turning strategy into flawless execution. You will support in managing the details, logistics, and follow-through that bring the PreK-12 program to life.

Each year, 1,100+ PreK-12 leaders from 530+ districts and schools join us to explore the most pressing opportunities and challenges in PreK-12 education—from classroom innovation and educator support to school leadership, digital learning, and student outcomes.

You’ll partner closely with the Director, K12 Product to execute the PreK-12 content program, and collaborate with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to bring programming to life for our growing network of PreK-12 leaders. The role blends project management, program logistics, and cross-team coordination—requiring thoughtful collaboration, extreme precision, consistent follow-through, and a genuine curiosity about the PreK-12 landscape, including how AI is beginning to reshape it. That deep curiosity and eagerness to build understanding and discernment is what supports our team’s purpose: elevating the most cutting edge research, founders, and ideas, identifying the stars of tomorrow, and curating provocative conversations that push forward the most pressing challenges impacting the future of learning.


WHAT YOU WILL DO
As the Jr. Product Manager, PreK-12 you will be responsible for:

Program Execution & Project Management
  • Support the development and execution of the PreK-12 program under the direction of the Director, K12 Product—from researching emerging topics and identifying compelling voices to developing session concepts and bringing them to life at ASU+GSV Summit: ensuring that they are timely, relevant, and high-impact.
    • Across the product team, we work with 850+ speakers and 200+ partners to curate more 300 sessions each year, in addition to numerous bespoke community activations and experiences.
  • Supporting end-to-end program logistics: from speaker outreach and confirmation to session scheduling, run-of-show details, and final delivery.
  • Track and maintain accurate program documentation, session details, and speaker logistics with exceptional organization. No detail is too small.
  • Maintain the PreK-12 program calendar and pipeline, in coordination with partnership and community team to ensure a holistic approach, proactively flagging risks and dependencies

Partnership Support
  • Support the Director, K12 Product and the partnerships team in coordinating partner deliverables and activations tied to PreK-12 programming.
  • Track partner commitments and help ensure timely execution of partner-related program elements.
  • Help prepare materials and briefs for partner program involvement.
Community Collaboration
  • Partner closely with the SVP of Community, the VP of Educator Engagement, and the broader K12 community team to execute community engagement initiatives that support PreK-12 programming, in-person and year-round.
  • Help coordinate educator engagement touchpoints—webinars, community activations, and outreach—that feed the PreK-12 content pipeline.
  • Capture and organize community insights to help the Director, K12 Product surface emerging leaders, trends, and conversation topics.
Relationship Management & Stakeholder Communication
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for PreK-12 speakers, moderators, and partners—managing logistics, scheduling, and communications with professionalism and responsiveness.
  • Support the Director, K12 Product in engaging PreK-12 superintendents, principals, educators, EdTech founders, and policymakers to inform program development and ensure content reflects the opportunities, challenges, and perspectives shaping the field.
Technology & Process Excellence
  • Use Airtable, Cvent, generative AI, and other tools to streamline workflows and enhance program delivery.
  • Identify and test new technologies that can improve efficiency, attendee experience, and business outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 1–2 years of previous experience in program/product management or a similar role that requires excellent attention to detail and ability to translate from strategy to execution
  • PreK-12 education or EdTech experience a strong plus
Skills & Qualities
  • Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: You track dozens of moving pieces without dropping a thread, and you build the systems to keep everything on track. No detail is too small.
  • Execution-Focused: You’re energized by getting things done—turning plans into action and keeping programs moving forward through prompt, reliable follow-through.
  • Collaborative & Coachable: You understand that great program execution depends on keeping multiple teams aligned and are an effective team-player working across teams on shared projects and initiatives. You take direction and feedback well, and are eager to learn the PreK-12 landscape.
  • Community Builder: You think about programming through the eyes of the people in the room and are curious about what will make a conversation useful, surprising, and relevant to different PreK–12 audiences
  • Strong Communicator: You write and speak clearly and professionally—whether confirming a speaker, updating a partner, or briefing your manager.
  • Calm Under Pressure: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay composed as details shift in the weeks leading up to Summit.
  • Curious About Education & AI: You’re genuinely interested in how AI and technology are reshaping PreK-12 education, and eager to grow your expertise in the sector.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: You anticipate issues before they become problems and bring solutions, not just questions, to your manager.
  • Tech-Forward & Tech-Savvy: You’re facile with tools like Airtable, Cvent, Google Workspace, and AI-powered platforms that boost efficiency and enhance program delivery.

This role requires a willingness to travel and work extended hours in the weeks leading up to the Summit, as well as supplemental travel throughout the year.

GSV is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Jampp, we’re on the mission of playing a leading role enabling the mobile app economy to grow. How? We build technology to support the most ambitious companies - from gaming to commerce pioneers - to propel the reach of their apps and accelerate their mobile businesses.

A demand-side platform (DSP) at heart, the technical challenges we face every day are huge: from processing over 2 million auctions per second in less than 40ms each, to efficiently storing over 150TB of events’ data daily, to continuously choosing the optimal price level for 300+ campaigns spending several million dollars every month in a constantly changing market, there’s never a boring day at Jampp!

WHY DO WE NEED YOU?

At Jampp, we solve the most complex and large-scale technological challenges in mobile advertising today. We process over 2,500,000 ad requests per second, which amounts to over 250TB of data per day, across three global data centers. We rely on real-time machine learning models (with billions of features) that give us predictions in less than 100ms. If you've spent your career building real-time, high-throughput data pipelines and want to own the architecture behind systems handling a billion events daily, Jampp is the right place for you.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you won't just build pipelines. You'll set the technical direction for how Jampp's data infrastructure evolves. You'll design, architect, and operate large-scale distributed systems across all environments, make key technology decisions, and mentor the engineers around you as we build our next-generation data infrastructure.

If you have deep, hands-on experience with distributed systems at scale, a strong command of Python, and you thrive owning ambiguous, high-impact technical problems in a fast-paced environment, you might be the new Jampper we're looking for.

WHAT YOU´LL DO

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for key pieces of Jampp's data infrastructure, not just implement it, but define how it should evolve.
  • Design and implement ETL processes from a wide variety of sources, with an eye toward scalability, incrementality, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner closely with Data Scientists and other Senior/Staff engineers to design scalable data models and pipelines that support real-time ML infrastructure.
  • Drive data consistency and reliability standards across Jampp's systems and machine learning inputs, including defining what "good" looks like for the rest of the team.
  • Identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks: benchmark systems, diagnose root causes, and propose architectural solutions rather than one-off fixes.
  • Build and evolve the tools and frameworks that empower colleagues across the company to access data and build reliable, scalable transformations on their own.
  • Mentor and coach mid-level and junior engineers. You'll be a technical reference point on the team, not just an individual contributor.
  • Contribute to technical decision-making around tooling and infrastructure choices, weighing trade-offs at a systems level.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of programming experience in Python, with a track record of building and owning production-grade distributed systems. Go is a plus.
  • Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed data processing systems, not just maintaining pipelines someone else designed, but making the core design decisions yourself.
  • Deep hands-on experience with the AWS Big Data stack (Kinesis, EMR, Lambda, etc.) in high-throughput, transaction- or event-scale environments, think fintech, payments, e-commerce, ad-tech, or gaming, where real-time or near-real-time data volume is core to the business.
  • Strong experience managing and operating TrinoDB/PrestoDB clusters in production.
  • Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and PySpark, comfortable owning the infrastructure these run on, not just deploying to it.
  • Rock-solid knowledge of databases and SQL, including performance tuning at scale.
  • Databricks experience is a strong plus.
  • A track record of mentoring and coaching engineers. This role expects you to actively raise the technical bar of the team.
  • Engagement with the open source community (raising issues, contributing PRs, participating in technical discussions) is a strong extra, it signals the kind of depth we're looking for.
  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership and ambiguity, and making sound architectural calls without needing everything spelled out.

WHAT WE OFFER

About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

Octave is looking for a Sr. Business Operations Manager & Network Optimization to lead the analytical and strategic work behind Octave’s provider network. This role will determine where we need supply, identify how to improve provider utilization and retention, and evaluate the network and growth investments that will expand access and strengthen performance across markets, payer panels, and service lines. You will serve as a strategic partner to leaders across Operations, Clinical, Growth, Finance, Product, and Data. You will turn complex questions into clear insights and recommendations, then work across teams to translate those recommendations into measurable results. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and pragmatic operator who is comfortable moving between detailed data, executive-level recommendations, and cross-functional execution. You bring clarity to ambiguity, communicate crisply, and focus the organization on the highest-impact opportunities.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Provider network strategy

  • Assess and monitor provider supply relative to client demand across markets, specialties, payer panels, and care modalities.
  • Provide data-driven hiring targets and market priorities to Talent Acquisition and Clinical Operations.
  • Analyze available slot supply, access gaps, and provider capacity, including the operational and revenue implications of identified gaps.
  • Develop models and frameworks to project provider capacity needs based on client behavior, utilization patterns, and market trends.
  • Recommend network expansion or contraction, panel participation, and other actions that improve access and network performance.

Clinical operations and provider performance

  • Partner with Clinical Operations on initiatives that improve provider utilization, retention, engagement, and performance.
  • Lead provider segmentation strategy and translate provider NPS, experience, and performance insights into differentiated actions.
  • Monitor key provider and network KPIs, investigate root causes, and recommend improvements with measurable impact.
  • Identify and advance Product and operational levers that improve provider discovery and utilization, including ranking, slot recovery, and provider-facing workflows.
  • Lead focused initiatives from analysis through implementation and handoff, ensuring clear ownership and sustained results.

Reporting and strategic support

  • Build trusted reporting, dashboards, and recurring reviews on provider supply, demand, utilization, retention, and network performance.
  • Prepare concise executive and board-grade materials that clarify trends, implications, tradeoffs, and recommended actions for executive leaders to present.
  • Provide provider and clinical-operations insights that inform Product priorities and requirements.
  • Respond to ad hoc analysis requests from executives and external partners with accuracy and urgency.
  • Support select strategic planning and due-diligence efforts related to the provider network and clinical operations.

Education & Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in management consulting, business operations, strategy and operations, analytics, or a comparable field. Familiarity with healthcare compliance and data privacy regulations is a plus.
  • A track record of structuring ambiguous problems, analyzing complex data, and translating findings into practical recommendations and measurable results.
  • Strong quantitative and financial acumen, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling and experience with business cases, forecasting, or performance analysis.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Crisp written and verbal communication, including executive presentations that clarify insights, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
  • High agency, curiosity, and a willingness to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
  • No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
  • Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
  • Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
  • Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
  • There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
  • Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
  • Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation, Equity & Incentives:

Base Salary Range Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location/ zone. Final pay within the posted range will be decided based on a combination of job-related factors, including education, training, experience, and market demands.

  • Geo 1 (All other states & D.C.): $142,000 – $163,600
  • Geo 2 (CO, HI, MD, RI): $156,900 – $168,400
  • Geo 3 (AK, CA, CT, MA, NJ, NY, WA): $164,000 – $176,000

Variable Compensation & Equity

  • Performance Bonus: This role is not currently eligible for bonus incentives.

  • Responsible for the quality deliverables at the country level; follows project requirements and aapplicable country rules with moderate oversight from the SSU Country Manager. Produces site-specific contracts from country template. Provide support in submissions for proposed contract and budget for site. Provides support in negotiating budget and contract with site via Site Contracts Service Centre and SAM with Sponsor until resolution of issues and contract execution. About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LCSW) in New Mexico to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required

  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program

Innovatie, elke dag

Maak kennis met Yellowtail Conclusion, dé IT Consultancy expert die al 20 jaar lang succesvolle IT-oplossingen biedt aan toonaangevende Nederlandse banken, verzekeraars, (semi)overheidsinstanties en financieel adviseurs. Wij hebben een bewezen staat van dienst in IT. Met innovatie in ons DNA en een gezond portie lef, gaan wij de uitdaging aan om Artificial Intelligence in de financiële wereld te integreren, en daar kunnen we jouw hulp goed bij gebruiken!

Waarom is Junior AI Consultant jouw nieuwe job?

Als junior/medior AI consultant zal jij je in eerste instantie, zodra je start, zoveel mogelijk ontwikkelen op het vlak van IT en AI. Je bent betrokken bij het bouwen van IT-systemen en geeft daarbij richting aan developers. Hierdoor leer je terwijl je werkt, en zal je in staat zijn om technische en AI-gerelateerde concepten te vertalen naar begrijpelijke taal voor verschillende collega's binnen Yellowtail.

Je draagt daarnaast bij aan de interne ontwikkeling naar AI-gedreven werken. Dit doe je door het selecteren, maar ook onderzoeken, van geschikte AI tools en daar collega's over te onderwijzen. Je fungeert dan ook tegelijkertijd als vraagbaak. Hoewel je ambitie hebt om uiteindelijk zelf te bouwen, richt je je nu vooral op het aantonen en ontwikkelen van je kennis en begrip van IT en AI.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een achtergrond in een relevante IT-opleiding, zoals computer science, informatica, data science of artificial intelligence. Je hebt ervaring met Azure en beschikt over inzicht in hoe frontend en backend met elkaar samenwerken. Je hebt een holistische kijk op IT en begrijpt hoe verschillende onderdelen zoals DevOps, hosting, netwerken, AI en applicatieontwikkeling samenhangen.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, gedreven, een meedenker en toont makkelijk initiatief. Daarbij kan het zijn dat je een AI-opleiding gecombineerd hebt met werkervaring in IT, of juist weer andersom. Je bent iemand die zich thuis voelt op het snijvlak van technologie en inhoud, en weet complexe vraagstukken helder over te brengen. Binnen ons team krijg je alle ruimte om je passie voor AI, IT en business consultancy verder te verdiepen en uit te bouwen, in een omgeving waar leren, experimenteren en impact maken centraal staan!

Requirements

Wat wij belangrijk vinden

  • Een afgeronde masteropleiding (WO) in een relevante studierichting. Denk aan computer science, wiskunde, data science, AI;

  • Je neemt 0 tot 2 jaar werkervaring met je mee (Artificial Intelligence of in de IT);

  • Sterke communicatievaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, op alle vlakken en niveaus, voor klanten en collega’s.

  • Je hebt een holistisch IT beeld; je snapt bijvoorbeeld hoe front-end en back-end met elkaar interacteren;

  • Je toont initiatief, bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en vindt het leuk om jezelf hierin te blijven ontwikkelen.

What’s in it for you?

Wij houden van duidelijkheid: de salarisrange voor deze functie is tussen € 3.000 en € 3.600. Daarnaast ontvang je een mobiliteitsvergoeding die je op een groene en verantwoorde manier mag inzetten (bijvoorbeeld door te kiezen voor een elektrische leaseauto).

Verder kun je erop rekenen dat alle basiszaken perfect geregeld zijn. Denk aan een goede lunch, een snelle MacBook, telefoon, een prima pensioenregeling en een soepele salaris- en kostenafhandeling.

Maar dat is nog lang niet alles! Wat ons écht onderscheidt is onze manier van werken:

  • Je mag volledig jezelf zijn en hoeft niet te voldoen aan een bepaald imago of stereotype. We zien je graag zoals je bent.

  • Je krijgt alle ruimte en kansen geboden om te groeien en te leren. Samen gaan we op zoek naar jouw talenten en ontwikkelen deze verder.

  • Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf waar en wanneer je werkt. Wij geloven in een goede werk-privé balans dus helpen we je om je thuiswerkplek goed en verantwoord in te richten. Maar we gaan verder: je kunt bij ons zelfs vanaf je favoriete vakantiebestemming remote werken!

  • Je kunt veel leuke activiteiten ondernemen met collega’s. Zo hebben we om het jaar een trip met het bedrijf of een Hackaton, elke maand een Cultural FriYay en regelmatig andere (sportieve, interessante, leerzame) evenementen.

  • En wil je op kantoor even een pauze nemen, kun je altijd je collega uitdagen voor een potje dart, tafelvoetbal of tafeltennis. Of je pakt de Yellowtail kantoorfiets voor een rondje Naarderbos!

Highlights

Kickstart je carrière als AI Consultant bij Yellowtail Conclusion: ontwikkel jezelf, verdiep je (nog) verder in AI en leer complexe vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere, impactvolle oplossingen.

Are you passionate about making a difference and eager to join a dynamic team? ITX is seeking talented individuals who are looking to contribute to our mission but haven't found an open position that matches their needs or profile. By joining our talent pipeline, you'll be considered for future opportunities that align with your skills and aspirations.

About the Role

While we may not have a specific role open for you right now, we are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team. By submitting your application, you'll be the first to know about new opportunities that match your profile.

Why Apply?

At ITX, we don’t just build technology—we create solutions that move, touch, and inspire the world. By joining our team, you'll become part of an environment that champions integrity, innovation, and excellence. Here's what we offer:

  • Integrity: We believe in honoring our word and doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. Trust and transparency are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Innovation: Your curiosity and passion for technology are valued here. We learn from every experience and embrace purposeful experimentation to push boundaries.
  • Elegance: We seek simplicity in complexity. You’ll be part of a team that designs efficient, optimized, and user-friendly solutions that make a real impact.

  • Success: Collaboration is key. We thrive together—both as a team and in partnership with our clients—delivering outcomes that drive success for everyone.

If you’re driven by a desire to make a meaningful difference, ITX is the place where your talents can truly shine.

What We’re Looking For

  • Passionate individuals who are eager to contribute to ITX's mission and values.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to learn and grow within the company.
  • Relevant experience and qualifications that align with potential future roles at ITX.

ITX’s Compensation Philosophy

Equality in compensation has been our practice since ITX started, in 1997.

ITX believes that market-based pay ensures fair and equitable compensation for our worldwide team members and pay that is based on the market, not on who has the best negotiation skills. At ITX, you’ll never discover that someone in the same job with the same experience makes more than you, or that there are pay gaps based on race, gender, disability, or age.

How do our team members experience market-based pay at ITX? We gather market data to benchmark each position in our candidates’ and team members’ locations and use these benchmarks for candidate offers and to perform regular compensation reviews for our team members. You’ll never have to worry about asking for a pay raise again. At least once a year ITX automatically adjusts pay when the benchmark is higher than our team member’s compensation.

ITX has team members in many countries, and we use the same methodology for determining pay for all our teammates. For candidates outside of the United States, we use local market data to determine the benchmark range for the role.

Do you have questions about ITX’s compensation practices? Let us know! We’re proud of how we do compensation at ITX and welcome the opportunity to share more.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance &  Accounting
jobs.excerpt: Why Thunderbird? Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally.
jobs.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

We are a small but growing company of 70+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about MZLA and Mozilla: MZLA Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird and part of the Mozilla family. MZLA is separate from Mozilla Corporation and has its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit

The opportunity

We are looking for a finance leader with a strong accounting or controllership foundation and the breadth to lead financial planning and analysis, finance operations, and organization-level decision support.

As MZLA grows across donations, subscription services, enterprise offerings, and international operations, our financial needs are becoming more complex. We need stronger integration across accounting and FP&A, experienced oversight of emerging revenue models and tax obligations, and clear financial analysis that helps leadership understand performance, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Manager will serve as MZLA’s most senior finance professional and directly manage our Senior Staff Accountant and Senior FP&A Analyst. This is a hands-on functional leadership role for someone who can provide experienced financial judgment, develop an established team, and remain close to the details while helping build the systems, controls, reporting, and finance practices the organization needs for its next stage of growth.

This role requires regular working-hour overlap with the COO, finance team, and other colleagues across North American time zones. Candidates based in Eastern or Central time zones are preferred; candidates elsewhere in the United States should be comfortable maintaining substantial overlap with those working hours. Flexibility for meetings with colleagues, advisers, and affiliated organizations in Europe is also expected.

What you’ll do

  • Lead MZLA’s finance function, with overall responsibility for accounting, financial planning and analysis, tax, treasury, and finance operations.
  • Manage and develop MZLA’s finance team, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities, review practices, and accountability.
  • Oversee monthly and annual close, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounting policies, and internal controls.
  • Oversee accounting and revenue recognition across donations, subscriptions, enterprise arrangements, partnerships, and other revenue streams.
  • Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, longer-range financial planning, and scenario analysis.
  • Develop clear management reporting and visualizations that highlight important trends, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.
  • Oversee tax, audit, indirect tax, VAT/GST, corporate filings, and related work with external advisers.
  • Evaluate the financial, tax, accounting, and operational implications of entering new jurisdictions or establishing additional entities.
  • Work with Enterprise Partnerships and Legal to establish financial reporting, reconciliation, and control processes for partner-led commercial arrangements.
  • Oversee financial reporting to MZLA’s parent organization and affiliated Mozilla organizations.
  • Own financial oversight of payroll across multiple providers in partnership with the People team.
  • Strengthen finance systems and workflows, including accounting, expense management, payment-platform reconciliation, documentation, and automation.
  • Oversee cash-flow planning, treasury, banking, and investment activities, working closely with the Senior FP&A Analyst.
  • Serve as a trusted finance adviser to organizational leaders, translating complex financial information into clear recommendations.

What you bring

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including progressively responsible roles spanning accounting, financial planning and analysis, and finance operations.
  • Significant accounting or controllership experience, including responsibility for U.S. GAAP financial reporting, close processes, internal controls, revenue recognition, and complex accounting judgments.
  • 5+ years of people management experience in a finance or accounting environment, including coaching, feedback, prioritization, performance support, career development, and team development.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial data visualization and translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations for non-finance leaders.
  • Substantive experience with subscription, SaaS, digital-product, enterprise, or comparable technology-based revenue models.
  • Experience supporting partner-led commercial arrangements, such as reseller, licensing, wholesale, or revenue-sharing models, including evaluating financial terms and developing or overseeing the related reporting, reconciliation, controls, and revenue-recognition processes.
  • Working knowledge of merchant-of-record arrangements, payment platforms, indirect tax, and international VAT/GST requirements.
  • Experience supporting an internationally distributed organization and coordinating financial obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to oversee tax, audit, and other external finance requirements and effectively manage outside advisers.
  • Experience providing oversight and review of cash management, treasury, banking, and organizational investment activities, including developing recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • A track record of strengthening financial systems, workflows, documentation, and controls.
  • Strong judgment and comfort moving between people leadership, detailed financial review, practical hands-on problem-solving, and organization-level decision support.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to identify and explain financial risks, implications, and tradeoffs.

Bonus points for

  • Experience working within a subsidiary, portfolio, federated, or similarly affiliated organizational structure, including reporting to a parent organization or shareholder.
  • Prior work supporting the establishment of a new legal entity or expansion into a new jurisdiction.
  • Familiarity with Intacct, Ramp, or comparable finance and expense-management systems.
  • Experience in a mission-driven, open-source, nonprofit-affiliated, or similarly values-oriented organization.

About you

You are an experienced finance leader who is equally comfortable reviewing detailed financial work and advising senior leaders. You know that an effective finance function requires accurate reporting, sound controls, integrated planning, clear analysis, and a willingness to surface risks and make recommendations.

You understand the complexity created by multiple revenue models, partner-led commercial arrangements, international operations, and evolving tax and reporting obligations. You can translate those requirements into practical processes, recognize when external expertise is needed, and provide appropriate rigor without unnecessary complexity.

You are a thoughtful people manager who gives experienced team members direction, oversight, and room to grow. You can distill sophisticated analysis into what matters most for decision-makers and are motivated by building finance capability in a lean, hands-on environment.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll work with colleagues, partners, and customers across multiple countries and time zones, so strong communication and documentation skills are essential.

Availability to participate in required company-wide gatherings and team workweeks, which may involve periodic domestic or international travel.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

  • US: $165,000 - $190,000 USD

We may consider candidates with strong skills but less than the required experience. Title, level and compensation will be determined based on qualifications and experience.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

  • Fully remote work & schedule flexibility
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Annual bonus program

Rest & play

Health & family

Work eligibility

Applicants must reside in and have permanent work authorization for the country location(s) specified in the posting. We are unable to consider applicants outside of these markets at this time. And, we do not provide visa sponsorship.

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. We carefully review every cover letter and screening question, so take the time to answer each fully.We value authentic, thoughtful responses that reflect your own experience and perspective. It is fine to use AI tools to polish your writing, but your answers should be your own. Candidates who submit generic or unoriginal AI-generated responses may be disqualified from further consideration.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

MZLA believes in the value of diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge, and knows diversity, equity and inclusion are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

MZLA will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who combines deep infrastructure expertise with a forward-thinking approach to AI-driven operations. In this role you will maintain and improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of our Java-based applications while pioneering the use of large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and intelligent automation to transform how we monitor, respond to, and prevent incidents.

You will design and build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that consume observability data, triage alerts, generate runbooks, automate incident response steps, and surface actionable insights—reducing toil and accelerating mean time to resolution. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable tuning a JVM, writing PromQL, and prototyping an agentic pipeline with tool-calling LLMs.

Application Reliability & Performance

AI & Agentic Workflow Engineering

  • Develop tool-calling LLM agents that interact with infrastructure APIs (Kubernetes, Grafana, Jira, Slack, PagerDuty) to execute diagnostic and remediation actions autonomously or with human-in-the-loop approval.

  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and integrations that expose internal systems as tool surfaces for AI agents.

  • Evaluate, select, and operationalize LLM frameworks and orchestration platforms (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or custom solutions) for production-grade agentic systems.

  • Implement guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and feedback loops to ensure AI agent outputs are accurate, safe, and continuously improving.

Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate incident timelines, auto-generate post-mortem drafts, and surface patterns across historical incidents.

Automation & Toil Reduction

Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

jobs.title: Senior Copywriter (Direct Response)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a direct response copywriter who can own messaging strategy across a client pod in our info/coaching marketing agency.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a direct response copywriter who can own messaging strategy across a client pod in our info/coaching marketing agency.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional pod alongside a strategist, media buyer, and PM - writing ad scripts, funnel copy, emails, webinars, and sales pages for clients spending $100k-$1M+ monthly on ads. You'll also be participating in creative strategy alongside your team - analyzing what's working, deciding what to iterate on, and bringing ideas backed by reasoning, not just executing what you're handed.

This is not an order-taker role. You won't be waiting for someone to hand you a brief and tell you exactly what to write. You'll be reviewing performance data, understanding why winners win, and coming to creative strategy calls with "here's what we should test and why" - not just "ready for my next assignment."

What Success Looks Like

  • You come to creative strategy calls with prepared ideas and hypotheses - not just ready to receive direction
  • You can explain why a winning ad works (awareness level, belief shift, lead type) - not just that it works
  • Your first drafts are close to final - strategists aren't rewriting your copy, they're refining it
  • You know what's winning and losing across your clients without being asked
  • Iterations are based on insight (what belief shift is landing, what objection we're not handling) - not surface-level changes (let's try a different hook)
  • The strategist trusts you to lead on messaging and creative concepts so they can focus on client relationships and offer strategy
  • Your avatar docs and messaging foundations are useful references the whole team pulls from - not boxes you filled in to complete a task

A Day In This Role

Morning: Check the creative tracker for your clients. What launched? What's testing? Any winners or losers from the last batch? Review any feedback or revision requests that came in overnight.

Writing blocks: The bulk of your day is writing - ad scripts, body copy, emails, funnel pages, or long-form projects like webinars or VSLs. You're working from briefs you helped shape, not briefs handed to you fully formed.

Creative strategy calls: Weekly with your pod. You come prepared with analysis: what's working, what's not, what we should iterate on, what net-new concepts are worth testing. You leave with a plan for what's needed and why.

Throughout the day:

  • Fill out creative briefs with the strategic reasoning (idea, angle, awareness level, lead type, variation) - not just the copy itself
  • Update the creative tracker with your batch details before submitting for review
  • Collaborate with your strategist on messaging direction, offer positioning, and funnel improvements
  • Coordinate with creative leads on video scripts and static direction

End of day: You can answer: What's the status of my active batches? What's winning/losing for each client? What's next and why?

Experience & Requirements

  • 3+ years of direct response copywriting experience; info/coaching space strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of awareness levels, belief shifts, and long-form persuasion structures (not just short-form social copy)
  • Experience writing across formats: ad scripts, body copy, emails, sales pages, webinars/VSLs
  • Ability to analyze creative performance and iterate intelligently - not just "try something different"
  • Strong grasp of avatar psychology and offer positioning - you understand why messaging works, not just what to write
  • Comfortable working within structured systems (creative trackers, naming conventions, brief templates)
  • Can take loose direction ("we need to test a new angle for this audience segment") and return with developed concepts backed by reasoning

What This Role Is Not

Not word-outputting. Writing without understanding the strategy behind it - the offer mechanics, the funnel purpose, the awareness level - produces generic copy. You need to understand (or figure out) the strategic context, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

Not an order-taker. Copywriters here get strategic context - and contribute to it. You should know what we're testing, why we're testing it, and bring your own ideas. "Just tell me what to write" is not how this works.

Not surface-level analysis. "This ad won" is not insight. Understanding why it won - what lead, what awareness level, what belief shift - is what lets you iterate intelligently and compound wins.

Not detached from performance. If you don't know what's winning and losing, you're writing blind. Creative trackers, performance data, creative strategy calls - they exist so you can write with intention, not hope.

Not a solo role. Creative strategy is collaborative. Strategists, media buyers, and you all contribute to what gets tested. Same goes for funnel improvements and long-form projects.

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You're energized by understanding why copy works - awareness levels, belief shifts, persuasion structures - not just writing what sounds good
  • You want to be a strategic partner, not a production resource
  • You're curious about performance data and want your work to be measured
  • You can operate with autonomy - taking loose direction and returning with developed, reasoned concepts
  • You're comfortable pushing back when briefs are unclear or strategy doesn't make sense
  • You want to master direct response as a discipline, not just collect writing samples

This May Not Be For You If

  • You prefer clear, detailed briefs that tell you exactly what to write
  • You see copywriting as creative expression rather than strategic persuasion

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Solutions Consultant, a Pre-Sales Lead, a Delivery Whisperer, Senior "Can-We-Actually-Deliver-What-We're-Selling" Person… or maybe you just call yourself Robin. Whatever you call yourself: you'll make sure the right client problem becomes the right AYBI solution, and that what gets sold is what actually gets built. Not just a good proposal. A solution the team building it can stand behind too. You'll own the outcome end to end, including the handoff between the people who sell the work and the people who build it.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000–€90,000 gross per year, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days, the option to buy up to 10 more, local public holidays, and the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team, plus occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned “Hey, well done Buddy!”, now and then.

  • Fully remote, within the Netherlands.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019, we’ve grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users’ eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

What the job looks like

  • Lead discovery and scoping for qualified opportunities: get past the feature request to the real business problem, the outcome the client wants, and the real constraints, then turn that into a solution using AYBI's data and BI platforms, including our own accelerator tools and the Microsoft data stack.

  • Own the solution behind the proposal: the approach, deliverables, assumptions, risks, team and effort. Make the call when scope, client ambition, commercial pressure and delivery reality pull in different directions. You decide when a solution is ready to sell and when architects, engineers or other specialists need to validate it first.

  • Shape the commercial case together with Sales, including the business case, the story and the pricing assumptions. Sales owns negotiation and closing; you own the credibility of what's underneath it. You'll also lead presentations, workshops and demos, explaining complex data work clearly to business and technical stakeholders.

  • Own delivery readiness before AYBI commits: make sure scope, capacity, assumptions, responsibilities and what "done" actually looks like are understood by both sides. Build a proper handover for every signed deal and stay involved through the first 30 days to catch gaps before they turn into problems.

  • Close the loop after the sale. Compare what was scoped against what the delivery team actually encountered, spot where margin or expectations slipped, and turn that into better proposals, playbooks and standards for next time.

  • Keep improving the full process, from discovery through handover, using AI where it genuinely improves speed or quality. Track proposal turnaround, win rate, scope changes after signature and handover issues during the first 30 days.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: energy, curiosity and healthy skepticism. You’ve led complex client work across consulting, solution design, pre-sales or delivery, and your ability to own the whole problem matters more than a specific number of years.

  • Data and BI understanding: you understand modern data platforms, BI solutions and cloud environments well enough to shape a credible solution, challenge assumptions and work effectively with architects and engineers.

  • Judgment across the deal: you can turn an ambiguous client question into clear outcomes, boundaries and a realistic delivery approach, while understanding how scope, price, risk and delivery effort interact. You spot missing requirements and unrealistic expectations early.

  • Communication and stakeholder leadership: you can lead a room with commercial, operational and technical stakeholders, surface disagreement early, and move the group towards a decision. You write proposals and decision documents people can act on without a follow-up meeting.

  • Ownership: you close the whole problem, including the awkward tail after signature, and you thrive without a manager directing your day. You turn recurring work into playbooks and standards that improve how the wider team operates.

  • Language: strong English. Dutch is useful, but not required.

  • Nice to have: experience in a data or BI consultancy; Microsoft Fabric, Azure or Power BI knowledge; experience with logistics, ports or industrial clients; commercial estimation or pricing experience; and experience improving pre-sales or delivery handover processes.

We’re a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

You're the bridge between what gets sold and what gets built. Own discovery, shape proposals, build real handovers, and make sure delivery never gets blindsided.

What You'll Do

Your focus is bringing segment strategy to life with operational rigor, ensuring repeatable team execution, and driving retention and portfolio growth.

What You'll Bring

You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for the work—staying motivated and forward-looking through ambiguity and difficult stretches, and bringing your team with you.

How you’ll grow

  • Build individualized career development and stretch plans tailored to senior/tenured ICs on your team.
  • Synthesize customer and team feedback to influence cross-functional partners in Product, Professional Services, and GTM leadership.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

jobs.description:
Viseven Group — міжнародна MarTech компанія, що спеціалізується на інтерактивному контенті та хмарних рішеннях для глобальних фармацевтичних компаній з 2009 року. Постійне зростання та саморозвиток закладені в нашій корпоративній ДНК. Наші унікальні розробки та підходи активно використовуються більш ніж у 50 країнах світу. Рішення Viseven представлені на великих галузевих заходах у Барселоні, Філадельфії, Лондоні тощо.
Команда, яка швидко зростає, включає понад 700+ висококваліфікованих технічних і нетехнічних експертів: front- і back-end розробників, BA фахівців та менеджерів, які створюють, локалізують і налаштовують програми у офісах по всьому світу: Житомир (Україна), Таллінн (Естонія), Познань (Польща), Нью-Делі (Індія), Бриджвотер (США).

Обов'язки:

  • Перетворювати стратегію продуктової лінійки на конкретні беклоги команди та валідувати результати спринтів для забезпечення стабільного виконання.
  • Володіти та постійно пріоритизувати беклог команди, щоб зусилля розробки фокусувалися на найцінніших завданнях, які відповідають цілям продукту.
  • Визначати цілі спринтів, брати участь у плануванні спринтів та координувати роботу з командою для забезпечення реалістичних зобов'язань.
  • Керувати змінами обсягу робіт та вхідними запитами під час спринтів, комунікувати зміни зі стейкхолдерами та відповідно коригувати плани спринтів.
  • Забезпечувати, щоб доопрацювання беклогу командою узгоджувалося зі стратегією та пріоритетами продукту, валідуючи результати.
  • Співпрацювати з Product Management та стейкхолдерами для вдосконалення функцій продукту на основі підтверджених ринкових та клієнтських інсайтів.
  • Координувати роботу бізнес-аналітиків, системних аналітиків та інших ролей на етапі дослідження (discovery), забезпечуючи чіткість та технічну реалізованість вимог.
  • Допомагати з наданням вимог команді, якщо мета та обсяг зрозумілі.
  • Планувати релізи (на рівні команди) у співпраці з Engineering Manager (PO визначає обсяг → EM координує виконання).
  • Брати участь у приймальному тестуванні функцій та демонстраціях для перевірки якості та повноти.
  • Брати участь та співкерувати ретроспективами спринтів разом з EM, ініціюючи покращення командних практик.
  • Керувати процесом виявлення ризиків та шляхами ескалації (PO визначає продуктові ризики → EM керує ризиками постачання).
  • Виступати основним експертом (SME) для внутрішніх стейкхолдерів, надаючи необхідний контекст для якісних релізів.
  • Валідувати проєктні плани та документацію для стейкхолдерів за потреби (у співпраці з DM).
  • Встановлювати та підтримувати співпрацю з веб-департаментом та іншими командами, коли потрібна крос-продуктова робота.
  • Координувати крос-командні епіки та забезпечувати узгодженість щодо спільного функціоналу.
  • Працювати з інструментом Estimator, отримувати погодження та підтримувати процес оцінювання (EM оцінює → PO/DM погоджує).
  • Співпрацювати з QA для класифікації проблем (інцидент чи покращення) та пріоритизувати баги в Product Backlog на основі впливу на бізнес.

Вимоги:

  • 3+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Manager або на подібних ролях
  • 2+ роки досвіду у сфері Pharma, Life Sciences або фармацевтичного маркетингу (в IT/tech середовищі) — процеси та системи ланцюга постачання контенту (створення контенту, MLR, CRM, Veeva, AEM, SFDC)
  • Підтверджений успішний досвід визначення та запуску продуктів, що відповідають бізнес-цілям
  • Досвід роботи з продуктами на основі AI/ML, включно з розумінням життєвого циклу моделей, метрик оцінювання та обмежень, таких як упередженість (bias) та галюцинації
  • Впевнене володіння Jira, Confluence та методологіями Agile/Scrum
  • Досвід написання user stories, критеріїв приймання (acceptance criteria) та технічних специфікацій
  • Знання технік оцінювання (story points, T-shirt sizing)
  • Рівень англійської мови — Upper-Intermediate або вище

Що ми пропонуємо?

Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм баченням, втілювати власні ідеї, зростати у професійному середовищі, зберігаючи баланс між роботою та особистим життям.
Приєднавшись до Viseven, ви отримаєте:
· Конкурентоспроможну винагороду та регулярний перегляд заробітної плати
· Професійне та кар'єрне зростання
· Оплачувану відпустку - 18 робочих днів на рік (20 робочих днів після 2 років співпраці)
· Лікарняний без підтверджуючих документів - 4 робочих дні на рік
· Документально оформлений лікарняний - 20 робочих днів на рік
· Відпустку по сімейних обставинах - 3 оплачуваних робочих дні (у разі одруження, народження дитини або тяжкої втрати)
· Комплексне медичне страхування (включаючи курс масажів та фізіопроцедур)
· Курси вивчення англійської мови
· Можливість участі в професійних форумах і конференціях
· Регулярні корпоративні заходи та тімбілдінги
· Досвідчену команду та дружню атмосферу
· Приємне робоче середовище: комфортний, повністю обладнаний офіс та можливість працювати вдома
