jobs.description:
💻 Kodland Hakkında

Kodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara kodlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.

  • 50.000+ aktif öğrenci — Türkiye'de 5.500+

  • 3.000+ takım arkadaşı — Türkiye ekibinde 300+

  • 9 farklı pazar: Türkiye, Doğu Avrupa, BDT Ülkeleri, Latin Amerika, Brezilya, Endonezya, Körfez Ülkeleri, UK/US

Türkiye ekibimize katılacak, mevcut ve geçmiş Kodland ailelerine telefon ve WhatsApp üzerinden ulaşacak İç Satış Yöneticileri (ISM) arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyon bir ders anlatma rolü değildir. Danışmanlık yaklaşımıyla yürütülen, portföy yönetimi ve sonuç odaklı satışın birleştiği tam zamanlı bir satış rolüdür.

🎯 Bu rolde ne yapacaksın?

Sana atanan aile portföyünü telefon, WhatsApp ve diğer kanallar üzerinden yöneteceksin.

Gün boyunca:

  • Kodland'da halihazırda ders almış ya da almakta olan ailelerle iletişim kuracak,

  • Çocuğun mevcut ilerlemesini ve ailenin beklentilerini anlayacak,

  • Kurs yenileme, paket yükseltme ve ek kurs satışlarını yöneteceksin,

  • Velilerin sorularını yanıtlayacak, itirazları profesyonel şekilde karşılayacaksın,

  • Fiyatlandırmayı netleştirecek, ödeme adımını ve tahsilat takibini sonuçlandıracaksın,

  • Portföyündeki her ailenin durumunu ve bir sonraki adımını CRM üzerinde güncel tutacak,

  • Her temastan sonra sisteme not bırakacaksın,

  • Aylık ciro ve dönüşüm hedeflerini takip edeceksin.

Kendi müşterini bulman beklenmez. Lead'ler sistem üzerinden ekibe düzenli olarak dağıtılır. Konuşma metinleri, itiraz karşılama rehberleri, fiyat hesaplayıcı ve ekip desteği sağlanır.

Senden beklenen; görüşmeyi aktif şekilde yönetmen, ailenin ihtiyacını doğru okuman, Kodland programlarının değerini net şekilde göstermen ve satış fırsatlarını sonuca ulaştırmandır.

Günlük hedefler: ortalama 50 arama ve 90 dakika aktif konuşma süresi. Tüm satış süreci tek bir panelden yönetilir; düzenli ve şeffaftır.

🕒 Çalışma Modeli — Gününü Sen Planlarsın

  • Tamamen uzaktan, freelance çalışma modeli — nerede olursan ol

  • Haftada 5 gün, günde 8 saat (1 saatlik molan dahil), haftada 2 gün tatil

  • Esnek başlangıç: güne 11.00–13.00 arasında dilediğin saatte başlarsın

  • Yoğun saatler: 18.00–21.00 — velilere en kolay bu saatlerde ulaşılır

  • Mola sende: 1 saatlik molanı gün içinde istediğin zaman kullanırsın

  • Erken bitirme hakkı: günlük KPI hedeflerini tamamladığında mesaini erken bitirebilirsin

💰 Kazanç Modeli

Kazancın iki parçadan oluşur:

  • 14.000 ₺ sabit maaş — performansından bağımsız, her ay garanti

  • Satış primi — belirli bir aylık satış tutarını geçtiğinde devreye girer ve satışın büyüdükçe oranı da artar

Buna ek olarak yüksek satış tutarlarında ek bonuslar ve her ay ilk 3 ISM'e verilen ödüller var.

Peki bu pratikte ne demek?

Ekibimizdeki ISM'ler genellikle aylık 25.000 – 50.000 ₺ kazanıyor. Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış yapanlar 80.000 ₺ ve üzerine ulaşabiliyor.

Prim oranlarını ve eşikleri, ekibimizin gerçek verileriyle birlikte mülakat aşamasında adım adım anlatıyoruz.

Belirtilen tutarlar garanti gelir değil, mevcut ekip performansına dayalı gerçek kazanç aralıklarıdır.

🧭 Eğitim ve İşe Alım Süreci

Başarılı adaylar gerçek ailelerle çalışmaya başlamadan önce yapılandırılmış bir eğitim ve değerlendirme sürecinden geçer:

  1. Başvurunun değerlendirilmesi

  2. Kısa ön değerlendirme görüşmesi

  3. Eğitim grubuna katılım — şirket, ürün, sistemler, satış temelleri ve itiraz karşılama üzerine teorik eğitim (yaklaşık 3–5 iş günü)

  4. Final değerlendirme — arama simülasyonu / rol-play ve kısa bilgi testi

  5. Canlı lead'lerle pratik dönem (ekip lideri geri bildirimi eşliğinde)

  6. Sözleşme, sistem erişimleri ve deneme süresi

🚀 Kodland Sana Ne Sunuyor?

  • Tamamen uzaktan çalışma ve esnek başlangıç saati

  • Garantili sabit maaş + performansa bağlı satış primi ve bonuslar

  • Hazır satış materyalleri: konuşma metinleri, itiraz karşılama rehberleri, fiyat hesaplayıcı

  • Tek panelden yönetilen, şeffaf bir CRM düzeni

  • Kapsamlı eğitim ve adaptasyon süreci

  • Team Leader, Head ve kalite ekibinden düzenli geri bildirim

  • 9 pazarda faaliyet gösteren uluslararası bir EdTech şirketinde deneyim

  • Satış, müzakere ve müşteri ilişkileri alanında gelişim fırsatı

  • Çocukların gelecekte kullanacağı beceriler kazanmasına katkı sağlayan anlamlı bir ürün

Requirements

✅ Zorunlu Gereksinimler

  • Türkiye'de ikamet

  • En az 6 ay satış deneyimi — telefonla satış, iç satış, retention, upsell, account management veya satış bileşeni olan müşteri hizmetleri

  • Türkçeyi akıcı, net ve güven veren şekilde kullanabilme; anlaşılır diksiyon

  • Telefon ve video görüşmelerinde kendinden emin sözlü iletişim

  • İtiraz karşılama ve fiyat görüşmesi konusunda rahat olma

  • CRM veya benzeri bir portföy/takip sistemi kullanma deneyimi

  • Yüzde, oran ve basit hesaplamalarla rahat çalışabilme

  • Günde ortalama 50 arama ve 90 dakika aktif konuşma temposuyla çalışmaya açık olma

  • Hedef ve KPI odaklı çalışabilme; reddedilmeye karşı dayanıklılık

  • Haftada 5 gün, günde 8 saat düzenli uygunluk; 18.00–21.00 yoğun saat aralığında aktif olabilme

  • Freelance çalışma modelinin sana uygun olması

  • Bu rolü ana çalışma düzeni olarak sürdürebilme

  • Uzaktan çalışma düzeninde zamanını disiplinli şekilde yönetebilme

Teknik gereksinimler:

  • En az 8 GB RAM'e sahip, güvenilir bir bilgisayar

  • Kaliteli mikrofon (tercihen kulaklık) ve çalışır durumda kamera

  • Stabil ve hızlı internet bağlantısı

  • Sessiz ve profesyonel bir çalışma ortamı

🌟 Avantaj Sağlayacak Deneyimler

  • EdTech, SaaS, telekomünikasyon, sigorta, turizm/konaklama veya B2C danışmanlı satış

  • Çağrı merkezi veya telesatış

  • Retention, yenileme ya da upsell odaklı roller

  • HubSpot, Salesforce, Bitrix24, amoCRM gibi CRM sistemleri

  • Eğitim sektörü ya da velilerle birebir iletişim deneyimi

  • İngilizce (global ekip iletişimi ve dokümantasyon için)

Bu deneyimlere sahip olman zorunlu değildir. Güçlü iletişim becerilerine, satış motivasyonuna ve öğrenme isteğine sahip adaylar da değerlendirilir.

🎯 Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olabilir, Eğer:

  • Telefonda konuşmayı ve insanların ihtiyacını anlamayı seviyorsan,

  • Kazancının performansına bağlı olması seni motive ediyorsa,

  • İtirazların satış sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu biliyorsan,

  • Düzenli takibin sonuç getirdiğinin farkındaysan,

  • Kendi portföyünü düzenli ve güncel tutmaktan keyif alıyorsan,

  • Gününü kendi ritmine göre kurgulayabileceğin bir esnekliği değerli buluyorsan,

  • Geri bildirime ve kalite değerlendirmesine açıksan.

⚠️ Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olmayabilir, Eğer:

  • Günde yüksek sayıda telefon görüşmesi yapmak istemiyorsan,

  • Akşam saatlerinde (18.00–21.00) çalışmak sana uygun değilse,

As collaborative creatives, we take untold pride in our work, designing with heart and soul. We are an agile and growing business, and we work hard to create an environment which allows for growth and progression, balanced with the support and flexibility needed to meet the challenge of a high-performance culture.

About Guideway Care*

Guideway Care is The Patient Activation Company™. We don't just "engage" patients; we activate them. By utilizing our proprietary Motivational Patient Guidance (MPG) model and AI-powered technology, we resolve the practical and psychological barriers that prevent patients from taking their "next right action."™

Job Summary:

The Clinical Service Lead (CSL) is a non-exempt, front-line operational leadership role responsible for the day-to-day execution of Guideway Care clinical service. This role is designed as a working operational lead accountable for service delivery, workflow stability, and partner-facing operational coordination. The CSL does not function as a people manager and does not hold formal performance management or disciplinary authority.

The Clinical Service Lead plays a critical role in ensuring high-quality, efficient, and compliant clinical service delivery across assigned operational lanes. The role focuses on managing work rather than managing employees, serving as a key execution partner to leadership while remainingclosely connected to frontline workflows.

Essential Functions:

  • Own day-to-day execution of assigned clinical service workflows, ensuring service-level agreements, quality standards, and operational deliverables are met

Contract, per-project basis.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Marketing Coordinator

About SkinnyDipped

Located in Seattle, SkinnyDipped was founded by a mom, her daughter, and two best friends after realizing that nothing is more important than time spent with the ones you love. Starting out of their kitchen, the four women created SkinnyDipped: thinly dipped chocolate almonds that are exceptionally good-for-you and ridiculously delicious. We are a women-led company driven by the belief that healthy snacking should make both you and your body happy.

The Opportunity

We’re on the hunt for an enthusiastic, roll-up-your-sleeves Marketing Coordinator to support our lean, mighty, and fast-moving marketing team. This is the ultimate ‘get-your-hands-dirty’ role for someone eager to grow their career in marketing.

You’ll be at the center of the action - supporting events, coordinating major trade shows, sourcing and managing vendors, ordering merch, and everything in between. One day you might be coordinating a demo tour, and the next you’re helping prep for a major partnership or activation. If you’re excited by the idea of learning a little bit of everything, jumping into a high-growth entrepreneurial brand, and working with a passionate team, we want to talk to you!

What You’ll Do

    Be the Right Hand of the Marketing Team

    • Plan, coordinate, and execute trade shows - including budgeting, booth logistics, timeline management, and on-site support from setup to takedown.
    • Manage the logistics and scheduling for retailer demos and sampling events across the country.
    • Support brand activations, influencer events, and partnerships - coordinating timelines, sourcing furniture, branded materials etc.. working with vendors and ensuring seamless on-site execution.
    • Manage and train a team of Brand Ambassadors on an as-needed basis
    • Coordinating influencer mailers including everything from managing vendors and working with operations on shipment details through to coordinating timelines for branded collateral and list management.
    • Keep our merch machine running by managing inventory and coordinating orders
    • Handle day-to-day marketing operations, from placing print orders to fulfilling sampling requests and shipping boxes.
    • Act as a liaison with vendors and agencies, helping to keep projects on track and communication flowing.
    • Coordinate with our Creative Director to ensure design needs and marketing orders are executed without a hitch.
    • Manage coupon setup and support retail launches by collaborating with our Sales and Customer Service teams.
    • Assist with website updates and maintenance, like homepage swaps and campaign page builds.
    • Assist with content syndication across retailer sites
    • Set up email and SMS campaigns, as needed
    • Provide occasional customer service backup when needed.
    • This role offers a front-row seat to a wide range of marketing initiatives, and we’ll support you in diving deeper into the areas that spark your interest

What You Bring to the Table

    Skills & Strengths

    • A self-starter with a can-do attitude. You’re energized by crossing things off your list and diving into whatever’s needed.
    • Stellar communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
    • Obsessed with the details - logistics, timelines, and task-tracking are your thing.
    • Willing to go the extra mile and pitch in wherever needed to make things happen.
    • Adaptable and unfazed by changing plans or moving targets.
    • Proactive in thinking ahead to what comes next to avoid last minute fire-drills.
    • Confident in owning relationships with outside partners/vendors and taking initiative by bringing recommendations to the team for sign off.

      • Experience & Education

      • 2+ years of relevant experience in marketing, ideally in CPG, brand, or events.
      • Hands-on experience planning or supporting trade shows, brand events, or demos = major plus.
      • BA required, Marketing or related field preferred.

        • Must-Haves

        • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.
        • Ability to travel occasionally for events.
        • Willingness to lift and move boxes (up to 50 lbs) as needed.
        • Some weekend and evening work required during events.

          • A Few More Things We Value

          • You’re hungry to learn and love being a team player.
          • You like pitching in wherever needed and you’re not scared of grunt work.
          • You’re passionate about snacks, storytelling, and growing a brand.
          • You bring a great attitude and energy to the team.

Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary
    • Annual performance bonus
    • Equity opportunity
    • Excellent medical/dental/vision benefits
    • 401(k)
    • 3 weeks paid vacation + 14 paid holidays
    • Paid parental leave
    • Paid time off to volunteer
    • Additional perks like wellness & tech stipends
    • Fun, entrepreneurial culture

A Bit More About Us

We’re a female-founded success story. This alone—regardless of the industry—requires true grit, mettle, and perseverance. We operate with an ethos that any idea is plausible until proven otherwise. A bold flavor combo with a totally new production method? Let’s try it. A major change to improve quality, even if it’s hard? We’ll make it happen. We lead with conviction, not hesitation. The world can be intimidating, but we stay curious, driven, and brave.

Our Mission

We craft ethical food that makes you and your body happy. We believe everyone deserves to eat the kind of nutritious, clean, delicious food we’re fortunate enough to share with our own families and friends. We work to raise up and support women and the children they care for in both our local communities and around the globe because no child should go without food or an education.

DigitalOrganizing Manager (Remote)

THE ROLE:

NextGen America is currently seeking a creative, self-starting Distributed Organizing Manager to join our Distributed Organizing team. The distributed organizing team will work to build and grow strong digital communities to help engage with young voters, expand ballot access, and elect progressives up and down the ballot. We are looking for organizers to spread the #YouthVote across digital networks, recruit folks online into strong volunteer networks, and lead volunteer teams in direct voter contact using peer-to-peer (P2P) texting in Scale to Win Text and other distributed tools.

The ideal candidate has a passion for politics and a belief that young people will make the difference in America’s future. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage people of diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value and are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion as an organization--in theory and in practice--and our culture reflects that value and commitment. We are committed to furthering issues like climate change, health care, and economic and racial justice from a progressive perspective, we seek to engage the public in these areas as well as others. We also recognize the urgency of confronting institutional racism and inequity within our political system and strive to make positive changes within our system as a result.

This role will report to the Distributed Organizing Director.

This is a fully remote position with no location requirement. We encourage candidates from all locations within the United States to apply.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Remote Position: Yes

Union Position: No

Travel Requirements: Less than 10%

End Date: 11/6/26

WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE:

  • Execute a values-driven and data-informed distributed organizing program with a team that will recruit, train, and organize remote volunteers to hit voter contact and mobilization goals in key 2026races and states.
  • Run regular P2P campaigns including data requests, script and campaign drafting, QA process, campaign launch, and debrief and clean up.
  • Draft and edit training guides, memos, templates, and toolkits to support volunteers’ direct voter contact over email, phone, text, Slack, and other platforms.
  • Lead trainings or workshops and coach our volunteers before, during, or after their shifts
  • Pull regular data metrics and write regular progress qualitative and quantitative reports on the impact of direct voter contact.
  • Recruit, train, and engage a team of volunteer leaders.
  • Be a digital community manager and administrator.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

ABOUT YOU:

Job Title: Customer Success Manager

We are seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager to own and drive the success of our customers using

our SaaS products. This role emphasizes customer satisfaction, product adoption, feature enablement, proactive

customer health management, SLA and SOP adherence and identification of opportunities to continuously improve

the customer experience. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, commercially aware and customer-centric

professional who can build strong customer relationships, anticipate customer needs, coordinate effectively with

internal teams and identify and close paid Change Request (CR) and expansion opportunities.

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Relationship and Success Management:

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, build trusted long-term relationships, understand

customer objectives and challenges, conduct regular customer touchpoints and business reviews, own

customer success plans and proactively identify and mitigate customer risks.

• Product Adoption and Usage Monitoring:

Measure and monitor product and feature adoption, identify underutilized capabilities or declining usage,

establish adoption metrics and work with customers to increase usage and demonstrate greater business value

from the product.

  • Feature Enablement and Continuous Improvement:

Stay aligned with product releases and proactively identify new features relevant to each customer. Drive

feature enablement through release communication, demonstrations, walkthroughs and customer engagement

so customers continuously benefit from new product capabilities and improvements.

  • Customer Health and System Health Monitoring:

Maintain customer health indicators covering adoption, support trends, SLA performance, system health,

customer sentiment and engagement. Conduct periodic system health checks, identify potential risks or

recurring issues and provide proactive updates and recommendations to customers.

• SLA and Service Delivery Management:

Monitor adherence to agreed SLAs, proactively identify potential breaches or service-level concerns,

coordinate with Support and Engineering teams and ensure customers receive timely and meaningful updates

on incidents, resolution plans and expected timelines.

Understand and maintain customer-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance processes

and agreed ways of working. Ensure agreed SOPs are executed consistently, monitor adherence, identify

deviations and coordinate updates when business processes or product capabilities change.

• Change Request and Revenue Generation:

Proactively identify paid Change Request (CR), enhancement and expansion opportunities. Work with

Product, Implementation and Commercial teams to qualify and scope opportunities, engage customers on

business value and commercial implications and actively pursue identified opportunities through proposal,

negotiation and closure.

and roadmap discussions.

Collaborate closely with Product, Product Support, Engineering, Implementation, Sales and Commercial

teams to deliver a seamless customer experience. Drive clear ownership, timelines and communication for

cross-functional customer activities and escalations.

Proactively identify churn risks and develop mitigation plans. Monitor customer satisfaction and engagement,

build strong stakeholder relationships and identify opportunities to turn satisfied customers into product

advocates, references and expansion opportunities.

  • Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement:

Maintain comprehensive customer documentation covering configurations, processes, contacts,

dependencies, SOPs, risks and key decisions. Contribute to knowledge bases and customer collateral and

continuously improve customer success processes based on feedback, data and operational learnings.

and follow-ups

o Commercial awareness and ability to identify and pursue revenue opportunities

You will work cross-functionally with leaders from Finance, Operations, Technology, and Legal and Compliance to assess risks, evaluate the company’s control environment, and deliver actionable insights that support strategic objectives.

In this role, you will contribute to building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement by translating audit objectives into meaningful business enhancements, identifying improvement opportunities, and helping to ensure the company is well-positioned to scale responsibly and meet regulatory expectations. The ideal candidate will combine strong auditing fundamentals with a growing understanding of digital platforms, online transactions, and gaming operations.

  • Assist in performing periodic risk assessments and evaluating the design and adequacy of the company’s risk and control framework.

  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to ensure internal audit efforts align with regulatory and licensing requirements across relevant jurisdictions.

  • Solid foundation in internal audit practices, risk assessments, control testing, and reporting.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize risk, focus on impact, and deliver value through audit execution.

jobs.description:
Science Buzz is a pre-launch blog that's focused on making research in the physical sciences accessible to a general audience.

We're looking for contributors with subject matter expertise in Earth Science, Biology, Physics, Astronomy, and Chemistry (and their sub-disciplines) to produce high-quality posts on recent discoveries/research, as well as guides and outlining content for infographics.

About you:

  • You're an expert in some scientific domain. That doesn't necessarily mean you have a Ph.D. or have worked in the field professionally; we're happy to hire passionate amateurs. It does mean that you're familiar with the leading academic journals in the subject and have the background knowledge to understand the significance of new research.
    * You can write clearly about complex topics. This means you know the Jargon of the field, but can communicate what is essential without relying on it.
    * You understand the elements of producing viral content and aren't averse to formulas when they work (e.g., listicles).

Pros of working with us:

  • Get paid to learn and write about something you're genuinely interested in
    * All work published under your byline
    * Flexibility: we rarely have strict deadlines and are happy to work with people who aren't able to contribute regularly.

What we look for:

  • Typical article length of 800 - 2,000 words. We're open to longer pieces but will typically solicit them from contributors who we've worked with previously.
    * Coverage of a topic that hasn't been widely reported on other blogs or in the press.
    * We want to cover research that has been published in the last year, though this is not a hard rule.
    * Relevance: our goal is to make science engaging, the primary way to do that is by illustrating how it connects to the lives of our readers.

* A sense of humor or whimsy.

Rates: Our starting rate is $150 per published article. Ideally, we would like contributors who can write several articles per week but are open to working with talented writers who as well.

Note: Because of the volume of applications we receive, we aren't able to personally follow up with everyone, but we will be in touch within 48 hours if it seems like there's a good potential match.

If you have a specific story idea you would like to pitch: please include the working title, subject, and potential sources. While we will need to see a full draft before committing to publish a piece, you can pitch an idea get our impression of whether it's a fit for us.

1. About PATeam Software Consulting

PATeam Software Consulting Ltd. delivers custom software product POS (ModusTech) and process-automation solutions for clients across the United States, the United Kingdom and Europe. Our delivery model is engagement-led: small, accountable teams work directly with client stakeholders from discovery through to go-live and hypercare, under a Project Management Office that holds the schedule, quality and governance line.

We are strengthening our engineering leadership bench and are looking for a Technical Lead who can own the technical outcome of a React and .NET engagement end to end inclusive of writing code, guiding a team, and standing confidently in front of the client.

2. Role Purpose

The Technical Lead is accountable for the technical quality and on-time delivery of assigned React and .NET projects. This is a hands-on leadership role: roughly half the week is spent on design, code and review, and the remainder on guiding the team, planning sprints, managing dependencies and communicating with client stakeholders.

Success in this role means predictable delivery. Commitments made at sprint planning are met, risks are raised early rather than explained late, the codebase remains maintainable as the team scales, and the client regards you as the technical authority on the engagement.

3. Key Responsibilities

3.1 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering

Own the solution architecture for assigned projects across the front end (React) and back end (.NET), including component structure, API contracts, data models, authentication and integration patterns.
Contribute production code for the most complex or highest-risk parts of the solution, and set the standard the rest of the team follows.
Run code review as a quality gate — enforce coding standards, review pull requests within agreed turnaround times, and coach through review comments rather than simply rejecting work.
Make and document technical decisions with the trade-offs stated, so that choices can be revisited later without re-litigating them from scratch.
Own non-functional quality — performance, security, accessibility, scalability and maintainability are treated as delivery requirements, not afterthoughts.
Manage technical debt deliberately by maintaining a visible register and negotiating remediation into the sprint plan.

3.2 Agile delivery and schedule control

Lead sprint planning, estimation and backlog refinement with the Product Owner and Project Manager, and hold the team to realistic, defensible commitments.
Break down requirements into stories and technical tasks with clear acceptance criteria and identified dependencies.
Protect the delivery date — track sprint burndown daily, identify slippage the day it appears, and propose concrete recovery options (scope, sequence or capacity) rather than escalating without a plan.
Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives where the Scrum Master role is not separately staffed, and act on retrospective outcomes.
Maintain accurate delivery status for PMO reporting, including RAG status, milestone confidence, risks, issues and change requests.
Manage release readiness — go-live checklists, cutover planning, rollback provisions and hypercare support arrangements.

3.3 Team leadership and development

Conduct performance conversations and contribute to appraisals, development plans and capability assessments in partnership with the reporting manager.
Reduce single points of knowledge by insisting on documentation and deliberate cross-skilling within the team.
Support recruitment through technical screening and interview panels.

3.4 Client engagement and stakeholder management

Act as the technical point of contact for US and other international clients, translating technical positions into business language and business needs into technical requirements.
Run technical discussions and demonstrations with client architects, product owners and executive sponsors, and present options with a clear recommendation.
Manage scope conversations professionally - recognise change when it arrives, quantify its schedule and effort impact, and route it through the agreed change-control process.
Communicate proactively across time zones so that a client starting their day has the update they need without having to ask for it.
Build client confidence by being candid about risk and consistent in follow-through.

3.5 Governance, quality and process

Comply with PMO governance including project documentation, stage gates, sign-offs, time recording and audit evidence.
Own the test strategy for the engagement across unit, integration, end-to-end and UAT layers, in partnership with QA.
Maintain CI/CD discipline — automated builds, quality gates, environment management and repeatable, low-drama deployments.
Contribute to continuous improvement by feeding lessons learned and reusable assets back into organisational practice.

4. Essential Skills and Experience

Candidates must be able to evidence all of the following.

4.1 Experience

Minimum five years of professional software delivery experience with React and the .NET stack, including at least two years in a technical lead, lead developer or equivalent leadership capacity.
Demonstrable record of leading a delivery team to release on a committed schedule, ideally across multiple projects or engagements.
Hands-on experience working directly with international clients, with the United States preferred, in a consulting, outsourced or product-engineering setting.
Experience delivering within Agile frameworks (Scrum or Kanban) throughout the full lifecycle — requirements, design, build, test, release and post-go-live support.

4.2 Front-end technical skills

Strong command of React, including hooks, component composition, state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query or equivalent) and performance optimisation.
Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with modern tooling and build pipelines.
Competence in HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design, and familiarity with a component library or design system.
Front-end testing practice using Jest, React Testing Library or comparable tooling.

4.3 Back-end and platform skills

Strong command of C# and .NET (.NET 6 or later, and ASP.NET Core), including RESTful API design and layered or clean architecture patterns.
Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM, plus SQL Server or an equivalent relational database, including query performance tuning.
Practical experience with cloud services — Azure preferred, AWS acceptable — covering application hosting, identity, storage and messaging.
Version control with Git and branching strategies suited to team delivery, plus CI/CD pipeline configuration (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or equivalent).
Sound grasp of application security fundamentals, including authentication and authorisation patterns such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and JWT.

4.4 Leadership and delivery competencies

Ability to lead by influence as well as authority, and to hold a team to standards without damaging morale.
Disciplined approach to estimation, dependency management and schedule control under fixed-date pressure.
Clear written and spoken English, sufficient to hold an unscripted technical conversation with a senior client stakeholder.
Sound judgement on when to decide, when to consult and when to escalate.

4.5 Working arrangement

Willingness and availability to work United States hours on a sustained basis, including participation in client ceremonies scheduled in US time zones.
A reliable remote working setup, including stable high-speed connectivity and a quiet environment suitable for client calls.

5. Desirable Skills and Experience

Microservices, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) or event-driven architecture in production.
Exposure to process automation or RPA platforms, or to integration-heavy enterprise environments.
Certification in Azure (for example AZ-204 or AZ-305), Scrum (PSM or CSM) or SAFe.

Presales or solution-estimation experience, such as contributing to proposals or technical responses.

6. Behavioural Expectations

About the Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Email is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Email & Lifecycle Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work—building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume program of 40+ campaigns per week plus automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization, and Partner Performance

  • Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
  • Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
  • Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
  • Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
  • Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

  • Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns—from planning through send and post-send analysis.
  • Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
  • Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
  • Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
  • Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets—IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops—monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
  • Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

  • Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
  • Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
  • Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys—activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back—to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
  • Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub’s own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team, and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle—including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation—and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
  • Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
  • Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
  • Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
  • Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

  • 9+ years of hands-on email, CRM, or lifecycle marketing in a high-volume program, including monetizing a newsletter or email audience through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance, and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
  • Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack—our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics—across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
  • Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
  • Strong command of segmentation, personalization, automation workflows, triggered campaigns, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives—with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—Preferred

  • Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, or media/ad-monetization company (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar).
  • Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape.
  • Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Benefits include:

  • 100% employer-paid life insurance

  • Generous paid time off (PTO)

BenefitHub is the premier employee lifestyle benefits platform, connecting millions of employees with exclusive discounts, rewards, and perks. Our mission is to enhance the lives of employees worldwide while helping organizations attract, retain, and engage top talent through meaningful benefits.

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. Our mission is to automate everything a property manager does.

About the role

Our platform has been an agentic platform since day one. Before we even planned the UI, we planned the way agents would interact with the software. Remember – our goal is to automate the entire industry and we mean it.

As of now, almost everything the user can do in the UI, we have an agent tool for it and the Co-Pilot (daily assistant of the user) can do everything for them, even toggling dark mode on and off.

But the Co-Pilot is just the beginning. The real challenge is the autonomous agents. More on that below.

What you’ll be working on

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonomous Agents triggered whenever something new happens inside a ticket. The customer can train them on their own OR rather use one of the templates you will build for them. These agents already have the capabilities to fully own entire complex scenarios and are one of the main reasons customers are interested in our software. But when should the agent escalate to a human rather than finishing on its own? How can we make sure it sticks to the process? Those are your questions.

  • Harness Engineering: The agent has 100+ tools. But it has to read a request the way a property manager would, not the way the words sound elsewhere. What goes into the system prompt, what into skills?

  • Knowledge base: Our platform includes its own knowledge base, similar to Notion. It’s fully custom built and supposed to act as the companys collective brain. But should the AI also “learn” by itself? And if yes, when? And how can we improve the way our AI searches the knowledge base — through better tools, system prompts, or skills?

  • Voice-agents: The same agents, but on the phone — built on LiveKit, handling calls the way our text agents handle tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Pick the right model for the job, cache and stream to cut latency, retry when a provider fails, compact context, optimize RAG search, track usage across providers, reduce costs and run evals to see what's actually better.

Our minimalistic tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Technologies you will encounter: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

You are:

  • fluent in English.

  • a seasoned developer with more than 2 years of experience building production agents

  • AI-native in production. You've shipped agentic features real users rely on, and you have opinions on retrieval, evals, tool design, and where today's frontier models break down.

  • a builder first. You'd rather ship a rough v1 today than spend three weeks planning the perfect one.

  • up to date with new AI models & the research.

  • comfortable working autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks.

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

The Early Careers TA Specialist leads the operational delivery of Moniepoint's structured early-talent ecosystem, spanning university partnerships, campus hackathons, structured internships, and graduate conversions.

In this role, you'll partner closely with the Senior TA Strategy & Enablement Manager to turn strategic vision into high-impact, repeatable programmes.   • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, or fast-paced corporate environments.
  • Familiarity with funnel analytics, spreadsheet reporting, or presentation design for leadership reviews.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption, C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.title: Attorney, Center for the American Future
jobs.excerpt: The Texas Public Policy Foundation’s Center for the American Future is seeking to hire an attorney—who may work fully remote or at our Austin, Texas, headquarters—with at least five (5) years of litigation experience to join our growing team as we litigate against government overreach.
jobs.description:
The Texas Public Policy Foundation’s Center for the American Future is seeking to hire an attorney—who may work fully remote or at our Austin, Texas, headquarters—with at least five (5) years of litigation experience to join our growing team as we litigate against government overreach. The idea candidate will be ready to hit the ground running and excited about defending individual liberty, enforcing constitutional limits on the government, and promoting a vision of America where individuals are free to flourish. He or she will immediately become an important part of a close-knit legal team of approximately eight (8) attorneys, as well as the larger TPPF organization.

About TPPF:

The Texas Public Policy Foundation (TPPF) is a 501(c)3 nonprofit research-based think tank in Austin, Texas. Established in 1989, TPPF promotes conservative principles and develops free-market approaches to public policy challenges affecting Texans and all Americans. To achieve its mission, TPPF analyzes complex issues, creates legislative policy solutions, and advocates for those solutions at the Texas Legislature, Congress, and other public forums.

Life at TPPF:

The Foundation offers a unique opportunity to be part of an organization that shapes the future of Texas & beyond through innovative thought leadership. At TPPF, you will have the opportunity to be part of an engaged team whose mission is to create a freer future for all Texans and Americans. We look for individuals who are passionate about advancing conservative public policy and embody servant leadership. With a strong belief in personal responsibility, we trust our people and want to empower them to make the right decisions for the right reasons - this is why it is crucial we bring the right people on board. We value our team and work to cultivate a culture of hard work, entrepreneurship, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration. As a team, we support one another and strive to create an environment in which our team members are inspired to excel, motivated to innovate, and empowered to be servant leaders for the cause of liberty.

The Role:

Description:

The Texas Public Policy Foundation is seeking an aggressive and innovative litigator with experience in the federal judiciary as an Attorney for the Center for the American Future. The qualified applicant will possess a strong love of liberty as the foundational purpose of government, an enthusiasm for Texas as the keystone of the American Dream, and an eagerness to challenge precedent and convention within the legal sphere in the defense of both.

The Center for the American Future defends the Constitution through legal opposition to government overreach. The Center launches legal challenges at the administrative, district, and appellate court levels on behalf of ordinary people whose lives, liberty, and property are threatened by government action in defiance of the Constitution.

This position can work in our Austin, Texas headquarters, or fully remote with the understanding that a moderate amount of travel will be required.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

This candidate will report to the Center’s Director and be called upon to execute the Foundation’s legal work plan as part of a two-person team that is managed by one of our Senior Attorneys. This includes building a robust docket and advancing the Foundation’s strategic priorities. The Attorney will be an active participant in complex litigation, including the discovery process, briefs, trials, appellate work, and amicus briefing.

Qualifications:

The Attorney for the Center for the American Future must be a “happy warrior” with a keen drive to blaze new pathways in the fight to reclaim territory from Washington, D.C. He or she must have the following qualities:

  • A self-starter. The Attorney must be willing and able to conceive and develop innovative ideas independently and often -- and bring them to fruition.

  • A polished legal writer. This Attorney must possess the aptitude for graceful prose that conveys complicated concepts convincingly.

  • A strategic thinker. Specifically, the Attorney must be a strategic legal thinker, with a Juris Doctorate, able to grasp Constitutional law sufficient for handling complex litigation matters and authoring amicus briefs that advance the strategic vision of the Foundation.

  • An advocate. The Attorney must bring to a table litigation experience in trial and appellate courts, administrative law, policymaking, legislation, and/or media -- and a proven record of accomplishment.

  • A leader. The Attorney must be willing to work with tact and persuasion to assist in assembling a coalition of activists, thinkers, and citizens in several states to challenge Washington, D.C., overreach on several fronts.

  • Optimistic and good-humored. The Center for the American Future highly values its “happy warrior” ethos. This work is not for the faint of heart. An optimistic, positive approach to challenges—as well as the ability to take one’s work seriously without taking oneself too seriously—is critical.

  • Applicants must be licensed to practice law in the United States.

The position’s salary will be commensurate with the experience, expertise, and skills of the Attorney who takes the position.

Benefits at TPPF:

TPPF values our team members and strives to provide a comprehensive benefits package so that our people can focus on achieving the mission. We offer competitive salaries and excellent health insurance, for staff & dependents. In addition, we have generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policies, including holidays and parental leave, and retirement contribution matching.

jobs.excerpt: Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenlandBen jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ?
jobs.description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland

Ben jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Heb je al minimaal twee jaar vlieguren gemaakt binnen de SGGZ en wil je jouw expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving?

Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.

Wij zoeken proactieve basispsychologen die online behandelen serieus nemen. Professionals die digitaal vaardig zijn, stevig in hun rol staan en ook op afstand een sterke behandelrelatie kunnen opbouwen.

Over Beterggz

Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.

Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters en andere betrokken professionals. We werken digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief goede GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.

Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je zit. Of je nu vanuit Nederland werkt of vanuit het buitenland, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit op orde zijn.

Requirements

Wat ga je doen?

Als online basispsycholoog behandel je cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ. Je voert online behandelgesprekken, doet psychodiagnostiek, stelt samen met collega’s behandelplannen op en bewaakt de voortgang van de behandeling.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar niet geïsoleerd. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een digitaal multidisciplinair team waarin je afstemt met regiebehandelaren, psychiaters en collega-psychologen. Ook denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van onze zorg, kennisdeling en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.

De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.

Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.

Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.

Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Beterggz?

Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.

We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je interessant om als online basispsycholoog bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?

Stuur je motivatie en CV naar:

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.

Een VOG-verklaring maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

jobs.excerpt: Warum wir Dich brauchenJedes Jahr werden tausende Patient:innen aus der stationären Reha entlassen – und stehen dann oft alleine da.
jobs.description:
Warum wir Dich brauchen

Jedes Jahr werden tausende Patient:innen aus der stationären Reha entlassen – und stehen dann oft alleine da. Mit der digitalen Nachsorge über myReha ändern wir das: Patient:innen setzen ihre Therapie zu Hause fort, begleitet von einem Therapieteam, das per Chat und Telefon erreichbar ist. Dieses Team bist du. Als DRV-Nachsorge-Therapeut:in bist du die Person, die Patient:innen nach der Entlassung auffängt, motiviert und durch ihre digitale Rehabilitation führt.

Was Du mitgestalten wirst

  • Patient:innen betreuen: Du begleitest Patient:innen nach der stationären Reha durch ihre digitale Nachsorge – per Chat und Telefon. Du bist ihre Ansprechperson, motivierst sie und beantwortest fachliche Fragen.

  • Aktivierung sicherstellen: Du sorgst dafür, dass Patient:innen nach der Entlassung tatsächlich mit der digitalen Nachsorge starten – zeitnah und ohne Hürden.

  • Therapieerfolg begleiten: Du behältst den Fortschritt deiner Patient:innen im Blick, erkennst Abbruchrisiken frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor jemand aufgibt.

  • Kliniken unterstützen: Du arbeitest mit den Kliniken zusammen, um den Übergang von der stationären Reha in die digitale Nachsorge so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten.

  • Produkt mitgestalten: Dein Feedback aus der täglichen Arbeit mit Patient:innen fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung von myReha ein.

Requirements

Was macht Deine Bewerbung erfolgreich?

  • Therapeutische Ausbildung: Du bist Logopäd:in, Ergotherapeut:in, Neuropsycholog:in oder Physiotherapeut:in – mit abgeschlossener Ausbildung oder Studium.

  • Klinische Erfahrung: Du hast mit Patient:innen gearbeitet, idealerweise in der neurologischen Rehabilitation. Du weißt, was ein Schlaganfall oder eine Hirnverletzung für den Alltag bedeutet.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Deine Patient:innen sehen dich nicht – du überzeugst und motivierst über Sprache, Stimme und Schrift.

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten: Du arbeitest remote und organisierst deinen Patientenstamm selbstständig. Du brauchst keine tägliche Anleitung.

  • Bonus: Erfahrung mit digitaler Therapie, Telerehabilitation oder der DRV-Nachsorge (IRENA).

Über den CV hinaus

  • Empathie mit Struktur: Du verstehst, dass Patient:innen nach der Entlassung verunsichert sind – und gibst ihnen Halt, ohne den roten Faden zu verlieren.

  • Motivationstalent: Manche Patient:innen brauchen einen Schubs, andere ein offenes Ohr. Du erkennst, was gerade gebraucht wird.

  • Digital-affin: Du arbeitest gerne mit Apps und digitalen Tools – und siehst in der Technologie eine Chance, nicht eine Hürde.

  • Teamplayer auf Distanz: Du arbeitest remote, bist aber trotzdem eng mit dem Team verbunden – du teilst Erfahrungen, fragst nach und bringst dich ein.

Warum nyra health

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du hilfst Patient:innen direkt bei ihrer Genesung

  • Schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Scaleup mit internationaler Ambition

  • Flexibles Remote-Arbeiten – vereinbar mit deinem Leben

  • Full-time oder Part-time möglich

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Attraktive Vergütung

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein Office am Schottentor

  • Die vermutlich besten Mario Kart-Fahrer:innen der österreichischen Startup-Szene 😉

Der Ablauf

  1. Intro Call (~30 Min): Background, Motivation und ein Überblick über nyra health und die Rolle.

  2. Gespräch mit unserem Health Lead: Teamfit, Arbeitsweise und gegenseitige Erwartungen – letzter Schritt vor dem Angebot.
