jobs.title: PAXUS System Expert
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewThe PAXUS System Expert is a senior subject matter role with platform-wide ownership and cross-functional influence across the firm’s global fund administration operations.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The PAXUS System Expert is a senior subject matter role with platform-wide ownership and cross-functional influence across the firm’s global fund administration operations. This is not a generic system administrator position; it is a specialist role that sits at the intersection of fund operations, technology, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will be the definitive internal authority on PFS-PAXUS: how it should be configured, how it should be used, and how it can be evolved to better serve the business. You will lead an internal SME group, act as the primary liaison with PAXUS Support, and partner with operational and business leads to drive meaningful efficiency improvements through correct and strategic platform usage.

Key Responsibilities

1. Primary Point of Contact & PAXUS Support Liaison

  • Serve as the first escalation point for all PAXUS-related queries raised by internal teams across reconciliation, fund accounting, transfer agency, and client servicing.
  • Own the relationship with PFS-PAXUS Support: log, track, and drive resolution of all support tickets and escalations.
  • Triage system issues and determine whether resolution requires internal configuration changes, user guidance, or vendor escalation.

2. Internal SME Group Leadership & Training

  • Establish and lead a structured internal PAXUS SME group, ensuring each operational area and/or region has a nominated and trained representative.
  • Design and deliver training programmes for new joiners and ongoing upskilling for existing staff, covering both core functionality and evolving best practices.
  • Maintain a training library and knowledge base that keeps pace with system changes and new use cases.

3. Best Practices & Proper Usage Governance

  • Define and enforce standards for how PAXUS should be used across all teams; reducing operational friction caused by workarounds, inconsistent approaches, and temporary fixes that do not address root cause.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of how teams are using the platform and proactively identify areas of misuse or suboptimal usage.
  • Communicate best practice guidance clearly and accessibly, ensuring adoption across diverse teams and experience levels.

4. UAT Lead for New Builds & Releases

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of User Acceptance Testing for all PAXUS system builds, upgrades, and new functionality releases.
  • Define test scenarios based on real operational workflows, manage defect logging, and sign off on releases to production.
  • Ensure post-release monitoring is in place and that any issues are captured and resolved promptly.

5. Automation Delivery

  • Identify and deliver automation opportunities within PAXUS’s existing features; prioritising high-volume, repetitive tasks across NAV processing, reconciliation, investor transactions, and reporting.
  • Work with operations teams to document current manual workflows and map them against available PAXUS automation capabilities.
  • Track and measure efficiency gains achieved through automation, and report outcomes to leadership.

6. Business Partnership & Requirements Management

  • Partner with business and operational leads as new processes are introduced, ensuring PAXUS is configured to support them from the outset rather than retrofitted after the fact.
  • Challenge and re-examine existing processes: proactively identify where PAXUS can enable a more efficient or scalable approach to current workflows.
  • Translate business requirements into clear system specifications and work with relevant stakeholders to implement them effectively.

7. PAXUS Enhancement Wishlist & Roadmap Management

  • Maintain a structured and prioritised log of PAXUS enhancement requests sourced from across the business.
  • Engage with PFS-PAXUS on the product roadmap: advocate for enhancements that address genuine operational needs and provide structured feedback on proposed changes.
  • Ensure business stakeholders are informed of upcoming platform changes and prepared to leverage new functionality.

8. Complex Fund Structure Support & Setup

  • Provide specialist oversight and guidance on the PAXUS configuration for complex fund structures, including multi-class, multi-series, fund-of-funds, and across different fund structures.
  • Lead system configuration for new fund launches, investor onboardings, and fund conversions, ensuring accuracy and completeness from day one.
  • Act as the final review authority on fund setups where structural complexity creates elevated risk of misconfiguration.

9. System Connectivity & Integration

  • Work with owners of other internal and external systems (custodians, brokers, investor portals, reporting tools) to establish data flows and integrations that allow PAXUS to communicate effectively with the broader technology ecosystem.
  • Define and document integration requirements, data mapping, and interface specifications in collaboration with IT and technology partners.
  • Ensure that connectivity initiatives are tested thoroughly and that ongoing data integrity across connected systems is monitored.

10. Operational Solution Design & Workflow Development

  • Work on the design of operational solutions and end-to-end workflows within PAXUS for new and evolving business requirements.
  • Ensure that system-led processes are designed with scalability, controls, and auditability in mind.
  • Challenge legacy workflows that have grown organically and may not reflect current best practice or available system capabilities.

11. Policy, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of PAXUS-related policies, procedures, and operational documentation.
  • Support firm-wide continuous improvement initiatives by surfacing PAXUS-related inefficiencies and proposing structured solutions.
  • Participate in internal governance forums and contribute to audit, compliance, and risk management activities as they relate to the platform.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Minimum 5–7 years of hands-on experience with PFS-PAXUS within a fund administration environment.
  • Deep operational knowledge of fund accounting and/or transfer agency functions; you must understand the business, not just the system.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex fund structures
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Familiarity with FATCA/CRS data requirements and how they manifest in PAXUS workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to issue resolution.

Preferred

  • Experience leading or coordinating UAT for system upgrades or new platform releases.
  • Exposure to PAXUS system configuration, module setup, or administration.
  • Experience delivering internal training programmes or developing operational documentation.
  • Familiarity with system integration concepts and data mapping between fund administration platforms.
  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related discipline is advantageous but not required.

About Meridial

Meridial places skilled, remote-first professionals into high-trust, high-precision operational opportunities for leading technology companies. Our teams work as an embedded extension of our clients' own product and operations organizations, holding the same quality bar and the same deadlines.

The Opportunity

As an SMB AI Power User on the Competitive Evaluations team, you'll help a major consumer technology company find out where its bundled AI assistant subscription falls short of the standalone assistants small businesses already pay for. You are not an AI researcher studying the problem from the outside - you are a working or experienced business owner who already runs on these tools, and your own operations are the test bed.

Your day is spent doing what you already do: drafting ad copy, planning content, answering customer messages, researching suppliers, and reconciling numbers. The difference is that you do it across competing assistants, side by side, and document precisely where each one breaks. The failures you surface are the failures real paying subscribers will hit, which is exactly why the seat calls for a genuine operator rather than an evaluator.

What You'll Do

  • Run head-to-head prompts and multi-turn workflows across the client's assistant and competing paid assistants, using tasks drawn from your own business operations and marketing.
  • Build and maintain a library of realistic small-business test cases spanning ad creative and copy, organic content planning, customer messaging, competitor research, pricing, scheduling, and light bookkeeping.
  • Identify and document failure modes - wrong answers, unnecessary refusals, weak instruction-following, tone misses, brand-unsafe output, broken formatting, context lost across turns, unusable image or video output.
  • Write clear, reproducible reports: prompt used, model and surface, expected output, actual output, severity, and why the failure matters to a paying business subscriber.
  • Assess the bundled subscription on value terms - what a business owner actually receives versus what a standalone competitor subscription delivers for comparable spend.
  • Stress-test assistant features inside the social and commerce surfaces where business owners meet them, not only the standalone chat product.

What We're Looking For

  • Owner or operator of a small or medium business - sole proprietor, founder, or the person running day-to-day operations at a business of roughly 1–200 employees.
  • Daily, habitual use of generative AI tools in that business, for both operations and marketing. Experimental or occasional use is not a fit.
  • Organic presence on Instagram and Facebook for the business, maintained personally: posting, Stories, Reels, comment and message response.
  • Hands-on paid advertising experience on Meta platforms - has personally built, launched, and optimized campaigns with real budget.
  • Based in the United States and authorized to work here.
  • Capacity sufficient to complete deliverables per the agreed scope and timeline, which may include up to 40 hours per week
  • Exceptional written English - able to describe a failure clearly enough that an engineer can reproduce it without follow-up.
  • Comfortable working independently against a rubric and holding a weekly output cadence.

Nice to Have

  • At least one current paid AI subscription (ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max, Gemini Advanced, or similar), so competitive comparison rests on actual use.
  • Runs a side business or second venture alongside a primary role - the profile that tends to test AI hardest against limited time.
  • Heavy Instagram user, personally and commercially: fluent in Reels, Stories, trends, and creator tooling.
  • Subscribes to two or more AI assistants simultaneously and holds an informed view on where each one wins.
  • Uses AI beyond chat - automations, agents, API or no-code integrations, custom GPTs or Projects.
  • Prior experience with model evaluation, red teaming, data annotation, QA, or structured user research.
  • Working familiarity with adjacent SMB tooling: Shopify, Square, QuickBooks, Klaviyo, Canva, CapCut, Later, or similar.
  • Industry range across the two hires - for example, one services or retail operator alongside one e-commerce or creator-economy operator.

We offer a pay range of $40-$50 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to write a Christ-centered book that addresses the profound grief, heartbreak, and questions surrounding miscarriage and pregnancy loss.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to write a Christ-centered book that addresses the profound grief, heartbreak, and questions surrounding miscarriage and pregnancy loss. This project should combine theological depth that is accessible, deep empathy, personal resonance, and practical, biblical encouragement to help grieving women (and their families) navigate loss, lament faithfully, and anchor their hope securely in Christ amidst deep sorrow.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

Your mission is to replace that with a consistent, automated data flow: daily pipelines that land processor, CRM, and ERP data into a cloud data warehouse, post automatically to the general ledger, and feed a reporting layer granular enough to decompose any variance to budget down to its root cause. This is a high-ownership role with direct visibility to finance and business stakeholders, where the quality of your data models directly determines whether the business can trust its numbers.

Technical Stack

Core: Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, a modern orchestrator (Airflow / Dagster / Prefect), Git + CI/CD.

Source systems in scope: multiple payment processors and a core payments API, a CRM (customer & pricing attributes), and an ERP/general ledger. A BI tool renders the end-user dashboards on top of the modeled data.

As a qualified expert You will

  • Design and build automated, reliable ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems (payment processors, CRM, and ERP) into a cloud data warehouse on a daily cadence.
  • Automate financial reporting to the general ledger that reconciles with the reporting layer by design, replacing manual, error-prone processes.
  • Build and maintain a data-mapping layer that resolves customer identity across systems and rolls transactions up to a single customer key.
  • Model clean, well-documented data marts that make business performance explainable and support drill-down and variance analysis.
  • Deliver the data models that power a KPI and forecasting dashboard for finance and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure pipelines are robust and auditable with monitoring, data-quality checks, and alerting so issues are caught before reporting is consumed.
  • Collaborate with BI, finance, and integration partners to turn business requirements into reliable data products and define phased delivery.

We’re looking for you if you have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with a track record of owning production data pipelines end to end.
  • Expert-level SQL — complex analytical queries, window functions, query optimization, and dimensional / star-schema data modeling.
  • Hands-on experience on a modern cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake (or comparable: BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Strong experience with dbt (or an equivalent ELT transformation framework) for transformation and building tested, documented, version-controlled data models.
  • Proven experience building and scheduling ELT/ETL pipelines using a workflow orchestrator (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and designing idempotent, re-runnable, incremental loads.
  • Experience implementing data-quality testing, monitoring, and alerting as first-class parts of a pipeline.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with finance/business stakeholders, clarify requirements, and explain data-model decisions clearly (English, written and spoken).

Bonus points

  • Domain experience in payments, FinTech, or financial-services data — familiarity with concepts such as interchange, scheme/network fees, take rate, chargebacks, authorization rates, or surcharging.
  • Experience integrating payment-processor data (e.g. Worldpay, Adyen, Stripe) and normalizing heterogeneous processor data into a single model.
  • Experience supporting BI/analytics teams and self-service reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Sigma).
  • Exposure to analytics engineering or hands-on work with forecasting / cohort-based analytical models.
  • Data contracts and governance practices (dbt exposures, contracts/tests, semantic layers).

What’s in it for You

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Experience an agile and flexible working environment

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Be among like-minded people

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Feel supported by your HR, and take advantage of our referral bonus program.

jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Consumer Authentication Platform team is looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer to help build the secure, reliable, and seamless authentication experiences that connect millions of consumers with Affirm’s financial products.

Authentication is the front door to Affirm. Our systems power critical consumer journeys (including sign-up, sign-in, account recovery, checkout authentication, step-up challenges, session management, and connected merchant experiences) across thousands of merchants and multiple countries. We build foundational capabilities such as authentication factors, identity federation, session and authorization services, and risk-based authentication that protect consumers while minimizing unnecessary friction. We work closely with Product, Security, Fraud, Identity, Analytics, Compliance, Data Science, and a wide range of engineering teams to both leverage existing systems and build new systems. This role requires a high level of technical capability, strong cross-functional communication, and a creative mindset. Our work needs to be secure, reliable, correct, scalable, and extensible. Our job is to build an authentication platform that balances security, regulatory requirements, fraud prevention, customer experience, and business growth.

As a senior engineer, you will lead significant technical initiatives, influence the architecture and evolution of the platform, and help the team deliver secure authentication capabilities that can be reused across products, merchants, and geographies.

What You’ll Do

  • You will own the technical design and delivery of significant authentication platform capabilities, leading projects from early requirements and architecture through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.
  • You will build secure, highly available systems that support consumer sign-in, authentication factors, account recovery, step-up authentication, session management, authorization, and identity federation.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, Security, Fraud, Compliance, design, and analytics; participating in ideation; articulating technical constraints; and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will translate security, regulatory, fraud, and customer-experience requirements into pragmatic technical designs that appropriately balance risk, friction, complexity, and delivery speed.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology, security, reliability, or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on,” and on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality, security, and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, mentoring other engineers through design reviews and hands-on collaboration, and leading by example.
  • You will clearly communicate technical decisions, constraints, risks, and trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering audiences through design documents, reviews, and technical discussions. You will lead the investigation and resolution of complex production issues and identify systemic improvements that prevent recurrence.

What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python, Kotlin, Java, or another comparable modern programming language.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes, as well as relational databases, event-driven architectures, and RPC or API frameworks.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, secure, simple, and extensible design. You write high-quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large codebase and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely, including testing strategies, migration plans, and controlled rollouts.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, manager, and stakeholders, while helping other engineers grow through mentorship and technical leadership.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team and cross-functional partners.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Familiarity with standards and protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, WebAuthn/passkeys, FIDO2, JWTs, and public-key cryptography. Knowledge of security and assurance frameworks such as the NIST Digital Identity Guidelines or PCI DSS.
  • Experience designing session-management, token-issuance, account-recovery, or multi-factor authentication systems. Familiarity with risk-based or adaptive authentication and the interaction between identity, security, compliance, and fraud controls.

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Terra Nova Solutions (« TNS ») est une société du groupe Solon qui agit en tant que fournisseur de services pour Solon. La Côte d’Ivoire est notre prochain marché cible.

Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Côte d’Ivoire. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. We are Physitrack. Our platform is used by clinicians in more than 100 countries to prescribe exercise, monitor patients between visits and evidence what treatment achieved. We are listed on Nasdaq First North.

In June 2026 we launched remote therapeutic monitoring in the US. The technology works and we're pleased to support a considerable and ever growing number of RTM customers.

That is this role.

What you would do

Work with clinics already on our platform using RTM, from accepting the policy through to a first patient enrolled and a first episode reaching CPT eligibility. You would not perform clinical monitoring on behalf of any practice, and you would not have access to patient clinical data. CMS has proposed tightening who may furnish RTM monitoring from January 2027, and this role is deliberately built on the education and enablement side of that line.

About you

You must have experience of RTM / CMS codes

Practicalities

$65 to $90 per hour depending on experience.

jobs.title: Litigation Paralegal
jobs.excerpt: Wanta Thome is a plaintiff-side employment litigation firm built like a modern company.
jobs.description:
Wanta Thome is a plaintiff-side employment litigation firm built like a modern company. We represent workers who have been hit by discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, we work on contingency, and the firm gets paid only when our clients recover. That shapes how we work: preparation matters, speed matters, and every file is a person whose job, income, or reputation is on the line.

Most firms hand their paralegals legacy processes and call it support work. We have an in-house developer team that builds custom drafting and case tools, we run the firm on data-backed goals so priorities are never a mystery, and we build teams where paralegals do substantive litigation work, not administrative cleanup.

The Role

This is not a legal secretary position. As a Litigation Paralegal, you drive case momentum. You prepare the pleadings, discovery, and case-development work that attorneys build strategy on, you keep clients informed during a hard stretch of their lives, and you spot problems in a case before they become delays.

2+ years of litigation paralegal experience, required. Employment law experience is helpful but not required; we have resources for teaching the substantive law to paralegals who already know how litigation works. This is not an entry-level position.

What the Job Is Really Like

  • Deadlines are real and often stacked. Litigation calendars do not move, and you will manage several active matters at once.
  • Clients come to us at a low point. Many have just lost a job or are still working somewhere hostile. You need steady empathy and the judgment to keep conversations productive without stepping into legal advice.
  • We give and expect direct feedback. We call it Radical Candor: say the true thing, kindly, early.

What You'll Do

  • Draft complaints, routine motions, discovery requests and responses, and mediation statements that need light attorney revision, not a rewrite.
  • Build the strategic core of each file: fact chronologies, deposition summaries, document indexes, and witness profiles.
  • Research procedural questions and deliver short, usable summaries with a recommendation.
  • Lead client fact-gathering calls and handle routine client questions with empathy and clear boundaries.
  • Watch each case for gaps, stalls, and approaching deadlines, and raise solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Keep matter status current in our case systems so anyone on the team can see where a case stands.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of paralegal experience in litigation, required. Plaintiff-side employment experience is a plus.
  • Paralegal certificate or associate's degree required; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Strong legal writing that is clean the first time, and an eye for the details others miss.
  • A project-manager mindset: you juggle multiple cases, meet deadlines without being chased, and ask for help early when you are stuck.
  • Warm and clear with clients; concise and clear with the team.
  • Comfortable in Microsoft 365. Case-management experience is a plus; we will train.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base pay of $28.00–$39.00 per hour depending on experience and other factors.
  • Performance bonuses tied to firm results.
  • Medical, dental, and vision: the firm pays 80% of the single-plan premium.
  • 401(k) with a 3% firm contribution.
  • Firm-paid life insurance and long-term disability.
  • Generous paid time off and commuter benefits.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Central, with occasional flexibility for case demands.
  • Location: your choice of remote, hybrid, or in-office. The Minneapolis office includes a wellness room and fitness center. You must physically work in the United States; we are not able to support hiring in every state.

Why People Stay

  • The work matters. Better-prepared cases produce better outcomes for clients whose livelihoods are at stake.
  • The firm is growing, and we create new seats as we grow. People who perform here move into larger roles.
  • You work directly with experienced attorneys and get mentorship, training, and custom-built tools rather than legacy processes.
  • We work hard and we mark the wins, with regular team events and an office built for collaboration.

Our values are simple: Teamwork, Impactful Agility, Relentless Excellence, Results-Driven, and Radical Candor. In practice that means no egos, honest feedback in both directions, and a shared commitment to fast outcomes for clients.

Hiring Process

  1. Submit your application.
  2. Prevue strengths assessment.
  3. Phone interview.
  4. Kolbe assessment.
  5. Final interview.
  6. Offer, references, and background check.

Equal Opportunity

Wanta Thome PLC is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

Apply with a resume and a short note about the case work you are most proud of.

jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What's the position?

As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team.

At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable.

You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself.

This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context.

Responsibilities

Building the function

  • Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end.

  • Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations.

  • Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst.

  • Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment.

Sentiment measurement & reporting

  • Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends.

  • Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars.

  • Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection.

  • Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations.

Diagnosing what's driving sentiment

  • When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue?

  • Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact.

  • Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance.

Closing the loop

  • Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation.

  • Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved.

  • Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding.

  • Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars.

  • Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process.

Data foundation

  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets.

  • Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports.

  • Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity.

  • Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently.

  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation.

  • Experience using AI tools within an analytical workflow, including sentiment classification, text analysis, or LLM-assisted review of qualitative feedback.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn analysis into a recommendation and land it with stakeholders who don't report to you.

  • Comfort working across both quantitative data (CSAT scores, trend lines) and qualitative material (reviews, transcripts, case notes).

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience building or standing up a new reporting function or capability from the ground up.

  • People management experience.

  • Familiarity with contact center or customer support operations and workflows.

  • Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.

  • Python experience, particularly for text/sentiment analysis (pandas, NLTK, or similar).

  • Experience in iGaming, online sportsbook, casino, or a regulated industry environment.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

Horario: 7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. hora Colombia, con disponibilidad para trabajar en un horario compatible con el equipo en España


Sobre la Empresa
Nuestro cliente es una empresa europea especializada en fabricación industrial y transformación de metales, con amplia trayectoria en el sector.
La organización desarrolla proyectos que combinan diseño técnico, fabricación y transformación de piezas y componentes metálicos, con un fuerte enfoque en la precisión, calidad y correcta preparación de documentación técnica para producción.

Sobre el Rol
Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Técnico/a Industrial y Delineante para apoyar diariamente al equipo técnico en la elaboración, modificación y preparación de planos y documentación gráfica para fabricación.
El trabajo estará enfocado principalmente en AutoCAD y SolidWorks, incluyendo interpretación de información técnica, elaboración y modificación de planos, diseño de piezas y preparación de documentación para producción.
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil altamente senior. Esta oportunidad puede ser adecuada para un profesional técnico con buenos fundamentos que quiera desarrollarse trabajando directamente con un equipo internacional. Inicialmente, la persona comenzará con tareas técnicas sencillas y, a medida que demuestre precisión, confiabilidad y autonomía, podrá asumir proyectos de mayor complejidad.
Además de las capacidades técnicas, buscamos una persona comunicativa, responsable y confiable, capaz de trabajar de manera autónoma y mantener una comunicación constante sobre el avance y finalización de sus tareas.



Qué Harás
Diseño y Delineación Técnica
  • Elaborar y modificar planos técnicos para procesos de fabricación.
  • Diseñar piezas y componentes para su posterior fabricación.
  • Interpretar información, medidas y especificaciones técnicas.
  • Digitalizar y actualizar planos existentes.
  • Preparar documentación gráfica clara y precisa para producción.
  • Realizar inicialmente tareas técnicas básicas y asumir progresivamente trabajos de mayor complejidad.

AutoCAD y SolidWorks
  • Trabajar diariamente con AutoCAD para la elaboración y modificación de planos.
  • Utilizar SolidWorks para apoyar el diseño y modelado de piezas y componentes.
  • Trabajar con documentación técnica en 2D y 3D según las necesidades del proyecto.
  • Verificar medidas, detalles y especificaciones antes de entregar los trabajos.
Trabajo Remoto y Coordinación
  • Coordinar diariamente con el equipo técnico ubicado en España.
  • Comunicar claramente avances, dudas y finalización de tareas.
  • Gestionar el trabajo asignado de manera autónoma y responsable.
  • Cumplir con los tiempos establecidos y mantener organizada la documentación de los proyectos.

Requisitos
Requisitos Indispensables
  • Formación como Técnico Superior en Diseño Industrial, Delineación, Ingeniería Técnica Industrial o formación técnica relacionada.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de AutoCAD.
  • Conocimientos de SolidWorks.
  • Capacidad para elaborar, modificar e interpretar planos técnicos.
  • Conocimientos básicos de diseño de piezas y componentes mecánicos.
  • Capacidad para interpretar medidas, datos y especificaciones técnicas.
  • Excelente atención al detalle y precisión.
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación.
  • Persona responsable, confiable y capaz de trabajar con autonomía.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar de 7:00 a.m. a 4:00 p.m. hora Colombia, manteniendo coincidencia horaria con España.
  • Español fluido. No se requiere inglés.

Requisitos Deseables
  • Experiencia previa en delineación, diseño industrial o fabricación mecánica.
  • Experiencia preparando planos o documentación gráfica para fabricación.
  • Conocimiento de otros programas de diseño CAD 2D/3D.
  • Experiencia trabajando de manera remota con equipos internacionales.

Cómo Se Verá el Éxito en Este Rol
El éxito en esta posición estará determinado por la capacidad para:
  • Entregar planos y documentación técnica con precisión y dentro de los tiempos establecidos.
  • Utilizar AutoCAD y SolidWorks correctamente en las tareas asignadas.
  • Interpretar instrucciones técnicas y convertirlas en documentación gráfica clara.
  • Trabajar progresivamente con proyectos de mayor complejidad.
  • Mantener una comunicación constante y efectiva con el equipo en España.
  • Trabajar de forma autónoma, responsable y confiable.
  • Entregar resultados consistentes sin necesidad de supervisión permanente.
¿Por Qué Unirte?
  • Trabaja 100% remoto desde Colombia.
  • Participa en proyectos internacionales de fabricación industrial.
  • Trabaja directamente con un equipo técnico europeo.
  • Fortalece tus conocimientos en AutoCAD, SolidWorks y diseño industrial.
  • Comienza con proyectos sencillos y desarrolla progresivamente tus responsabilidades técnicas.
  • Obtén experiencia práctica en diseño y fabricación de piezas metálicas.

Notas Importantes

Por favor, aplica únicamente si cuentas con conocimientos prácticos de AutoCAD y SolidWorks y tienes disponibilidad para trabajar en el horario establecido.
Tendrán especial consideración los candidatos que:
  • Puedan demostrar experiencia práctica elaborando o modificando planos técnicos.
  • Tengan experiencia relacionada con fabricación mecánica o diseño industrial.
  • Sean comunicativos y mantengan informado al equipo sobre el progreso de sus tareas.
  • Demuestren autonomía, responsabilidad y confiabilidad trabajando de manera remota.
  • Estén interesados en desarrollarse progresivamente y asumir tareas de mayor complejidad.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager, RMS
jobs.excerpt: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is scaling rapidly, and the talent we bring in will define how fast and how well we deliver. As Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition for RMS, you will own the recruiting engine that fuels that growth. This is not a passive support function—you will sit at the table with production and engineering leaders, translate workforce plans into hiring strategies, and hold your team to a consistently high bar across process discipline and performance outcomes.
We need a leader who is solution-oriented by default: someone who digs into the data, identifies what’s broken or underperforming, and initiates change once the evidence supports it—not after consensus emerges on its own. You will build and refine recruiting processes that are measurable and repeatable, coach your team to execute at a high level, and ensure every hire raises the caliber of the organization. You will manage a team of recruiters, partner with hiring managers across the RMS organization, and drive full-cycle strategy from talent mapping through offer close. The right person for this role combines operational rigor with the creativity and urgency of a startup recruiter—no task too big, no detail too small.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage and develop a team of recruiters supporting RMS hiring across production, manufacturing engineering, quality, and supply chain functions
  • Own end-to-end hiring strategy for RMS: forecast demand with production leaders, build pipelines, and report progress with clear, data-backed communication
  • Use recruiting data and funnel metrics to identify bottlenecks, diagnose root causes, and drive process improvements—acting on what the data shows rather than waiting for direction
  • Set and maintain a high performance bar for the recruiting team: define clear expectations around sourcing activity, pipeline velocity, interview quality, and offer-acceptance rates
  • Act as a subject matter expert in sourcing techniques and tools—including Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referral programs, and SOBO campaigns—and coach your team to use them effectively
  • Conduct interviews and calibrate hiring manager expectations, demonstrating strong interview-to-offer conversion through disciplined candidate evaluation
  • Build talent maps and market intelligence specific to the RMS talent landscape (propulsion, energetics, pyrotechnics, production operations) to inform proactive engagement strategies
  • Drive diverse talent into the organization while ensuring a consistently excellent candidate experience at every touchpoint
  • Partner cross-functionally with HR, compensation, and workforce planning to align recruiting efforts with headcount plans, offer competitiveness, and retention goals
  • Represent Anduril’s brand and recruiting function with the highest level of professionalism—internally with senior stakeholders and externally with candidates and partners

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of high-volume talent acquisition experience evaluating and hiring top-tier technical talent
  • 8+ years partnering with senior leaders and stakeholders—reporting on progress, advising on strategy, and using data to influence hiring decisions
  • 5+ years managing or mentoring a team of recruiters with accountability for time-sensitive, high-volume pipelines
  • Demonstrated track record of using recruiting analytics to initiate and sustain process improvements—not just reporting metrics but acting on them
  • Experience recruiting in an agency and/or fast-paced startup environment, hiring for hardware, production, manufacturing engineering, or related technical roles
  • Ability to travel between sites as needed
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience standing up a talent acquisition function for a greenfield or rapidly scaling manufacturing site
  • Knowledge of ITAR policies and their impact on hiring practices
  • Background recruiting for solid rocket motors, propulsion, energetics, pyrotechnics, or adjacent defense/aerospace disciplines
  • Track record of operating in a consultative capacity where data-informed guidance led to measurably improved hiring outcomes and candidate experience
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent high-volume pipelines while maintaining process integrity and candidate engagement throughout
  • Highly autonomous, collaborative, and adaptable—comfortable driving change in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
US Salary Range
$143,000—$191,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to .

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LCMHC, LMFT, LCSW) in North Carolina to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • North Carolina: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

NOCD is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. NOCD is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Virtualization Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Virtualization Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $80,000–$105,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are looking for a Virtualization Engineer to design, deploy, and operate VMware-based virtualization, software-defined networking, and software-defined storage platforms across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

We’re looking for a Creative MarketingProducer who thinks like a researcher - someone who senses trends, understands storytelling, and knows how to turn marketing insights into videos that actually sell.

Your role is not only production, but to lead creative evolution - generating ideas, refining proven creative approaches, finding new styles, testing them, and scaling what works. You’ll work at the intersection of project management, creative, analytics, and production.

You’ll also shape and pitch creative concepts that challenge existing ad formats and explore new storytelling angles.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and document emerging video trends across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms.
  • Market and Content development Research
  • Research new video styles, not just iterate on existing ones.
  • Translate insights into creative hypotheses.
  • Project management, supporting various teams from idea to delivery
  • Ensure each concept accurately reflects the client’s value proposition and target audience.
  • Coordinate creators, influencers, and bloggers.
  • Develop and manage test plans with media buyers to validate creative hypotheses.
  • Review performance data (CTR, hook rate, watch time, CPA).
  • Understand a consistent “create → test → learn → scale” workflow for ongoing creative optimization.
  • Communicating effectively between marketing, creation and testing departments.

AI & Experimentation Mindset:

You know how to experiment with AI tools - from generating references in Midjourney to using Claude to organise your workspace. We don’t expect you to know every tool, but we value a “prompt-first” mindset - when you create faster than you search.

Requirements

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing - ideally within paid social or performance marketing.
  • Solid understanding of short-form video formats and what drives performance on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.
  • Comfortable collaborating with creators and bloggers: sourcing, briefing, and overseeing remote shoots.
  • Confident in interpreting marketing performance data.
  • Exceptional communication and organization skills - able to keep projects on track, people aligned, and expectations clear.
  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to prioritize multiple projects effectively.
  • Fluent English - both spoken and written

Nice to Have

  • Experience in media buying or working closely with media buyers.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or enhancing creative assets.
  • Video production or video marketing background.
  • Experience using UGC or influencer platforms to source and manage creators.
  • Understanding of A/B testing and how creative experiments are structured and analyzed.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.
