jobs.description:
VP, North America Base Sales

At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose.

Honesty

Reliability

Curiosity

Collaboration

Passion

About the role and what you'll be doing:

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Vice President, North America Base Sales to lead a multi-tiered sales organization responsible for driving strategic growth, client satisfaction, and long-term client retention across our North America existing client portfolio. In this leadership role, you will own senior executive client relationships, define and execute the North America base growth strategy, provide strategic direction and mentorship to sales leaders, and ensure Ensono delivers consistent, world-class outcomes that strengthen lifetime client value across a large, complex client base.

You will maintain accountability for accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management, ensuring visibility and predictability across the North America region to support strategic planning and resource allocation. You will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, leveraging Ensono's full portfolio and partner ecosystem to address evolving business and technology needs. Your objective is to make our clients successful and committed to Ensono for life through durable, value-based relationships.

As a strategic thinker and self-starter, you will operate with agility in a dynamic market, combining proven leadership experience with innovative approaches to drive expansion, renewals, and client advocacy. As a senior leader within the Ensono Sales organization, you will ensure disciplined execution across the full lifecycle of client engagement, while building strong partnerships with internal stakeholders across delivery, operations, and solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the North America base sales strategy for the region, aligned with Ensono's overall growth objectives and client lifecycle model.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-level sales organization, establishing clear performance standards, fostering a high-performance culture, and holding teams accountable to aggressive revenue and retention targets.
  • Coach sales leaders in strategic account planning, pipeline development, and execution methodology to drive consistent, scalable results across teams.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage accurate sales forecasting and pipeline visibility across the North America region, ensuring predictable revenue projections and timely executive reporting to support strategic planning, resource allocation, and organizational accountability.
  • Own executive-level client relationships, providing thought leadership and strategic consultation on aligning client business outcomes with Ensono and partner solutions.
  • Develop and strengthen relationships with C-level executives, senior business leaders, and IT decision-makers within existing client accounts.
  • Drive revenue growth through renewals, expansions, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across Ensono's end-to-end portfolio.
  • Lead proposal development, negotiations, pricing strategy, and commercial terms for complex, multi-line deals.
  • Work collaboratively with solution architects, delivery leaders, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure client success and identify expansion opportunities.
  • Monitor sales performance, renewal trends, and market dynamics; incorporate insights into account planning, forecasting, and investment decisions.
  • Establish and maintain accurate sales forecasts; provide regular visibility into pipeline health, win/loss analysis, and key performance metrics.
  • Represent the sales organization in regional and enterprise-wide strategic planning; advocate for market and client needs.
  • Build scalable operating models, talent pipelines, and succession plans for the North America base sales organization.
  • Actively recruit, onboard, and retain top sales talent; develop high-potential team members for advancement within the organization.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

  • Executive-level sales leadership experience, including responsibility for leading large, multi-tiered, high-performing sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated success managing teams across multiple management layers; proven ability to lead leaders.
  • Demonstrated success leading consultative, solution-based sales in technology and managed services environments.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue, retention, and growth targets at scale.
  • Significant experience managing, forecasting, and optimizing large, complex sales and renewal pipelines.
  • Extensive experience structuring and closing complex, multi-year, multi-solution client engagements.
  • Proven success managing enterprise clients with multiple lines of business and complex stakeholder models.
  • Ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without direct line authority.
  • Deep experience with managed services, hosting, mainframe, security, outsourcing, and hybrid IT environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage, advise, and influence C-level client stakeholders.
  • Ability to articulate technology and service value propositions from a business and outcomes-oriented perspective.
  • Highly organized, analytical, creative, and adaptable in fast-changing environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong collaboration and leadership capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree is a plus

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $230,000 to $275,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include a role-based, sales-incentive plan, and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

Ensono is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment to our Associates and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Pay transparency nondiscrimination statement/posting OFCCP’s pay transparency policy can be found on OFCCP’s website.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Semiconductor Software Engineer with 10+ years of industry experience to design, develop, and optimize software, firmware, and automation solutions supporting semiconductor design, verification, manufacturing, and post-silicon validation. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in C/C++, Python, EDA tools, hardware-software integration, and software architecture, with a proven track record of delivering scalable solutions for complex semiconductor platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop high-performance software solutions for semiconductor design, verification, and validation workflows.
  • Architect and implement firmware, device drivers, and low-level software for advanced silicon platforms.
  • Develop scalable automation frameworks and infrastructure for EDA tools, build systems, and compute environments.
  • Design and enhance post-silicon validation, debugging, characterization, and data analysis tools.
  • Optimize software performance, reliability, and scalability across multicore, embedded, and distributed computing environments.
  • Collaborate closely with hardware, ASIC, FPGA, verification, and manufacturing engineering teams to enable successful silicon bring-up and production.
  • Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, and establish software development best practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies, methodologies, and tools to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, design specifications, and development guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in semiconductor or embedded systems environments.
  • Expert-level programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
  • Extensive experience with EDA tools, ASIC/SoC verification, silicon bring-up, or post-silicon validation.
  • Strong understanding of hardware-software integration, embedded systems, debugging techniques, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation frameworks, Linux development environments, and HPC or cloud-based compute infrastructure.
  • Experience with version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development methodologies.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, Verilog, or VHDL.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native EDA workflows, distributed computing, and AI/ML applications in semiconductor design.
  • Experience with FPGA development, embedded Linux, or real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Prior experience leading engineering teams or driving large-scale technical initiatives.
  • Master's or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Role: Special Projects Director (Leadership)
  • Salary: $130.000 – $160.000 gross annual. For other currencies, we use a 5-year rolling average exchange rate.
  • Location: Fully remote. UTC-5 to UTC+2 preferred.
  • Job Type: Full-time (40 hours per week) preferred, and minimum 35 hours per week required.
  • Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, Carolyn Footitt
  • Start date: As soon as possible, but no later than January 4, 2027
  • Application Deadline:Monday, October 12, at the end of the day (23:59) Anywhere on Earth (UTC-12:00).
  • Application Process: Click "Apply Now" to respond to the prompts. We ask that you spend no more than 2 hours preparing your responses to the prompts.
  • Contact: Please email if you have any questions.

About Special Projects and the Position

Rethink Priorities’ (RP’s) Special Projects Program (SP) — RP's portfolio of fiscally sponsored and incubated projects — is entering its most significant growth phase yet, and this role will own the program end to end. Whoever takes this on will define how SP scales from here, with leadership over its strategy and its growing team.
RP is a US 501(c)(3) research and implementation nonprofit working across global health and development, animal welfare, and reducing global catastrophic risk, including risks from advanced AI. Beyond our own research, RP acts as a fiscal sponsor — under a Model A structure — to a portfolio of independent, high-impact projects, each running its own show day to day while RP provides the legal, financial, HR, and compliance support to accelerate them towards spin-off and further impact. SP helps founders get started on their project from day one, eliminating the 6–18 months a founder would otherwise spend standing up a legal entity and becoming tax-exempt. That acceleration matters enormously when the window for impact is short. Beyond speed, SP sponsorship provides a lower-risk environment for testing proof of concept: projects can validate mission fit and demonstrate traction before committing to the cost and complexity of independent legal existence.

Our SP program has supported numerous projects through their fastest growth phase, from a headcount size of one to 30+ and multi-million dollar budgets — including Epoch AI, Apollo Research and IAPS, all of which grew under SP before spinning off as independent organizations.

SP is growing — more projects, more countries, more complexity — and the systems and approaches that got it this far won't hold at the next size. Growth at this stage could look like taking the team from around 7 FTE today to somewhere in the 12–16 FTE range within a year, and launching upwards of 10 new sponsored projects — but figuring out what growth is actually necessary and appropriate, and at what pace, is a core part of what this role is for. You'll be the first person whose full-time job is building what comes next: a real risk framework, a sustainable fee model, a clear graduation path for projects that have outgrown fiscal sponsorship, and a growth strategy for the ones still to come.
You'll manage the Special Project Managers and the rest of the SP team who support sponsored projects day to day. This is a Leadership position at RP, meaning you’ll have a seat at the table for all major organizational strategic decisions and authority to set your team’s strategy, growth plans, and budget. It's a high-leverage position: getting the right systems in place now will position SP for further growth and the ability to support even more impactful projects.

This is a role for someone comfortable being the person that a fast-growing team will rely on for new answers and solutions — where "I don't know, let me find out" is a normal Tuesday, and good judgment matters more than a playbook, because there might not be one yet. You won't need to arrive knowing intricate employment law or new AI regulation yet — but you will need to be someone who picks new topics up fast.
You'll report to RP's COO, Carolyn Footitt, work closely with our Finance and People & Culture colleagues in the Operations Department, and have real latitude to shape how this program runs.

Most of our meetings happen between UTC-5 and UTC+2, where most SP and Core Operations staff are based, so we strongly prefer candidates within these timezones. This isn’t a heavy travel role, but you can expect somewhere around 3-4 trips per year for conferences and team or company retreats. We're able to legally hire in many countries and may be able to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support to the US or UK. This role is open to candidates who are able to commit a minimum 35 hours per week, with a preference for full-time (40 hours) candidates.

Key Responsibilities

As the Special Projects Director, your main responsibilities will include:
Program Strategy and Growth
  • Own SP's overall strategy and roadmap, positioning the program to capture the current wave of AI-related philanthropic capital and project demand.
  • Decide which projects join, graduate, or spin off from fiscal sponsorship, and build the frameworks behind those calls
  • Own SP's value proposition and Theory of Change with input from RP leadership
  • Evaluate the inbound project pipeline and proactively source new fiscally-sponsored opportunities rather than only waiting for them to arrive
  • Represent SP externally to prospective projects, funders, and peer fiscal sponsors, and sharpen how SP positions itself against other sponsors
  • Explore new service lines where they'd extend SP's value, such as regranting structures
Risk, Compliance, and Governance
  • Establish a formal project risk assessment framework covering financial, employment, legal/reputational, and leadership risk, with mitigation measures for top risks.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point on operations compliance matters: HR, finance, and compliance matters.
  • Create a project graduation framework — criteria for when a project should spin out vs. stay within RP, with clear spin-out milestones.
Funding and Financial Sustainability
  • Keep the SP fee model fair and sustainable for RP and project directors
  • Track a defined SP revenue target quarterly against a forecast.
Building Organizational and Management Capacity
  • Decide when to add capacity, what roles come next, and how management layers evolve as headcount and project count grow, in coordination with the COO and other Ops teams
  • Manage the Special Project Managers directly: weekly 1:1s, performance and feedback, coaching and professional development
  • Watch for capacity strain and wellbeing issues on the team before they become a problem
  • Handle skip-levels and interpersonal issues, and know when to loop in People & Culture
Support Quality and Experience
  • Ensure SP’s processes are documented and standardized — onboarding, offboarding, financial reporting, risk review — so growth doesn't depend on tacit knowledge
  • Set and track OKRs for the team
  • Keep SP's relationships with funders, project directors, and other RP departments strong
  • Make sure project directors are genuinely satisfied with the support they're getting

What We Are Looking For

Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking and Systems Evaluation — Understands the bigger picture of how SP functions as a system; identifies performance indicators and the actions needed to improve them.
  • Judgment and Decision-Making — Weighs costs and benefits of potential actions, spots risk before it becomes a crisis, anticipates opportunities, and stays comfortable operating across a genuinely varied portfolio.
  • People Management — Motivates, mentors, and develops direct reports (including other managers); builds a durable management layer rather than concentrating decisions personally.
  • Business Development and Relationship Management — Builds real trust with project directors, funders, and peer fiscal sponsors, and is comfortable representing SP externally.
  • Solution Orientation — Proactively proposes solutions and improves systems and processes rather than waiting for problems to surface.
  • Social Perceptiveness — Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder relationships (project founders, RP leadership, funders) with sensitivity and respect.
  • Cultural Competence — Works effectively across a remote, multi-country team and a diverse portfolio of sponsored projects.
  • Adaptability — Adjusts strategy and structure as SP scales; knows when to seek expertise from Core Ops, legal counsel, or RP leadership.
  • Communication — Conveys strategy, policy, and difficult decisions (including saying "no") clearly in writing and speech.
  • Execution. Strong prioritization and attention to detail, the ability to get an 80/20 understanding of an unfamiliar topic fast, and self-direction so that you don't need close oversight to stay on track.

Knowledge and Experience

Strong Knowledge and/or Expertise (Essential)
  • Solid experience in an operations role — HR, legal, finance, or general operations — with working knowledge of US 501(c)(3) rules and how they shape org decisions.
  • Familiarity with the effective altruism landscape and at least one of RP's cause areas (AI safety/global catastrophic risk, animal welfare, or global health and development), enough to understand what our sponsored projects are actually trying to do.
  • A generalist streak: you've had to get up to speed on unfamiliar domains before and know how to do it fast.
  • People management experience, including managing managers across a scaling team
  • Project/program management for large, varied portfolios
Working Knowledge and/or Expertise (Desired)
  • Fiscal sponsorship (particularly Model A structures), and how that shapes what a sponsored project can and can't do.
  • Financial forecasting, budgeting, and fee or pricing model design
  • UK and US nonprofit and employment regulatory environments
  • Experience working with a PEO (we use Justworks) or an EOR (we use Remote) to employ staff compliantly across borders.
  • Experience working with project management software (we use Asana) to manage work, delegate, and keep people informed of project progress.
We expect that even highly qualified applicants will not meet all these criteria. We encourage you to apply even if you don't have some of these skills, knowledge & experiences.

What We Offer

Compensation

  • Annual salary range: $130,000–$160,000 USD pre-tax, based on a 40-hour workweek.
  • Exact salary will be based on the candidate's prior relevant experience and corresponding title level, calculated using RP's salary algorithm.
  • Compensation is not restricted to USD and can be offered in other currencies. We use a 5-year rolling average exchange rate.
  • To ensure fairness across the organization, RP does not negotiate salaries.

Other Benefits

  • Opportunity to lead a program accelerating new high-impact organizations, and shaping how they get built.
  • Flexible work hours and location.
  • Comprehensive global benefits package (varies by country; RP aims for equity and quality across all staff).
  • Generous paid time off, including unlimited vacation (with a minimum required statutory minimum), "mandated" mid- and end-year organization-wide breaks, unlimited personal/sick leave (within reason), and parental leave (4–9 months paid/unpaid, taken within 2 years of a child's birth or adoption).
  • A collaborative leadership team and low administrative bureaucracy.
  • Technology stipend of $2,000 USD equivalent every 3 years for work and office equipment.
  • AI tools budget of $40 USD equivalent monthly.
  • Professional Development Budget of $5000 USD per year.
  • Learning opportunities, including workshops/training sessions and 10% of work time dedicated to professional and personal development.
  • Paid work trips, including one annual all-staff Mega Team Retreat and relevant conferences.
  • Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group.
  • RP Peer Support Program for New Employees.
  • Other benefits at the discretion of RP Leadership.
  • A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance.
  • We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want!

Our Hiring Process

The hiring process for this role will consist of multiple stages.
  1. Initial Selection: Applications will be reviewed primarily based on responses to the initial prompts on the application page but also your CV.
  2. Evaluation Rounds: Candidates who progress will complete a paid skills assessment and/or structured interview, followed by an opportunity to have a “meet and greet” with other SP team members. We will ask for references as well.

Additional Information

  • Extension requests: We can accommodate extension requests made before the deadline, up to one week.
  • Language: Please submit all application materials in English; professional-level English proficiency is required.
  • Accessibility: We're committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process — reach out to with any accessibility requests.
  • Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace. We encourage applicants regardless of age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity, or other background.
  • Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for recruitment; all correspondence comes via Pinpoint (@pinpoint.email and @pinpointhq.com) — please check spam/promotions folders if you don't hear from us.
  • Note Before Applying: Please do not include a cover letter, photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you’re applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.).
  • Contact: Please email if you have any questions.

About Rethink Priorities

Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future.
We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world’s most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results.
RP works as all of the following:
  1. A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work
  2. A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities.
  3. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world.
  4. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects.
Accomplishments include:
  • Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare.
  • Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination.
  • Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants.
  • Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties.
  • Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics.
  • Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively.
  • Donor Compass - Cross Cause Fund Tool to guide philanthropic giving
We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report.

About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for someone to join our purpose-led high-growth scale-up as a Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints.

You’ll support the management of member complaints and help ensure fair, compliant and timely outcomes. You’ll work closely with senior Operations colleagues, administrators, insurers and internal stakeholders to review complaints, support responses, identify issues and contribute to improvements in member experience and complaints management.

You may already be working in a superannuation Trustee office, or you may be joining us from a superannuation administrator and looking to broaden your experience into governance, oversight and Trustee responsibilities. And the best bit, you’ll get to work with some fantastic work mates!
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at

The Role As our Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints, you’ll be responsible for reviewing and supporting the management of complaints across internal dispute resolution and, where required, external dispute resolution processes.
You’ll help review complaint information, investigate member concerns, review and coordinate responses and ensure matters are accurately recorded and progressed within required timeframes. You’ll work with administrators, insurers and internal teams to gather information, clarify issues and support fair and well-reasoned outcomes for members.
You’ll also contribute to complaints reporting and insights by identifying recurring issues, process gaps and potential systemic concerns. Your work will help improve complaint handling, member communications, operational processes and outcomes.

You'll love this job if

  • You care about listening to members and helping resolve their concerns fairly.
  • You’re confident reviewing information, asking questions and identifying what needs to happen next.
  • You have strong written communication skills.
  • You have sound judgement and attention to detail.
  • You enjoy working with different stakeholders to resolve issues within clear timeframes.
  • You’re comfortable handling sensitive or difficult matters in a calm and professional way.
  • You’re interested in using complaints insights to improve processes and member experiences.

We're looking for someone who

  • Has 2+ years experience in superannuation administration, particularly complaints, or dispute resolution.
  • Has experience investigating member concerns, coordinating information from different teams and preparing or supporting complaint responses.
  • Has an understanding of internal dispute resolution and the importance of fair, accurate and timely outcomes.
  • Ideally has experience working in a superannuation Trustee office, or has worked closely with a Trustee, RSE licensee or service provider.
  • Can assess information, prepare clear written responses and maintain accurate complaint records.
  • Has strong organisational, stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Can manage multiple complaints and competing deadlines while maintaining quality.
  • Has RG146 or is willing to undertake the relevant training where required for the role.
  • Believes in Future Group’s mission and has a passion for moving Australia’s money out of fossil fuels and into renewable energy.
  • Believes in using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world.
Some nice-to-haves but are not essential are:
  • Experience handling complex or sensitive member complaints.
  • Experience supporting AFCA matters or systemic issue investigations.

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable

Job Title: Senior Manager, Practice Operations
Location: remote (work from home eligible)

Salary: $160,000-$180,000 DOE

Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients.
Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers.

The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end — the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production.

You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company.

We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof-of-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering — including where it introduces risk rather than removing it.

NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

What you’ll do

As a Content LiveOps Manager, you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet.

  • You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule.

  • Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update.

  • Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible.

  • Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live.

  • Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release.

  • Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention.

What you’ll bring

  • Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally.

  • Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm.

  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own.

  • LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why.

  • Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job.

Nice to have.

  • Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…)

  • Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication—especially in asynchronous, long-form formats—is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid. Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base.

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Integration Platform Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Integration Platform Developer with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including extensive expertise with the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and manage enterprise-scale integration solutions while driving API strategy, event-driven architecture, governance, security, and platform modernization initiatives. This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of delivering highly scalable, secure, and reusable integration solutions while collaborating with enterprise architects, application teams, and business stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration solutions using the Dell Boomi AtomSphere Platform, including process development, connector configuration, and runtime optimization.
  • Architect scalable integration solutions utilizing API-led connectivity, event-driven architecture, and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop reusable integration processes, shared components, libraries, and templates to accelerate enterprise integration initiatives.
  • Build and manage RESTful APIs, SOAP services, event-driven integrations, and real-time data synchronization solutions.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage Atom, Molecule, and Atom Cloud runtimes while ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational reliability.
  • Develop custom integrations and extensions using Groovy, JavaScript, or Java where required.
  • Implement enterprise API security using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS, certificate-based authentication, and API management best practices.
  • Integrate enterprise applications including SAP, Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, ServiceNow, and other cloud and on-premises systems.
  • Design and implement event-driven integration solutions using Apache Kafka, JMS, Boomi Event Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Establish CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and observability for integration solutions.
  • Optimize integration performance, troubleshoot complex production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable integration solutions.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, perform code reviews, establish integration development standards, and mentor junior integration engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, including 5+ years of hands-on Dell Boomi AtomSphere experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Boomi AtomSphere, including process design, connectors, Atom/Molecule runtime management, and deployment strategies.
  • Strong experience developing REST APIs, SOAP services, API management, and enterprise integration solutions.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Groovy, JavaScript, or Java for Boomi customization and automation.
  • Extensive experience integrating enterprise platforms including SAP, Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, ServiceNow, and similar SaaS applications.
  • Deep understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, encryption, and API governance using OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Experience implementing event-driven architectures using Kafka, JMS, Boomi Event Streams, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps tools.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dell Boomi Professional Developer, Boomi Professional Architect, or equivalent Boomi certification.
  • Experience with Boomi Flow, Boomi DataHub, Boomi Integration, Boomi API Management, and Boomi Event Streams.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud deployment across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with other enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), or Azure Integration Services.
  • Knowledge of FinOps, cloud cost optimization, API governance, and enterprise integration best practices.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply immediately.

jobs.title: Social Media & KI-Automation Manager (m/w/d) - 100% Remote, Vollzeit | Start: ab
jobs.excerpt: Die Endo Health GmbH entwickelt digitale Gesundheitslösungen, um die Versorgung von Frauen nachhaltig zu verbessern.
jobs.description:
Die Endo Health GmbH entwickelt digitale Gesundheitslösungen, um die Versorgung von Frauen nachhaltig zu verbessern. Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der jede Frau Zugang zu einer personalisierten, wirksamen und digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

Mit unseren Anwendungen unterstützen wir Betroffene dabei, ihre Gesundheit selbstbestimmt zu gestalten, und schließen gleichzeitig bestehende Versorgungslücken im Gesundheitssystem. So gestalten wir Frauengesundheit aktiv neu und stärken sie langfristig. Mit der Endo-App, der isi-App und der Vera-App begleiten wir Frauen bereits heute in unterschiedlichen Lebensphasen und bei unterschiedlichen gesundheitlichen Themen – und wir haben noch viel vor: Unser Produktportfolio wächst kontinuierlich weiter.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere Organic Social-Media-Accounts, gestaltest die Content-Strategie für Paid und Organic und entwickelst unsere KI-gestützten Content-Prozesse aktiv weiter. Carousels, Stories und UGC-Formate entstehen bei uns zunehmend in einer automatisierten KI-Pipeline – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du entscheidest, was guter Content ist, testest neue Ansätze und machst unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich besser. Dabei verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung und bringst Erfahrung im Aufbau KI-gestützter Content-Prozesse mit.

Du berichtest direkt an den Head of Marketing, übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Werkstudenten oder eine Werkstudentin und arbeitest eng mit unserer Performance-Marketing-Managerin sowie weiteren interdisziplinären Teams zusammen. Du bekommst dabei viel Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Dinge auszuprobieren und Themen wirklich voranzutreiben.

Strategische Verantwortung

  • Du gestaltest die Content- und Social-Media-Strategie für unsere verschiedenen Apps und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du baust nachhaltig wachsende Social-Media-Kanäle und vertrauensvolle Communities auf und steigerst Reichweite, Engagement und relevanten Traffic kontinuierlich
  • Du entwickelst Kommunikationsmessages und Creatives für Organic und Paid weiter – mit einem guten Gespür dafür, was Menschen erreicht und was wirklich performt
  • Du steuerst Influencer- und Markenkooperationen mit Unterstützung eines Freelancers und entwickelst daraus neue Impulse für Community, Reichweite und Markenwachstum

KI & Marketing Automation

  • Du baust skalierbare, KI-gestützte Content-Prozesse auf und optimierst sie kontinuierlich – damit wir schneller und effizienter produzieren können, ohne Qualität, Kreativität oder Markenstimme zu verlieren
  • Du bringst deine KI-Expertise auch ins restliche Marketing-Team ein und hilfst dabei, weitere sinnvolle Automatisierungsprozesse aufzubauen

Operative Umsetzung

  • Du setzt unsere Still-Contentproduktion für Organic operativ mit Hilfe von KI-Prozessen um und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du steuerst und gestaltest das UGC-Management für Paid & Organic gemeinsam mit einem Werkstudenten oder einer Werkstudentin
  • Du analysierst regelmäßig unsere Content- und Kanalperformance, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und machst relevante KPIs für das Team verständlich und nutzbar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Social-Media- & Content-Kompetenz

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Content-, Social Media- oder Digital Marketing
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau und der Skalierung organischer Social-Media-Kanäle und Communities
  • Fundierte operative Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Produktion performanter Inhalte für Organic und Paid sowie ein gutes Verständnis von Performance Marketing
  • Breite Kenntnisse relevanter Social-Media-Plattformen – von Meta und TikTok über YouTube und Pinterest bis hin zu neuen Plattformen und Trends
  • Erfahrung im Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Digital-Health-Umfeld ist von Vorteil

KI-Expertise

  • Tiefgehende, nachweisliche Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI in der Content-Produktion, im Aufbau effizienter Content-Workflows und in der Marketing-Automatisierung
  • Routine mit KI im Alltag: Du nutzt KI-Tools für Text, Bild und Video täglich und selbstverständlich – z. B. Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway oder CapCut AI. Du weißt, was sie können und wo sie danebenliegen.
  • Verständnis dafür, wie KI-Systeme gesteuert werden: Du kannst Prompts und Anweisungen lesen und anpassen, Outputs systematisch bewerten und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass daraus etwas gebaut werden kann.

Wichtig: KI-Know-how ist für uns kein Add-on, sondern ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Position. Deshalb freuen wir uns besonders auf Menschen, die bereits KI-gestützte Content-Prozesse aufgebaut und Content-Produktion damit messbar skaliert haben. Wenn du KI nicht nur nutzt, sondern richtig Lust hast, Prozesse damit neu zu denken, zu testen und immer weiterzuentwickeln, passt du sehr gut zu dieser Rolle.

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, bringst Themen proaktiv voran und hast Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete Lösungen zu machen.
  • Du denkst strategisch, packst gleichzeitig gerne selbst mit an und möchtest deine Ideen nicht nur diskutieren, sondern in die Umsetzung
  • Du bist begeistert von neuen KI-Tools und hast richtig Lust, immer wieder neue Ansätze zu entdecken, zu testen und damit unser Marketing besser zu machen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für starke visuelle und kreative Umsetzung und erkennst schnell, was guten Content ausmacht.
  • Du bist analysestark
  • Du kommunizierst gerne, arbeitest im Team und freust dich auf einen offenen, direkten Austausch, in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden können.

Benefits

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit – mit viel Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und echtem Teamspirit
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Wege und echte Ownership – deine Ideen können bei uns schnell Wirkung entfalten
  • Regelmäßige Teamtreffen vor Ort (ca. 3× jährlich), bei denen wir auch persönlich zusammenkommen, Ideen teilen und gemeinsam Zeit verbringen
  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg durch VSOP
  • Weiterbildungs- und Coaching-Budget, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst
  • Ein engagiertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit einer klaren Mission: Gemeinsam wollen wir die Gesundheitsversorgung von Frauen nachhaltig verbessern – und dabei wirklich etwas bewegen.

Damit wir direkt einen Eindruck davon bekommen, wie du denkst und arbeitest, gehört eine kurze Probeaufgabe fest zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess. Bitte reiche sie direkt zusammen mit deiner Bewerbung ein. Uns geht es dabei nicht um Hochglanz, sondern darum, zu verstehen, wie du denkst.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Format: PDF oder Slides
  • Umfang: max. 2–3 Seiten oder 4–8 Slides
  • Bearbeitungszeit: 60 Minuten

Skalierbaren On-brand Instagram-Content mit KI erstellen

Wähle eine unserer Marken – Endo, Vera oder isi – und entwickle mithilfe von KI mehrere CI-konforme Instagram-Assets.

Für uns zählt nicht nur, wie gut ein einzelner Post aussieht. Besonders spannend finden wir, wie du einen KI-gestützten Prozess aufsetzt, mit dem sich hochwertiger und konsistenter Content skalierbar produzieren lässt – und welche Ideen du dabei mitbringst.

Aufgabe

Erstelle mindestens drei fertige Instagram-Assets.

Dabei bist du in der Wahl der Formate flexibel. Zum Beispiel kannst du:

  • drei Carousels erstellen oder
  • unterschiedliche Formate kombinieren, z. B. Carousel, Single Post und Story

Abgabe

Bitte sende uns:

  • mindestens drei fertige Assets als JPG, PDF oder PPT
  • die verwendeten Prompts (keine Sorge: Die müssen nicht hübsch aufbereitet sein – Spracheingabe ist völlig in Ordnung)
  • eine Beschreibung deines technischen Setups und Workflows

Bonus: Du hast für die Aufgabe eine eigene Anwendung oder ein kleines Tool gebaut? Umso besser – dann zeig uns sehr gerne per Link, wie du damit Assets generierst.

Beantworte zudem kurz folgende Fragen:

  • Warum hast du genau diese KI-Tools und Modelle gewählt?
  • An welchen Stellen ist ein Human-in-the-Loop notwendig und warum?
  • Wie würdest du den Prozess auf 40–50 Assets pro Monat und mehrere Marken skalieren?

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

jobs.title: AI and Data Platforms Lead (1 year contract)
jobs.excerpt: BackgroundThe African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent.
jobs.description:
Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives

All African countries should have the capacities, resources, and tools to shape their own energy transitions. African Energy Futures (AEF), housed within the African Climate Foundation, will fund African institutions to build energy systems knowledge and tools that meet African needs; train the rising generation of African energy system analysts; strengthen local energy policy and decision-making; and ensure Africa plays a greater role in shaping energy research, policy, and investment.

Purpose

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) and African Energy Futures (AEF) are establishing a shared Strategic Data & Intelligence Unit to improve how African energy and development data are gathered, governed, analysed, visualised and used.

The unit will build and maintain an online data visualisation platform, develop compelling evidence-based narratives that can shift public and policy understanding, and provide strategic analytical services to grant-making and regranting organisations. It will work closely with Ember during the platform’s initial development, while progressively building independent African capability in data infrastructure, analysis and storytelling.

The initial four-person team is intentionally multidisciplinary. It combines strategic intelligence and philanthropy engagement, applied artificial intelligence and platform development, rigorous data science and governance, and sustained hands-on data acquisition and cleaning.

Scope of the role

Reporting to the Project Director, the AI & Data Platforms Lead will design and deliver the digital and AI-enabled capabilities of the unit. The role combines product thinking, data engineering, applied AI and practical software development. You will work with Ember and other partners to develop the online data storage and visualisation platform, create efficient data workflows, and identify responsible AI applications that improve research, grant-making, communications and knowledge management across ACF and AEF. This is an applied role: the successful candidate must be able to move from experimentation to reliable tools that colleagues can use.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Platform and product development

  • Lead the technical design, development and iterative improvement of the online data platform and visualisation tools.
  • Translate user needs into a prioritised product roadmap, prototypes, specifications and tested releases.
  • Work with Ember to adapt or integrate relevant platform components while building a pathway to independent ACF-AEF capability.
  • Design for accessibility, low-bandwidth use, maintainability, multilingual expansion and responsible open access where appropriate.
  • Implement analytics, usage monitoring and user-feedback processes to improve product relevance.

Data engineering and architecture

  • Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, versioning and publishing pipelines.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data from public, partner and internal sources using APIs, automated workflows and documented manual processes.
  • Collaborate with the Junior Data Scientist to implement validation, provenance, reproducibility, access control and release standards.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-code repositories, testing processes, backups and business-continuity arrangements.

Applied AI and automation

  • Identify, prototype and deploy useful AI applications for data discovery, extraction, classification, cleaning, summarisation, visualisation, research and internal knowledge management.
  • Develop retrieval, search and assisted-analysis tools that connect users to trusted ACF-AEF data and evidence.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy choices and select appropriate open-source or commercial tools.
  • Create human-in-the-loop evaluation processes to manage hallucination, bias, confidentiality, intellectual-property and security risks.
  • Monitor relevant AI developments and provide practical briefings, demonstrations and guidance to ACF and AEF teams.
  • User enablement and collaboration
  • Work closely with analysts, programme teams, communications colleagues and external users to understand workflows and adoption barriers.
  • Provide training, templates and technical support that help colleagues use AI and data tools safely and effectively.
  • Manage technical vendors and contributors where necessary and conduct appropriate code and security reviews.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, data engineering, information systems, software engineering, computational science or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in software, data-platform, data-engineering or applied-AI roles, including delivery of user-facing tools.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with APIs and databases, and familiarity with modern web-based data visualisation approaches.
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, version control, testing and secure data workflows.
  • Hands-on experience applying large language models or machine-learning tools to real organisational use cases.
  • Ability to explain technical choices, risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with open-data platforms, geospatial data, energy data, development indicators or public-interest technology.
  • Knowledge of data protection, cybersecurity, AI governance and model evaluation in nonprofit or research environments.
  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple African countries and variable digital infrastructure.

Start date: Position available immediately.

Location: ACF’s operational hub is in Cape Town, South Africa. Remote working will be considered for candidates based on the African continent.

Contract duration: 12 months (renewable based on mutual agreement and project success).

Closing date: 4 October 2026.

Application Details:

  • Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where they are based.

Should you not hear back from us by 30 November 2026, please consider your application to be unsuccessful.

The ACF strives to be an equitable organisation with a team which reflects the diversity of Africa.

In compliance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), The ACF assures all applicants that any personal information provided during the recruitment process will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and used solely for recruitment purposes. Your privacy and data security are of paramount importance to us. By applying for this position, you consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal information for recruitment-related activities only. The ACF is committed to safeguarding your privacy and maintaining the trust you place in us.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$125,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP) with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.
