About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to reach physicians, practice owners, office managers, and other healthcare decision-makers

  • Support organic marketing and local-market growth initiatives

  • Help develop physician-facing messaging, success stories, testimonials, and other materials that strengthen Pillar's value proposition

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

You will help convert interested medical practices into active Pillar partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting or facilitating discovery calls with prospective physician partners

  • Explaining Pillar's services and patient-support model confidently

  • Communicating fees, billing structure, workflow, and partnership expectations clearly

  • Understanding the prospective practice's needs and identifying how Pillar can support them

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Serve as a key operational contact for physician partners

  • Monitor feedback from physicians and patients and take appropriate action

  • Coordinate with dietitians, virtual trainers, administrative staff, and virtual assistants

  • Support thoughtful matching between patients, dietitians, and virtual trainers when appropriate

  • Monitor patient engagement and identify concerns before they become escalations

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

  • Help establish appropriate check-ins across the patient, dietitian, trainer, and physician relationship

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide concise updates on projects, priorities, wins, risks, and unresolved issues

  • Explain not only what happened, but why it happened

  • Present recommended next steps and anticipated outcomes

  • Bring thoughtful options instead of open-ended problems

  • Negotiate priorities, expectations, and timelines when necessary

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

  • Maintain transparency even when progress is slower than expected

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

Pillar wants AI to become a practical part of how the business operates.

You will:

  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing workflows

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

Although growth is an immediate priority, you will also help strengthen Pillar's operational foundation.

This may include:

  • Monitoring business and client KPIs

  • Improving workflows as operational gaps become visible

  • Maintaining accurate client, physician, patient, billing, and reporting information

  • Supporting consistent naming conventions and documentation

  • Reviewing processes for accuracy and efficiency

  • Creating or improving SOPs when a documented process is genuinely needed

  • Supporting scheduling, invoicing, reporting, and administrative coordination

  • Helping the company prepare operationally as the number of physician partners and patients increases

As Pillar grows, the scope of the position may expand into greater leadership and team-management responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of relevant experience across business operations, executive support, business development, customer success, healthcare operations, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leaders, founders, executives, physicians, or business owners

  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills

  • Ability to manage several responsibilities simultaneously in a startup or rapidly changing environment

  • Experience solving problems independently without waiting for detailed instructions

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Confidence facilitating meetings and business conversations

  • Ability to organize information and communicate progress clearly

  • Strong judgment when dealing with sensitive or difficult conversations

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and processes independently

  • Practical experience using AI tools for business or productivity

  • High attention to detail, particularly where client information, billing, reporting, or financial accuracy is involved

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting a startup founder or small-business owner

  • Exposure to physician acquisition or healthcare business development

Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values

We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.

What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team with a passion for learning, operating, and creating new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about every customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and we strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as a leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success into the digital space, ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We’re looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to own technical direction for backend capabilities within the Promos domain, working within our shared service and cloud ecosystem. You will solve complex distributed systems problems, guide the evolution of APIs, events, data, and services, and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code.

Working across Product, Mobile, Web, Data, QA, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Principal level impact means creating clarity beyond one team, developing other engineers, and being accountable for organizational outcomes, not only implementation.

Your responsibilities will include:

Technical strategy and architecture

  • Own backend technical direction for the assigned product domain, such as Promos, while aligning with shared platform, cloud, data, and service standards.

  • Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers and teams that own shared capabilities such as identity, payments, compliance, messaging, and platform services, integrating those capabilities while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.

  • Guide architecture evolution and modernization, balancing product delivery, technical debt, scalability, and platform investment through pragmatic decisions, clear tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead major restructuring work through planned iterative delivery: establish the target end state before execution, decompose the initiative into sequenced tickets, surface dependencies and risks, and provide credible delivery dates that are updated as evidence changes.

Promotional and backend capabilities

  • Build scalable and reliable promotion lifecycle capabilities, including configuration, eligibility, activation, state transitions, rewards, expiration, auditability, idempotency, and recovery.

  • Partner with Product, Mobile, Web, Back Office, Data, and Operations to define service boundaries, API and event contracts, experimentation, success measures, and operational controls.

  • Design resilient services for high traffic and transaction volume, using appropriate data consistency, caching, asynchronous processing, rate controls, and graceful degradation strategies.

Execution, quality, and operations

  • Remain hands on with the hardest problems, turning ambiguity into iterative delivery while delegating effectively and correcting work that is off course or not producing value.

  • Model and raise a high bar for code review, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, shared understanding, and engineer growth, and advance standards for testing, API design, security, observability, performance, CI/CD, controlled rollout, data migration, and production readiness.

  • Lead diagnosis across services, APIs, databases, caches, queues, and event streams using correlated logs, traces, and metrics, turning incidents into systemic improvements.

AI enabled engineering

  • Drive responsible adoption of AI assisted development across discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and review, measuring improvements to quality, speed, learning, and developer experience.

  • Identify valuable product and operational uses for AI, assess feasibility and model risk, and establish guardrails for evaluation, confidential data, human accountability, and production safety.

Organizational impact and culture

  • Act proactively as a trusted technical advisor to Product and Engineering teams, identifying risks and opportunities early and using customer, operational, and market insight to make clear recommendations and drive decisions to closure.

  • Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architectural guidance, reviews, pairing, and reusable knowledge, and contribute technical perspective to senior hiring, capability planning, and career development.

  • Resolve systemic risks, ownership gaps, and missing capabilities by bringing the right people together, and lead change with calm ownership, constructive conflict, clear commitments, and learning without blame.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing and operating distributed backend systems, plus a degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.

  • Deep expertise with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, with a record of establishing patterns and standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Strong AWS knowledge and experience building scalable, resilient applications across multiple regions and availability zones.

  • Experience with streaming technologies such as Amazon Kinesis or Kafka and messaging systems such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.

  • Experience designing microservice and service oriented architectures and operating containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong judgment around high volume systems, concurrency, idempotency, caching, asynchronous workflows, failure recovery, and backward compatible API and event evolution.

  • A record of shaping technical and product strategy, delivering ambiguous multi team initiatives, communicating clearly with senior stakeholders, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.

Preferred experience:

  • Experience in sportsbook, casino, online gaming, fintech, banking, or another regulated digital industry.

  • Experience building promotion, loyalty, offer, reward, experimentation, or customer engagement platforms.

  • Experience scaling engineering through shared libraries, developer platforms, service templates, internal tooling, or production AI practices.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

Roster of Uniques

jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

Location: This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open-source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high-quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Tekst- en videotherapie

ifeel | Internationaal platform voor mentale gezondheid

ifeel is een wereldwijd platform voor mentale gezondheid, actief in meer dan 90 landen. We werken vanuit een evidence-based klinische aanpak en zetten ons in voor het mentale welzijn van medewerkers.

We zijn op zoek naar Nederlandstalige GZ-psychologen met een geldige BIG-registratie die deel willen uitmaken van ons internationale netwerk en cliënten in Nederland flexibele, vertrouwelijke en hoogwaardige psychologische ondersteuning willen bieden.

Als GZ-psycholoog bij ifeel kun je cliënten ondersteunen via twee complementaire vormen van online therapie:

Videotherapie: online sessies van 40 minuten, die je inplant op basis van je eigen beschikbaarheid.

Teksttherapie: asynchrone schriftelijke communicatie waarmee je cliënten op een flexibele en doorlopende manier kunt ondersteunen.

Je wordt onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en krijgt toegang tot evidence-based klinische tools, ondersteuning van ons ervaren Clinical Team en een continue instroom van cliënten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise.

Vereisten

  • Een bachelor- en masterdiploma in de psychologie, bij voorkeur met een klinische specialisatie.
  • Een afgeronde postmasteropleiding tot GZ-psycholoog.
  • Een geldige BIG-registratie als GZ-psycholoog in Nederland.
  • Ervaring met psychologische begeleiding, psychotherapie of andere vormen van geestelijke gezondheidszorg.
  • Professionele beheersing van het Nederlands.

  • Culturele sensitiviteit en ervaring met internationale of multiculturele cliënten zijn een pré.

  • Ervaring met telehealth, online therapie of digitale zorgplatforms.

  • Goede beheersing van het Engels en eventuele andere talen is een pré.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

  • Modern online therapieplatform: Werk met geavanceerde digitale tools die zijn ontwikkeld om hoogwaardige psychologische zorg te ondersteunen.
  • Eenvoudig cliëntbeheer: Richt je op je cliënten, terwijl wij zorgen voor de instroom van cliënten en administratieve ondersteuning. Je hoeft geen marketingkosten te maken of een eigen website op te zetten.
  • Concurrerende vergoeding: Ontvang een passende vergoeding voor jouw professionele expertise.
  • Doorlopende training en ondersteuning: Profiteer van regelmatige trainingen, klinische begeleiding en mogelijkheden voor verdere professionele ontwikkeling.
  • Internationale community: Word onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en werk samen met collega's van over de hele wereld.
  • Betekenisvol werk: Maak een verschil binnen een groeiende en dynamische organisatie die zich inzet om mentale gezondheidszorg toegankelijker te maken.

We stellen je interesse om je bij ifeel aan te sluiten zeer op prijs.

ifeel is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Wij beoordelen alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten ongeacht ras, huidskleur, religie, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, genderidentiteit, nationaliteit, beperking of enige andere wettelijk beschermde eigenschap.

Vanwege het grote aantal sollicitaties nemen wij alleen contact op met kandidaten die worden geselecteerd voor de volgende fase van de procedure.

Alle informatie die je met ons deelt, wordt vertrouwelijk behandeld en uitsluitend gebruikt voor werving en selectie. Je cv en eventuele aanvullende documenten worden verwerkt in overeenstemming met de toepasselijke privacywetgeving en maximaal twee (2) jaar na afronding van de sollicitatieprocedure bewaard, tenzij anders overeengekomen. jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on navigating social media and digital spaces wisely. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A formational, theology-of-technology book that examines how social media affects our attention, desires, and identity, offering a vision for faithful digital discipleship.
  • A highly practical guide or handbook that addresses specific digital struggles, such as navigating digital distraction, setting healthy boundaries/screen time rhythms, dealing with online conflict and outrage, or curating a life-giving, Christ-honoring online presence.
  • A well-researched, data-backed guide book that bridges the intersection of science and biblical truth. This project would examine the verified psychological, neurological, and sociological impacts of digital media consumption and integrate those scientific insights with Scripture to offer an evidence-based, biblically grounded roadmap for holistic digital health.

The ideal project will combine sharp cultural insight with rich biblical truth to offer genuine gospel hope, wisdom, and freedom for the digital age.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

About World Business Lenders

  • At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States — particularly those facing difficulties with traditional financing. We're a fast-moving, results-driven organization that takes security seriously as we continue to grow.

Role Overview

  • Provide executive leadership and legal oversight for the Company’s Asset Resolution Department function, directing nationwide default litigation and other legal recovery strategies, overseeing Asset Resolution counsel, managing outside counsel relationships, and supporting portfolio performance and operational execution for non-performing commercial business loans secured by real estate.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements

  • Lead comprehensive legal recovery strategies across foreclosure (judicial and non-judicial), bankruptcy, lawsuits involving breach of note and guaranty, title claims, receivership, loan workouts, deed-in-lieu transactions, judgment enforcement, and collateral liquidation.
  • Provide executive oversight and direction to the Asset Resolution legal team, currently consisting of 10 Asset Resolution counsel and 6 support staff, while maintaining accountability for legal strategy, workload distribution, performance, and consistency of execution.
  • Oversee the legal management of an active portfolio of approximately 342 Asset Resolution cases, with each Asset Resolution counsel managing an average of approximately 35 active matters.
  • Oversee nationwide outside counsel by setting litigation strategy, managing legal spending, monitoring performance, reviewing legal invoices, coordinating payment of law firm invoices, and ensuring alignment with Company objectives and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage relationships with existing outside law firms and identify, evaluate, retain, and oversee new law firms to represent WBL in foreclosure, bankruptcy, litigation, title, and other Asset Resolution matters.
  • Partner with Executive Leadership, Credit, Servicing, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to assess portfolio risk, prioritize recovery strategies, and maximize returns on distressed assets.
  • Provide legal oversight of preservation, insurance compliance, lien protection, title matters, and disposition strategies for commercial real estate securing business loans.
  • Oversee complex enforcement matters involving deficiency judgments, guarantor collections, fraudulent transfers, bankruptcy proceedings, and contested foreclosure actions without directly managing individual cases.
  • Negotiate and oversee settlements, restructurings, loan modifications, discounted payoffs, and other resolution strategies that balance recovery objectives, litigation risk, and cost discipline.
  • Support submissions to the Asset Resolution Committee and Executive Leadership, including settlement proposals and bidding instructions associated with foreclosure sales, in coordination with designated Asset Resolution Committee representatives.
  • Develop executive reporting and portfolio analytics that deliver actionable insight into recovery performance, legal expenditures, asset aging, recoveries, charge-offs, litigation trends, and portfolio performance.
  • Establish policies, procedures, performance metrics, and accountability standards that strengthen operational consistency, reporting accuracy, portfolio visibility, legal risk management, and outside counsel performance.

Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 Asset Resolution counsels and 6 support staff responsible for the nationwide management and legal resolution of approximately 342 active distressed commercial loan matters.

Professional Experience

  • Demonstrated experience managing or overseeing a high-volume litigation portfolio, including the ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, identify risk, monitor deadlines, and maintain consistent quality across hundreds of active matters.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Foundry Integration Engineer to lead the development and maturation of our silicon photonic fabrication processes through close partnership with external commercial foundries. In this highly cross‑functional role, you will own integration strategy, accelerate learning through structured experimentation, and help drive our technologies from development into stable, ramped production.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of device physics, materials, and manufacturing—coordinating across internal design, modeling, and systems teams while serving as a key technical interface to our external foundry partners.
As a Senior Foundry Integration Engineer at Photonic you'll directly shape how quickly and reliably we learn, scale, and deliver. You will help establish development priorities, improve reproducibility, and enable scaling of Photonic’s quantum compute systems.
Please include a cover letter with your resume (in one file) describing how you would be a great fit at Photonic and what attributes you could bring to our growing team.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

  • Own and execute process integration plans across external commercial foundries to mature and stabilize fabrication flows.
  • Define, organize, and drive experiments to accelerate learning and drive product performance.
  • Design experiments, analyze fabrication and measurement results, and synthesize data into clear technical conclusions.
  • Define next step process improvements and development priorities based on experimental outcomes.
  • Lead technical engagement with foundries, including aligning on integration intent, process assumptions, and learning objectives.
  • Translate system level and device level requirements into actionable fabrication strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams across nanofabrication, design, modeling, yield, and systems to produce chips supporting our core technology.
  • Ultimately drive successful production ramp of chips through improved yield, reproducibility, and process robustness.

WHAT YOU BRING TO OUR TEAM

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ years of industry experience in process integration, semiconductor fabrication, or related roles.
  • Hands‑on experience working in or with a commercial semiconductor foundry.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor process integration, unit processes, and cross‑module interactions in both foundry and university cleanrooms.
  • Experience and intuition in silicon photonics fabrication and design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze data, and drive data‑informed technical decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working across organizational and company boundaries.
An exceptional candidate will bring:
  • Experience supporting semiconductor technologies through development into production ramp.
  • Familiarity with advanced photonic, electronic, or heterogeneous integration platforms.
  • Prior experience serving as a technical interface between internal R&D teams and external manufacturing partners.
  • Track record of accelerating learning cycles in complex fabrication environments.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK WITH US

  • Work closely with some of the brightest innovators in quantum technologies to drive breakthroughs that redefine computing
  • Enjoy a fast-paced and fun environment where you can try new things while solving innovative challenges every day
  • Inclusive company culture that values collaboration

Descrição do trabalho

Atua no desenvolvimento e evolução dos componentes web do SDK unificado, garantindo a captura, validação e transmissão segura de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, como imagens, documentos e sensores, preservando sua integridade durante toda a jornada até os serviços de backend.

É responsável pela implementação de mecanismos avançados de proteção contra fraudes digitais, incluindo detecção de injeção de conteúdo, adulteração de sessões, automação maliciosa e execução em ambientes virtualizados ou navegadores não confiáveis. Trabalha diretamente na camada cliente, considerada uma das superfícies mais críticas de exposição a ataques.

Colabora com equipes de Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Plataforma e Produto para transformar requisitos de segurança, confiabilidade e conformidade em soluções escaláveis e prontas para produção. Atua continuamente na otimização de performance, compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos, observabilidade e telemetria, contribuindo para aumentar os níveis de confiança e assertividade dos motores de decisão de risco e fraude.

  • Participar da definição de arquitetura, padrões de desenvolvimento e estratégias de segurança para aplicações client-side.
  • Conduzir revisões de código e apoiar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Investigar vulnerabilidades e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos mecanismos de prevenção a fraude e abuso.
  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura e funcionamento interno de navegadores modernos.
  • Experiência com frameworks modernos de front-end como React, Angular ou Vue.js.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web, incluindo OWASP Top 10, CSP, CORS, XSS, CSRF e autenticação segura.
  • Experiência com WebAuthn, fingerprinting de dispositivos e mecanismos de proteção client-side.
  • Conhecimento em detecção de automação de navegadores, ambientes virtualizados, emuladores e ferramentas de scraping.
  • Experiência na integração entre aplicações web e SDKs nativos mobile ou desktop.
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, protocolos de comunicação segura e criptografia aplicada.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, monitoramento e análise de logs.
  • Vivência com processos de desenvolvimento ágil e práticas de DevSecOps.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em produtos de identidade digital, biometria ou prevenção à fraude.
  • Conhecimento em WebAssembly (WASM).
  • Experiência com análise comportamental e device intelligence.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de anti-tampering, anti-debugging e proteção de código cliente.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e aplicações com requisitos críticos de segurança.
  • Conhecimento de soluções de captura documental, prova de vida ou onboarding digital.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de SDKs multiplataforma.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Mentalidade voltada para segurança, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação para interação com times multidisciplinares.

jobs.description:
Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens

Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast-growing B2B brands, YC & Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market through predictable, scalable outbound systems.

We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to own and evolve our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts.

This is a hands-on senior role sitting at the intersection of data, automation, AI, deliverability, intent signals, and outbound strategy. Beyond building systems yourself, you’ll help set technical standards, introduce new GTM technologies, and mentor other team members.

This is a full-time, remote role, working EU hours.

About the role

You’ll work closely with GTM Strategists, Campaign Managers, and other GTM Engineers to architect scalable outbound systems from ICP definition through campaign execution and reporting.

You’ll own complex Clay workflows, data infrastructure, intent and signal-based targeting, automation, and deliverability, while continuously testing new AI and GTM tools that can improve our results.

We’re looking for someone who can not only build great systems, but also lead technically, challenge existing processes, and help raise the standard of the wider team.

What you’ll do ✨

  • Architect end-to-end outbound systems, from ICP and TAM definition through enrichment, sequencing, CRM sync, and performance reporting
  • Build and optimize advanced Clay workflows, including enrichment waterfalls, Claygent, AI columns, conditional logic, and custom API integrations
  • Own and improve email deliverability infrastructure, including domains, inbox health, sending infrastructure, authentication, reputation, and scaling best practices
  • Design intent and signal-based outbound systems using signals such as job changes, funding, hiring activity, website intent, technology adoption, social activity, and other buying signals
  • Build automation workflows with n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks
  • Use AI and LLMs to improve prospect research, qualification, personalization, data processing, and campaign workflows
  • Continuously explore and test new AI and GTM technologies, identifying tools and approaches that can give SalesCaptain and our clients an advantage
  • Write lightweight Python or JavaScript and work directly with APIs when no-code tools aren’t enough
  • Partner with GTM Strategists to improve targeting, campaign architecture, and outbound performance
  • Establish best practices and documentation for GTM engineering workflows
  • Mentor junior and mid-level GTM Engineers, review workflows, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team develop technically
  • Proactively identify inefficient processes and design better, more scalable solutions

Requirements

Who you are ❤️‍🔥

You should have:

  • 3+ years of experience in GTM Engineering, RevOps, outbound operations, growth engineering, or a closely related role
  • Strong hands-on experience building outbound systems in a B2B SaaS, GTM agency, consultancy, or fast-moving technology environment
  • Advanced experience with Clay, including complex enrichment workflows, Claygent, AI columns, waterfalls, and APIs
  • Strong understanding of email deliverability, sending infrastructure, domain reputation, authentication, and inbox health
  • Experience designing campaigns around intent data and buying signals, rather than relying only on static prospect lists
  • Strong knowledge of the modern GTM tooling ecosystem and genuine curiosity around emerging AI and automation tools
  • Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, automation platforms, and basic Python or JavaScript
  • A strong commercial mindset — you understand ICPs, messaging, outbound performance, pipeline, and why targeting decisions matter
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design systems rather than simply execute predefined tasks
  • Experience mentoring, supporting, or reviewing the work of other team members
  • Excellent English communication skills (C1–C2), with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Tech, SaaS, or B2B software companies

We’re also open to candidates coming from RevOps, growth engineering, Clay consulting, outbound operations, or highly technical SDR/BDR backgrounds who have transitioned into systems building.

What good looks like

You are successful in this role if:

  • GTM Strategists trust the systems and data you build without needing to recheck everything
  • Our outbound infrastructure remains scalable, reliable, and deliverability-safe
  • Intent signals help us identify better prospects and improve campaign timing
  • Clay and automation workflows are clean, efficient, documented, and cost-effective
  • You regularly introduce new AI, automation, and GTM approaches that improve how the team works
  • You identify problems before they become bottlenecks
  • Other GTM Engineers improve through your mentoring and technical guidance
  • You help the team move faster while maintaining a high standard of data and execution quality

This role is not for you if

  • You have never used Clay or similar GTM automation tools
  • Your outbound experience is limited to basic LinkedIn scraping or list building
  • You have little understanding of email deliverability
  • You prefer executing instructions rather than designing systems and proposing improvements
  • You are not interested in experimenting with new AI and GTM technologies
  • You are uncomfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems
  • You do not enjoy mentoring or sharing knowledge with other team members

Benefits

In addition to joining a fast-growing GTM team, we offer:

  • Remote work
  • Collaborative, friendly, and ambitious team
  • Paid vacation, days off, and sick leave
  • Team-building activities
  • Free books and Kindles to support your development
  • Specialized training and access to leading GTM tools
  • Opportunity to work with international B2B brands, startups, and scaleups
  • Hands-on exposure to emerging AI, automation, data, and GTM technologies
  • Significant autonomy to experiment, introduce new tools, and influence how our GTM infrastructure evolves
  • Opportunity to mentor others and play a key role in developing the GTM Engineering function

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager DACH (m/w/d) – Teilzeit / Contractor

Wir suchen eine strukturierte und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden in der DACH-Region unterstützt und ihnen hilft, das volle Potenzial von Abler zu nutzen.

Die Rolle startet in Teilzeit (ca. 10–20 Stunden pro Woche) und bietet die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Wachstum in der Region weiter zu wachsen.

Abler wird bereits von Organisationen im Umfeld von Clubs wie Chelsea F.C., Newcastle United oder Barcelona genutzt. In England arbeiten wir mit rund 40% der Clubs aus den Top 4 Ligen zusammen. Auch in Deutschland haben wir bereits erste Kunden und bauen unsere Präsenz weiter aus.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir eine sehr starke Value Proposition haben und echten Mehrwert für Sportorganisationen schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, diese Qualität und Struktur auch im Breitensport verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du die richtige Einstellung und Motivation mitbringst, unterstützen wir dich mit allem, was du brauchst, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Die Rolle

  • Du arbeitest eng mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass sie Abler erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Dazu gehören das Onboarding neuer Vereine, die Unterstützung im täglichen Umgang mit der Plattform sowie die Beantwortung von Fragen.
  • Du bist Teil unseres Customer Success und Support Teams und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen. Gleichzeitig hilfst du aktiv dabei, unseren Ansatz für Kundenbetreuung und Implementierung im DACH-Markt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sammelst Feedback aus dem Markt und bringst es in unser Produktteam ein, um sowohl das Produkt als auch unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Je nach Interesse kann die Rolle auch Aufgaben im Bereich Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung umfassen, z. B. bei der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden oder erster Business-Development-Aktivitäten.
  • Gelegentlich können auch persönliche Besuche bei Kunden Teil der Rolle sein.

Arbeitsweise

  • Remote-first Rolle (Arbeiten von zu Hause)
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der Teilzeit
  • Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung von Co-Working-Spaces je nach Bedarf
  • Gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Vereine und Begleitung beim Setup
  • Unterstützung von Kunden im täglichen Einsatz von Abler
  • Beantwortung von Fragen und Sicherstellung einer positiven Nutzungserfahrung
  • Sammeln und Weitergeben von Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam
  • Mitgestaltung unserer Prozesse für Customer Success und Implementierung in DACH
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Hilfsmaterialien und Guides
  • Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung bei Bedarf

Das bringst du mit

  • Freude daran, Menschen zu helfen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Bezug zum Sport (z. B. als Spieler, Trainer oder im Verein)
  • Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Tools (Du musst nicht hoch technisch sein, solltest aber offen sein, neue Systeme zu lernen (wir schulen dich auf Abler)
  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wohnsitz in der DACH-Region
  • Erfahrung mit Abler ist ein Plus
  • Spanischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus (Unterstützung in anderen Märkten möglich)

Das erwartet dich

  • Flexible Teilzeitrolle mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Remote-Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Unterstützung bei Co-Working-Space möglich
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Klare Prozesse, Einarbeitung und Unterstützung
  • Möglichkeit, aktiv Einfluss auf Produkt und Arbeitsweise zu nehmen

Über Abler

Abler entwickelt das Betriebssystem für Sportorganisationen.

Unsere Plattform wurde in Island entwickelt, einem Land mit einem der stärksten organisierten Sportsysteme weltweit. Island gilt international als Vorzeigemodell für erfolgreiche Sportentwicklung. Heute nutzen rund 75 % der gesamten Isländishen Bevölkerung Abler im Kontext von Sport - alles vom Breitensport bis hin zu professionellen Strukturen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Sportorganisationen besser zu machen und dadurch die Entwicklung von Menschen und Gemeinschaften durch Sport zu fördern.

Sport matters.

. Alle Bewerbungen werden vertraulich behandelt.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un Chef de projet SAP S/4HANA senior pour piloter un projet de mise à niveau de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA vers une version plus récente. La personne sera responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de l’exécution complète de l’upgrade, de la préparation initiale jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation post-déploiement.

Le mandat évolue dans une grande organisation de plus de 10 000 employés, au sein d’un environnement complexe et fortement réglementé. Le Chef de projet travaillera avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes, notamment SAP, BASIS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, équipes d’affaires, partenaires et fournisseurs.

Exigences principales

  • 10+ années d’expérience en gestion de projets SAP.
  • Expérience concrète dans la gestion de mises à niveau SAP S/4HANA, idéalement d’une version 2020/2021 vers 2023 ou plus récente.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la méthodologie SAP Activate.
  • Expérience importante dans les domaines Supply Chain et Manufacturing.
  • Expérience dans une organisation de plus de 10 000 employés.
  • Expérience de projets SAP globaux impliquant plusieurs équipes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes.
  • Expérience en environnement hautement réglementé.
  • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires simultanément.
  • Expérience importante dans la planification et le pilotage des tests, cutover et mises en production.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la gouvernance de projet, notamment échéanciers, budgets, jalons, dépendances et registres RAID.
  • Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes techniques, les responsables d’affaires et la haute direction.

Atouts

Une expérience en custom code remediation lors d’un upgrade S/4HANA est particulièrement pertinente. Une bonne compréhension de SAP BASIS et de l’architecture SAP, ainsi qu’une expérience de tests à grande échelle et de périodes d’hypercare/stabilisation post-go-live, constituent également des atouts.

Les certifications PMP, PRINCE2 ou SAP sont appréciées.

Responsabilités principales

Le Chef de projet prendra en charge le plan détaillé de la mise à niveau SAP, incluant les échéanciers, ressources, jalons, risques, enjeux et dépendances. Il pilotera les différentes phases du projet selon SAP Activate, notamment la préparation, le Sandbox, le développement, l’assurance qualité, les tests et la mise en production.

Il coordonnera les campagnes de tests intégrés, de régression et de performance, ainsi que la stratégie et l’exécution du cutover. Il sera également responsable de la coordination entre les équipes SAP/BASIS, les responsables des processus d’affaires, les équipes Supply Chain et Manufacturing ainsi que les différents fournisseurs.

La personne assurera la gouvernance du projet, le contrôle des changements, le suivi des risques et la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction. Elle contribuera également à la gestion du changement, à la formation, à la documentation et à la période de stabilisation suivant la mise en production.

jobs.title: Senior Database Administrator
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates with passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interactions, experiences, behavior, and insights, and we strive to ensure we always act authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space. Ready to join us?

What's the position?

Every bet and payout at Hard Rock Digital is a database transaction that has to be fast and accurate. A casino game resolves in milliseconds; settling a big sporting event moves millions of balances at once, and none can be wrong.

We're hiring a Senior Database Administrator to own production reliability for our CockroachDB and PostgreSQL fleet. You'll diagnose contention, range hotspots, retry storms, plan regressions, and cross-region latency in systems that move money at scale. You'll read execution plans and reason about the optimizer that produced them, inspect database internals when behavior doesn't match the docs, write Go and Python tooling that makes the next incident faster to solve, and set standards that application engineers rely on under pressure.

Claude Code, Codex, and similar AI harnesses are part of how this team works. You'll use them to investigate incidents, generate probes, summarize evidence, and turn one-off debugging into durable tooling. The goal is to spend less time on toil and more on the work that compounds: better defaults, safer migrations, and tooling that makes the next incident shorter than the last.

What You'll Do

Reliability & Performance

  • Operate and evolve multi-region CockroachDB clusters and PostgreSQL instances across production, staging, and development.

  • Investigate contention, serialization retries (SQLSTATE 40001), and range hotspots in the transaction paths behind bets, wagers, settlements, and payouts.

  • Diagnose leaseholder placement, monotonic-key write pressure, and cross-region latency that turn one query into several network round trips.

  • Trace a slow query to its execution plan, the plan to optimizer behavior, and the behavior to the schema or application call path that caused it.

  • Catch plan regressions after statistics changes, schema changes, data growth, or releases, then turn the fix into a safer rollout pattern.

  • Assess schema-change and backfill risk before it reaches large tables: lock behavior, retry pressure, capacity impact, and rollback path.

  • Plan capacity, scaling events, and version upgrades that customers don't feel.

Observability & Incident Response

  • Build database observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, and Snowflake: dashboards backed by real queries, alerting on leading indicators, and SLO tracking.

  • Connect database symptoms to application behavior and business events so alerts point at causes.

  • Join the on-call rota for the data layer, lead incident analysis when the database is part of the failure, and drive blameless postmortems toward durable fixes.

  • Instrument the system to surface degradation before it becomes an incident.

Automation & Tooling

  • Build Go and Python tools that make incidents easier to understand: log collectors, explain-plan analyzers, migration checks, capacity models, and runbook generators.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, backup, and recovery with Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools.

  • Work with platform engineering on CI/CD, deployment safety, and change management for database-touching services.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Use Claude Code, Codex, and similar harnesses in daily work to investigate incidents, generate probes, draft runbooks, and write tooling.

  • Keep the harness grounded in logs, traces, metrics, and source code, and verify its output against production facts before you ship it.

  • Evaluate AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection, and share what works with the team.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and audit access controls, authentication, authorization, and encryption in transit and at rest.

  • Support data-protection, audit-logging, and retention requirements for a regulated gaming platform.

Standards & Mentorship

  • Build a database center of excellence: documentation, standards, and reusable patterns that other teams build against.

  • Mentor engineers on database fundamentals, distributed-systems behavior, and operational discipline.

  • Read CockroachDB and PostgreSQL internals when a problem needs a code-level answer, and bring what you learn back to the team.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years operating production relational databases as a DBA, Database Reliability Engineer, or Data Platform Engineer.

  • Deep production experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, or another relational database management system, with fluency in the tradeoffs behind isolation, consensus, locality, and query planning.

  • You understand how a SQL engine works under the hood: MVCC, the Volcano iterator execution model, and cost-based optimizer frameworks such as Cascades. You apply that knowledge to indexing strategy and to execution plan analysis.

  • Working knowledge of distributed-systems fundamentals: consensus (Raft and Paxos), distributed transactions, consistency models, and failure modes.

  • You write tools and automation in Python or Go, and you can debug and suggest fixes to line-of-business code in Java or a similar language.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and a monitoring and observability stack such as Grafana or Datadog.

  • UNIX/Linux administration with shell scripting, comfort on a cloud platform (AWS preferred, Azure, or GCP welcome), and willingness to join an on-call rota.

  • Clear technical writing and speech. You'll work across teams.

What You've Done

The strongest candidates show evidence here, not a checklist.

  • Shipped Go or Python tooling for database operations, performance analysis, migration safety, or incident response that other engineers then used.

  • Investigated production incidents end-to-end using metrics, logs, query fingerprints, execution plans, and source-level reasoning.

  • Owned a database platform through on-call, post-incident repair, standards, and cross-team adoption.

  • Used AI coding agents in real engineering work, with review habits that keep generated output tied to evidence.

  • Run CockroachDB in production.

  • Contributed to an open-source database such as PostgreSQL.

  • Worked with streaming infrastructure such as Kafka and Materialize.

  • Worked with a modern data warehouse or analytics platform such as ClickHouse Cloud or Snowflake.

  • Practiced SRE along the lines of the Google SRE books.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

  • Team gatherings around the US and Europe

  • Employer-sponsored training and conference attendance

  • Opportunity to work in an AI-first environment with access to the tools you need to excel at your job

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

jobs.description:
Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.graphitefinancial.com) built to help startup and high-growth companies scale efficiently and sustainably. Graphite Financial is redefining the “finance department” for early-stage companies and VC-backed startups. We deliver high-caliber accounting and finance leadership and support to entrepreneurs and management teams building scalable, high-growth companies. Our clients are actively managing cash burn, measuring performance, reporting to investors, making capital allocation decisions, and preparing for fundraising. All of that takes expertise and time that founders don’t have and can’t afford to hire for. Graphite bridges the gap with flexible, fixed-fee support packages that provide fractional leadership and operational support from CFOs, Controllers, FP&A Managers, and Tax leaders.

ROLE PURPOSE

Ensure high-quality, consistent client delivery across an assigned team of CPG-focused Client Leads and staff by enabling, coaching, and coordinating their work. The Accounting Senior Manager — CPG Team Lead is accountable for team effectiveness across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods clients — not just individual client outcomes. This role requires both delivery leadership and people leadership, and carries formal responsibilities for performance reviews, career coaching, and development planning.

CPG is a demanding vertical. Clients in this space deal with trade promotion complexity, multi-channel revenue structures, inventory and landed cost challenges, and margin pressure that requires precision at every level. The Team Lead must be fluent enough in CPG accounting to coach Client Leads through these challenges credibly — and to recognize quality work product when they review it.

WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED HERE

This is a fully remote leadership role within a client-facing professional services firm. You lead a team of Accounting Managers (Client Leads), Senior Associates, and Associates serving CPG clients who expect Graphite-quality accounting every month. The following qualities define what high performance looks like at this level.

•CPG Accounting Fluency: You understand CPG accounting at a practitioner level — trade spend, deductions, landed cost, inventory reconciliation, gross-to-net revenue across channels. You do not need to prepare every reconciliation yourself, but you need to review one and know immediately whether it is right.

•Leadership Without Proximity: You set clear expectations, provide consistent coaching, and hold your team accountable — entirely through remote communication and structured operating rhythms. Your presence is felt through the quality of what your team produces.

•Client Credibility: You maintain the technical depth and professional presence to engage senior CPG client contacts directly when needed. Your team’s standards reflect yours — invest in both.

•Coaching Over Fixing: Your job is to make Client Leads better — not to do their work for them. When something goes wrong on a CPG engagement, your first instinct is to coach, not to take over.

•Responsiveness at Scale: You model the responsiveness you expect from your team. Delayed decisions and slow escalations create client risk in a fast-moving industry. Move fast, communicate clearly, and resolve things.

•Accountability for Team Outcomes: You own what your team delivers across the CPG portfolio. You do not deflect to process or capacity. You identify problems early and solve them.

•Professional Standards Enforcement: You hold Client Leads and Associates to a high bar for written communication, client interaction, and deliverable quality. This is not optional in a remote, client-facing environment.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Enablement & Oversight

•Coach Client Leads on solution design, client management, delivery approach, and professional judgment across CPG engagements

•Review CPG client engagement approaches for technical risk, complexity — particularly around trade promotion accounting, inventory, and multi-channel revenue — or inconsistency with firm standards

•Serve as the first escalation point for delivery challenges, CPG-specific technical questions, and team capacity problems

•Ensure all work produced by the team meets Graphite’s quality standards before it reaches clients

People Leadership

•Conduct formal performance reviews and ongoing career development conversations with direct reports

•Identify CPG accounting capability gaps within the team and address them through coaching, targeted training, or resourcing decisions

•Build a team environment where Client Leads operate with confidence and accountability, not dependency

Capacity & Quality Management

•Balance workload across Client Leads and adjust resourcing to manage close peaks, seasonal CPG demand cycles, and coverage risks

•Drive execution consistency across the CPG client portfolio without creating bureaucratic overhead

•Ensure no CPG client engagement is a single point of failure — cross-training and documentation are standing expectations

Client Execution (Selective)

•Maintain a purposefully limited personal CPG - focused client book

•Use direct client execution to stay current on CPG accounting complexity, model the standards you set for your team, and remain credible as a coach and escalation resource

Cross-Team Coordination

•Partner with Standards and Technology teams to translate firm-wide standards into practical, CPG-ready execution within your team

•Surface recurring CPG delivery issues, client patterns, and improvement opportunities to the Director proactively

CLIENT INTERACTION

•Not a primary client contact in the standard operating model

•Engages directly with CPG clients during escalations, complex onboarding, or when providing real-time coaching to Client Leads on high-stakes situations

•Maintains the professional presence, CPG industry fluency, and technical credibility to represent Graphite confidently in any senior client conversation

QUALIFICATIONS

•Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA required

•7–10 years of accounting experience including at least 2 years in a client lead, manager, or team leadership role; public accounting (Manager level) or outsourced accounting leadership experience strongly preferred

•Demonstrated CPG accounting experience — this is a firm requirement. Candidates must be able to speak specifically to trade promotion accounting, inventory reconciliation, landed cost, and multi-channel COGS in a CPG context

•Familiarity with CPG-specific platforms and operational systems including QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Cin7, Shopify, and 3PL management systems preferred

•Deep working knowledge of GAAP with direct experience navigating startup-specific accounting complexity: SAFEs, convertible instruments, ASC 606, equity compensation, and more

•Demonstrated ability to manage a team and a client portfolio simultaneously without sacrificing quality on either

•Strong coaching and feedback skills — you have developed junior accounting professionals before and take that responsibility seriously

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills; executive presence in client-facing situations

•Experience working in a remote professional services environment is strongly preferred

Comprehensive Benefits & Perks:

  • Health & Wellness: Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. 100% of the employee's health insurance premium is covered by the company.
  • Financial Security: Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • Work/Life Balance To Include: Generous Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 Paid Company Holidays, and comprehensive Paid Parental Leave.
  • Remote Work Setup: Fully remote position with company-provided technology equipment and a $250 technology stipend to support your ideal home office setup.
  • 401k: With a company match
