jobs.excerpt: Description Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose.  Powered by Clinical Expertise.
jobs.description:
Description

Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise.

Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations.

Excellence starts with our people.

WE OFFER

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Benefits include healthcare, vision and dental insurance, a generous 401k match, paid vacation, personal time, and holidays.
  • Growth and training opportunities.
  • An award-winning remote work environment

﻿POSITION OVERVIEW

The Product Owner sits within the Product Organization and is accountable for product strategy, business requirements, roadmap planning, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, business readiness, and value delivery throughout the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and the Engineering, Architecture, and QA organizations, ensuring solutions are clearly defined, aligned to business objectives, and deliver measurable value. The Product Owner owns the requirements and prioritization decisions within their portfolio while collaborating closely with Architecture on technical feasibility, Engineering on delivery, and QA on release readiness.

Roles:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, requirements, UI design direction, business process definition, reporting and data requirements, and prioritization for an assigned portfolio of operations and utilization review tools
  • Serve as the accountable business owner for user acceptance testing, business readiness, and adoption of delivered solutions
  • Act as the primary point of consultation with the Architecture, Engineering, and QA organizations throughout the PDLC, per MRIoA's defined RACI operating model

Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

  • Monitor progress against roadmap commitments and adjust priorities as business needs change

Demand Intake and Portfolio Management:

  • Manage the intake process for new requests and enhancements, assessing business value, complexity, urgency, and dependencies
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions with stakeholders and document decisions regarding scope, priorities, and funding
  • Maintain visibility into active, pending, and future initiatives, and ensure alignment between business demand and available delivery capacity

Business Requirements Management:

  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, discovery workshops, and business process reviews with stakeholders • Document current-state and future-state business processes, and define functional, UI, data, reporting, integration, and non-functional requirements in sufficient detail for development to begin without ambiguity
  • Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and approved prior to development, and maintain traceability between requirements, user stories, testing, and delivered functionality
  • Manage changes to requirements throughout the project lifecycle

Backlog and User Story Management:

  • Create and maintain product backlogs, and define epics, features, and user stories that meet MRIoA's user story standards (business objective, user role, functional description, acceptance criteria, UI and data requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and success criteria)
  • Prioritize backlog items based on business value, and participate in backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions with Engineering
  • Clarify requirements throughout development and testing activities

Timeline and Release Planning:

  • Define business priorities and delivery expectations, and collaborate with Engineering and QA on estimates and delivery plans
  • Establish milestone and release targets, monitor roadmap execution and timeline adherence, and communicate schedule changes and impacts to stakeholders
  • Coordinate business readiness activities for releases

Risk and Change Management:

  • Identify business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder risks; assess impacts of delays, scope changes, and resource constraints; and develop mitigation plans for critical initiatives
  • Assess business impacts of proposed changes, manage stakeholder communication plans, and support organizational readiness and training/adoption activities
  • Escalate risks affecting delivery or business outcomes

User Acceptance Testing (UAT):

  • Coordinate business participation in UAT and validate solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Document business approvals and signoffs, facilitate defect review and prioritization with QA, and ensure business readiness prior to deployment

Release Readiness and Business Adoption:

  • Define release objectives and success measures, and coordinate stakeholder communication activities
  • Ensure training materials and job aids are available, validate operational readiness, and support production deployment activities
  • Measure adoption and business outcomes following release

Product Performance and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor product adoption and utilization, against business objectives
  • Gather stakeholder and user feedback, identify enhancement opportunities, and continuously improve products, processes, and user experience
  • Maintain long-term product strategy and roadmap for the assigned portfolio

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Consult with the Architecture organization on solution feasibility, technical standards, and nonfunctional requirements during discovery and design
  • Consult with the Engineering organization, including offshore development resources, during sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning; remain informed on vendor and offshore delivery governance, which is owned by Engineering
  • Consult with the QA organization on test strategy, acceptance criteria, and release readiness, and support QA-led production validation

Regulatory Compliance and Knowledge:

  • Possess a working knowledge of HIPAA, utilization review processes, and relevant healthcare regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance is reflected in business requirements

Requirements

﻿Skills:

  • Comfortable operating within a defined RACI model, collaborating with Architecture, Engineering, and QA organizations without owning their respective accountabilities
  • Working knowledge of Jira or similar tools for backlog management, sprint planning, and requirements traceability
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and dashboarding tools is preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of utilization review operations, healthcare regulatory requirements, and the Company's clients, products, and workflows

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Product Analyst
  • Experience in health insurance, healthcare, or managed care environments preferred; utilization management experience is a plus
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product backlog or roadmap and making prioritization decisions based on business value, risk, and cost
  • Strong experience writing detailed, testable business requirements (functional, UI, data, reporting, integration, and non-functional) and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Effectively coordinate UAT and business readiness activities, including stakeholder communication and training/adoption planning

﻿

﻿Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Product management or business analysis certification (such as CSPO, ECBA, or CCBA) is preferred but not required

Work Environment:

Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

Diversity Statement:

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

﻿

Drug-Free Workplace:

This company is a drug-free workplace. All candidates are required to pass a Background Screen before beginning employment. All newly hired employees will take a Drug Screen, as well as agreeing to all necessary Compliance Regulations on their first day of employment. Employees are required to adhere to all applicable HIPAA regulations and company policies and procedures regarding the confidentiality, privacy, and security of sensitive health information.

  • Створення та підтримка ефективних структур і процедур для залучення ресурсів, ухвалення рішень, вирішення проблем і досягнення цілей портфеля.
  • Пріоритезація та коригування ресурсів, активностей і графіків у межах проєктів і програм для балансування ризиків і зусиль між стратегічними змінами бізнесу та поточними операціями. Оптимізація розподілу ресурсів з урахуванням пріоритетів організації, потужностей, навичок і потреб розвитку, з максимальним використанням міжбізнесової взаємодії.
  • Формування мотивованої, високоефективної команди через тімбілдинг, обмін інформацією, управління навантаженням і належне визнання. Розвиток навичок членів команди через коучинг і делегування.

Вимоги:

  • Щонайменше 3 роки досвіду у delivery management, технічному акаунт-менеджменті, технічному pre-sales, solution consultancy, технічному продакт-менеджменті або суміжних ролях.
  • Технічний бекграунд і попередній практичний досвід у software engineering, QA або суміжній сфері.
  • Здатність виконувати функції проєктного менеджера та забезпечувати нагляд на етапах ініціації, планування, виконання, моніторингу та закриття проєкту.
  • Досвід управління кількома agile-командами.
  • Глибоке розуміння та практичний досвід роботи з Agile-практиками та фреймворками.
  • Досвід роботи в матричній організації з підзвітністю кільком стейкхолдерам.
  • Сильні навички проєктного менеджменту, організованість і структурований підхід до операційної діяльності.
  • Орієнтованість на сервіс/клієнта, фокус на результат.
  • Вільне володіння англійською мовою, письмово та усно.

Що ми пропонуємо?

Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм баченням, втілювати власні ідеї, зростати у професійному середовищі, зберігаючи баланс між роботою та особистим життям.
Приєднавшись до Viseven, ви отримаєте:
· Конкурентоспроможну винагороду та регулярний перегляд заробітної плати
· Професійне та кар'єрне зростання

· Комплексне медичне страхування (включаючи курс масажів та фізіопроцедур)

· Приємне робоче середовище: комфортний, повністю обладнаний офіс та можливість працювати вдома

The Global Director, Accounts Payable and Procurement leads the global Procure-to-Pay finance process and owns both procurement operations and accounts payable. This role ensures that goods and services are procured appropriately, vendors are paid accurately and timely, AP records are complete, accurate, and up to date, and reliable AP information is available to support FP&A, while protecting the company through strong controls, consistent policies, transparent global reporting, and disciplined purchasing practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the global procure-to-pay process, including procurement intake, purchase requisitions, vendor sourcing support, purchase order governance, vendor onboarding, invoice receipt, coding, approval routing, payment runs, exception handling, vendor inquiries, and AP month-end procedures.
  • Establish global procurement and AP policies, procedures, controls, service levels, approval matrices, purchasing thresholds, preferred vendor requirements, and process metrics across all countries and shared services resources.
  • Partner with Legal, Tax, Treasury, Accounting, IT, operations, and local finance teams to ensure vendor compliance, proper approvals, tax documentation, payment accuracy, purchasing discipline, contract visibility, and system alignment.

  • Support acquisition integration by mapping legacy procurement and AP processes, migrating vendors, aligning approval workflows, onboarding acquired entities to company policies, and stabilizing purchasing and payment operations.
  • Maintain strong controls over vendor selection, vendor master data, segregation of duties, bank detail changes, duplicate payments, fraud prevention, purchase approvals, payment approvals, contract support, and documentation retention.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Procurement, or related field preferred.

  • Experience driving process improvement across a global or complex organization is highly desirable.

Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

  • Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products.

  • Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics.

  • Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.

  • Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms.

  • Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself.

  • Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.

  • Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects.

  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.

  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

  • Experience working in or helping build newly formed teams.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

PermitFlow is looking for a Business Development Representative to support our core go-to-market motion across key customer verticals. This role is foundational to how we acquire new customers and scale revenue across Residential and Commercial Real Estate Development, Renewable Energy, and Home Services. You will be a front-line driver of pipeline, owning outbound engagement, building relationships with prospective customers, and converting interest into qualified sales conversations.

You will work closely with Account Executives and cross-functional partners to execute personalized outbound strategies, clearly communicate PermitFlow’s value in construction permitting, and generate new business through creative, multi-channel prospecting. This role requires comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment, strong ownership of outcomes, and a genuine interest in developing sales craft through repetition, feedback, and results.

This is not a passive or support-only SDR role. It is an opportunity to join a high-growth company, master outbound sales fundamentals, and play a meaningful role in shaping PermitFlow’s go-to-market execution, with a clear path for growth based on performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting (80–100+ calls per day) across phone, email, and LinkedIn to engage prospective customers.

  • Leverage ABM campaigns to engage the right personas at the right time — using digital engagement signals, intent data, and local market insights.

  • Drive qualified meetings (SQLs) with decision-makers across the organization, including Permit Coordinators, Operations Leaders, Regional Directors, and Executive Leadership.

  • Personalize outreach using account research, industry context, regional insights, and relevant proof points.

  • Coordinate and cluster early wins — expanding from branch to branch, region to region, or franchise to franchise.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to document insights, share field intelligence, and refine our enterprise GTM motion.

  • Transition qualified opportunities to the Enterprise AE for pilot scoping or enterprise-level discussions.

  • Maintain clean CRM hygiene, consistent follow-up, and accurate forecasting within Salesforce.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experienced Prospector: 1–3 years of experience in sales or business development, with comfort spending the majority of your day prospecting and speaking with new people.

  • Curious Storyteller: You research deeply, craft tailored outreach, and can connect operational pain points to business value.

  • High-Volume Resilience: Comfortable making 80–100 calls per day and navigating rejection with consistency, energy, and professionalism.

  • Goal-Driven Mentality: Motivated by quotas, metrics, and continuous improvement; taking ownership of results.

  • Strong Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to be clear, concise, and compelling.

  • Strategic Operator: Skilled at identifying buying centers and understanding complex org structures (enterprise orgs, roll-ups, franchises, multi-brand groups).

  • Team-Oriented: Thrive working side-by-side with AEs, Marketing, and RevOps to execute coordinated campaigns.

  • Mission-Driven: Views sales as a deliberate career path and energized by modernizing one of the world’s largest, most impactful industries — construction.

  • Exposure to construction, real estate development, or building permitting workflows.

  • Experience selling into complex organizations, multi-location businesses, or regulated industries.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Montreal, Quebec, Toronto, or Ontario

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build and ship ML/AI systems that interact with real customers thousands of times a day. Our voice agents book service appointments, rescue missed calls, and route callers through natural conversations. You’ll work across products and platforms. You’ll ship AI features including prompts, agents, tools, and production ML models, while building the evaluations and tooling that help teams ship with confidence. You’ll also contribute to our ML platform, including model serving, LLM infrastructure, and production observability. At Numa, we believe great ML is about more than building bigger models. It’s about knowing whether a change is good enough to ship. Our evaluation-first approach makes that measurable in CI and production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build conversational AI systems for phone and SMS that understand customer needs, take action, and know when to act autonomously

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The role is responsible for analyzing customer and telecommunications data—including revenue, provisioning, ordering, billing, and contract information—to identify billing discrepancies and opportunities where the client may be under-billing its customers. The position requires a strong understanding of telecommunications products, services, ordering and provisioning processes, and billing practices, combined with strong analytical and technical skills. Identified under-billing opportunities must be analyzed, validated, and quantified, and then corrected in collaboration with the client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform Revenue Assurance audits for assigned telecommunications clients to identify billing inaccuracies, revenue leakage, and under-billing opportunities.

  • Analyze and reconcile multiple data sources, including customer revenue, billing, provisioning, ordering, invoice, and contract data.

  • Apply analytical techniques, including anomaly detection, trend analysis, contract analysis, order-to-bill analysis, and invoice validation, to identify potential billing discrepancies.

  • Use knowledge of telecommunications products, services, network services, ordering processes, provisioning, and billing to determine whether identified discrepancies represent actual revenue leakage or under-billing.

  • Validate identified billing issues by researching customer contracts, orders, provisioning records, invoices, and applicable billing rules.

  • Work collaboratively with client teams to correct inaccurate billing through the client's ordering and billing processes.

  • Track identified opportunities, corrections, and financial results through client portals and internal tracking dashboards.

  • Monitor the status of identified revenue assurance opportunities and follow through to ensure corrections are implemented and reflected in billing.

  • Prepare and provide analytical reports, findings, and supporting information in response to internal and client requests.

jobs.excerpt: About Yordas Group Yordas Group is an international provider of scientific and consultancy services, regulatory advice and training to industry in chemicals management, sustainability and risk assessment.
jobs.description:
About Yordas Group
Yordas Group is an international provider of scientific and consultancy services, regulatory advice and training to industry in chemicals management, sustainability and risk assessment. We help companies understand and comply with the regulatory requirements affecting their products and supply chains. Our Hazard Communication team works with clients around the world to ensure chemical products are classified, documented and communicated safely and compliantly across different markets.

The opportunity
We are looking for scientifically minded people to join our growing Hazard Communication team in either the UK or Turkey.

We are deliberately keeping the experience level for this role broad.

You might be an early-career regulatory professional who already has some experience of Safety Data Sheets, chemical classification, GHS/CLP, labelling or chemical regulatory affairs and is looking for the next step in your career. Alternatively, you may have a strong scientific background and transferable experience with the aptitude to develop into a Hazard Communication specialist.

You do not need to arrive knowing everything. We have an established technical training and development programme and can tailor your development according to your existing knowledge and experience.

For candidates who already have relevant Hazard Communication experience, the role can offer greater responsibility and independence from the outset.

The important things for us are strong scientific reasoning, attention to detail, curiosity, good judgement and the ability to learn and apply complex regulatory requirements.

What you'll be doing

Depending on your existing experience and development needs, your work will include:
  • Safety Data Sheet and label authoring for chemical products supplied into different global markets.
  • Hazard classification of substances and mixtures, applying GHS-based regulatory requirements including EU/GB CLP and requirements in other international jurisdictions.
  • Reviewing technical and compositional data and making informed classification and Hazard Communication decisions.
  • Supporting Poison Centre Notification (PCN) and related regulatory activities.
  • Reviewing SDS and other Hazard Communication documentation for regulatory compliance and quality.
  • Researching regulatory requirements and helping the team respond to technical and client questions.
  • Working with colleagues on international Hazard Communication projects and managed services.
  • Communicating with clients and other Yordas teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality work.
  • Contributing to improvements in our technical processes, guidance, systems and tools.
As your knowledge and experience develop, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership of client relationships and projects, provide regulatory consultancy, undertake quality review, support and mentor colleagues, contribute to training and help develop new services.

What we're looking for

We are interested in candidates at different stages of their early regulatory careers, so we don't expect everyone to tick every box.

You will ideally have:
  • A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in a scientific discipline, particularly Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Science, Biology, Biomedicine, Natural Sciences or a related subject; or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to interpret scientific and technical information.
  • Excellent attention to detail and an appreciation of the importance of accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage changing priorities and organise your own workload.
  • Confidence working both independently and collaboratively within an international team.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
Relevant experience would be an advantage and we would particularly like to hear from you if you have some experience in one or more of the following:
  • Safety Data Sheet authoring or review
  • GHS or CLP classification
  • Chemical or product labelling
  • Chemical regulatory affairs or product stewardship
  • REACH or CLP
  • Poison Centre Notifications / UFI
  • Dangerous Goods
  • Chemical compliance within industry
  • Regulatory or scientific consultancy
  • SDS authoring or regulatory software

What we can offer

Hazard Communication is a specialist field, and we don't expect people to arrive knowing every regulation or every market.

You'll receive structured training and support from experienced Hazard Communication professionals while working on real client projects. As you develop, you'll have opportunities to build expertise across global GHS requirements and pursue a career path that suits your strengths.

That could include becoming a technical specialist, moving further into consultancy and client management, managing projects, undertaking quality review, delivering training, developing new services or progressing into team leadership.

Yordas also offers a range of benefits depending on location, including professional development opportunities, generous holidays, flexible working and pension/medical benefits where applicable.

Application
If this sounds interesting but you're unsure whether your experience is quite at the right level, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're more interested in finding someone with the right scientific aptitude, regulatory mindset and potential than matching a rigid number of years' experience.

Please send your CV and covering letter to , outlining your relevant experience and why you're interested in developing your career in Hazard Communication.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a hazard classification exercise. All information required to complete the exercise will be provided.

Yordas Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

  • Du wohnst und lebst in Deutschland (arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist bei uns nicht möglich) und möchtest bei uns in Vollzeit durchzustarten.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Und das gibt's on top!

  • Günstig auf reisen 🧳 - Unsere Mitarbeiter*innen profitieren von zahlreichen Rabatten für ihre nächste Reise. Du erhältst eine Travel Industry Card und sparst so bei Freizeitaktivitäten, Hotelübernachtungen, Zugreisen und vielem mehr.   • Hier sparst du 💸 - Über die Belonio App erhältst Du monatlich einen 50-Euro-Gutschein und zum Geburtstag einen weiteren. Du kannst ihn für verschiedenste Marken aus den Bereichen Mode, Lebensmittel, Home & Living und Entertainment einlösen.

  • Feier mit uns 🪩 - Bei uns wird es Dir nicht so schnell langweilig. Wir halten den Team Spirit hoch, durch regelmäßige Team-Events sowie Firmen-Events wie Weihnachts- oder Sommerfeste. Bei unseren Quartals-Events lassen wir Dich außerdem an der Firmenentwicklung und spannenden Neuigkeiten teilhaben.

  • Technisch einwandfrei 🧑‍💻 - Obst gibt es bei uns auch oft – Apple gibt es jedoch immer. Wir arbeiten auf moderner Hardware, deshalb wirst Du für Deine Arbeit ein MacBook und iPhone verwenden.

  • Freiraum für dich 💡 - Viele sprechen von flachen Hierarchien, wir leben sie. Wir arbeiten alle eng zusammen, völlig egal, welche Funktion wir haben. Durch kurze Entscheidungswege können so Prozesse beschleunigt werden – und Du hast viel mehr mitzureden. Das alles ist Teil des Start-up-Vibes, der bei uns mitschwingt.

Der Weg zu uns 🚀

1. Erstes Kennenlernen - In einem Gespräch mit unserer HR Managerin bekommst Du einen Einblick in STAYERY und die Position.

2. Operations Deep Dive - Lerne unseren Head of Operations Pascal kennen und tauche tiefer in den Operations Bereich bei STAYERY ein. Mach dir beim Probearbeiten einen persönlichen Eindruck von der STAYERY und verschaffe dir einen Überblick über deine zukünftigen Aufgaben.

3. Founder Interview - Im Gespräch mit einem unserer Gründer geben wir Dir einen Einblick in unsere Vision.

Deine Bewerbung
STAYERY ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und Diversität - unabhängig von Alter, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Behinderung, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Wir erkennen die Stärke, die in der Vielfalt liegt und fördern eine Arbeitsumgebung, die alle Mitarbeitende gleichermaßen einbezieht und schätzt. Deine Bewerbung kannst Du bei uns auch ohne Bild oder Angaben Deiner Nationalität, Alter und Geschlecht einreichen. Wir freuen uns von dir zu hören!

jobs.excerpt: Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenlandBen jij een ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ die graag zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ?
jobs.description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland

Ben jij een ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ die graag zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Wil je jouw medische en verpleegkundige expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving, waar kwaliteit, autonomie en samenwerking centraal staan?

Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.

Wij zoeken een proactieve Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ voor een nieuwe rol binnen onze organisatie. Een professional die online behandelen serieus neemt, stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat en ook op afstand hoogwaardige specialistische zorg weet te leveren.

Over Beterggz

Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.

Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters, verpleegkundig specialisten en andere betrokken professionals. We werken volledig digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief hoogwaardige GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.

Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je werkt. Of je nu vanuit Nederland of vanuit het buitenland werkzaam bent, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit gewaarborgd zijn.

Wat ga je doen?

Als online Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ ben je zelfstandig behandelaar en lever je specialistische zorg aan cliënten binnen de SGGZ. Je voert diagnostiek uit, stelt behandelplannen op, behandelt cliënten en bewaakt de voortgang van het behandelproces.

Je bent regiebehandelaar en werkt nauw samen met psychiaters, psychologen, SPV'ers en andere behandelaren binnen het multidisciplinaire team. Vanuit jouw verpleegkundige én medische expertise lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan kwalitatief hoogwaardige en veilige zorg.

Daarnaast kun je worden ingezet voor overbruggingszorg, complexe triage en consultatie. Je signaleert risico's, beoordeelt crisissituaties, schrijft waar nodig medicatie voor binnen jouw bevoegdheden en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze digitale zorgverlening.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Zelfstandig behandelen van cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ.

  • Fungeren als regiebehandelaar.

  • Uitvoeren van diagnostiek en indicatiestelling.

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en evalueren van behandelplannen.

  • Medicatiebeleid en farmacotherapeutische begeleiding binnen het eigen deskundigheidsgebied.

  • Risicotaxaties, crisisbeoordelingen en crisisinterventies.

  • Complexe triage en consultatie.

  • Overbruggingszorg en wachttijdbegeleiding.

  • Multidisciplinair overleg en afstemming met collega's.

  • Zorgvuldige dossiervoering en rapportage.

  • Coaching en inhoudelijke ondersteuning van collega's waar passend.

  • Actief bijdragen aan kwaliteitsverbetering, innovatie en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.

Omdat dit een nieuwe functie binnen Beterggz is, krijg je bovendien de mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere inrichting en ontwikkeling van deze rol.

Requirements

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een zelfstandige en ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ met ruime ervaring binnen de specialistische GGZ.

Om deze functie te kunnen vervullen beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding HBO-Verpleegkunde.

  • Een afgeronde Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) met uitstroomprofiel GGZ.

  • Een geldige BIG-registratie als Verpleegkundig Specialist.

  • Ervaring als Verpleegkundig Specialist binnen de specialistische GGZ.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met diagnostiek, behandeling en regiebehandelaarschap.

  • Kennis van psychiatrische ziektebeelden, farmacotherapie, risicotaxatie en crisisinterventie.

Je bent gewend om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen, werkt zorgvuldig en gestructureerd en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg die je levert.

Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.

Ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek, trauma, stemmingsstoornissen, angststoornissen, ADHD en autismespectrumstoornissen binnen de SGGZ is een pre.

Verder:

  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

  • is beheersing van de Engelse taal een pre;

  • ben je ingeschreven als ZZP'er bij de Kamer van Koophandel;

  • beschik je over een geldige beroeps- en bedrijfsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering;

  • ben je bereid een geldige Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan te leveren.

Waarom Beterggz?

Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en kwalitatief hoogwaardige online zorg levert.

Wij werken op basis van een ZZP-overeenkomst met een uurtarief van €110 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we in overleg af en starten kan op korte termijn.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Omdat dit een nieuwe functie binnen Beterggz is, krijg je bovendien de kans om actief mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze online zorgverlening en de inrichting van deze rol.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je interessant om als online Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?

Stuur dan je motivatie en CV naar:

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.

Een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Job Title: Senior Bookkeeper

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Senior Bookkeeper to take ownership of the financial function across multiple businesses and entities.

This is not a basic or purely transactional bookkeeping role. We are looking for a commercially minded and analytical finance professional who can manage the day-to-day accounting function while also understanding the bigger financial picture.

The successful candidate must be comfortable analysing financial information, asking questions, identifying discrepancies, monitoring profitability and cash flow, and providing clear financial reporting to management.

They should be capable of operating with a high level of independence and responsibility, with the ability to support financial decision-making at a Director of Finance or CFO level when required, while remaining hands-on with the day-to-day financial operations.

  • Prepare and review financial statements and management reports.
  • Monitor expenses and ensure accurate financial recording.
  • Analyse profitability, expenses, and financial performance across multiple businesses.
  • Assist with budgeting and financial forecasting.
  • Monitor and report on cash flow.
  • Investigate discrepancies, unusual transactions, and inconsistencies in financial information.
  • Analyse financial data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Prepare clear and accurate financial reports for management.
  • Ask questions and challenge financial information when something does not make sense.
  • Ensure financial information is accurate, organised, and up to date.
  • Manage multiple entities and priorities effectively.
  • Work closely with management and communicate financial information clearly.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and controls.

  • Proven experience in a Senior Bookkeeper, Senior Accountant, Finance Manager, or similar role.
  • Strong experience managing the bookkeeping function across multiple entities or businesses.
  • Strong experience using QuickBooks.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.title: Patient & Family Advisor
jobs.excerpt: About UsInStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it.
jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

As a Patient and Family Advisor at InStride Health, you will be the first point of contact for prospective families, guiding them through the process of accessing life-changing care. Working as a vital part of a small, close-knit team, you will have significant opportunities to contribute to our growth and support one another. You will champion the program by building relationships, educating families about our services, helping them navigate the complexities of insurance, and providing concierge-level support from pre-application through onboarding. With a strong focus on patient advocacy, you’ll help individuals who have faced challenges navigating the healthcare system, ensuring they receive the support they need. If you are a warm, empathetic person who is passionate about mental health care and energized by providing exceptional service, this is the perfect role for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Patient & Family Education: Serve as the primary contact for inquiring families, handling inbound and outbound calls, texts, and emails to educate them on InStride’s program, treatment methods, and clinical outcomes.
  • Relationship Building: Foster trusting relationships by offering empathetic guidance and advocating for families facing hurdles in accessing care.
  • Process & Insurance Navigation: Proactively reach out to families to resolve onboarding barriers and keep them “unstuck”. Confidently navigate complex insurance workflows—including verifying eligibility against specific payer contracts, managing Single Case Agreements, and coordinating with the authorization team. Connect directly with insurance representatives, pushing back when necessary to secure accurate information and fiercely advocate for our families.
  • Collaboration & Cross-Coverage: Act as a central liaison connecting families with our internal teams—including Payer, Scheduling, Authorization, Growth, and Clinical staff. Maintain a team-first mindset with a constant readiness to jump in, support, and cover for colleagues as needed.
  • Innovation & Workflow Piloting: Actively step in to pilot new workflows, participate in organizational projects, and provide constructive feedback to refine team processes.
  • Technology & Automation: Maintain a continuous improvement mindset with a willingness to utilize and learn AI tools to automate tasks and optimize daily workflows.
  • Documentation & Process Management: Efficiently manage help desk tickets and maintain precise records within our CRM and internal systems, strictly adhering to HIPAA regulations to safely handle Protected Health Information.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • Proven experience working closely with customers, patients, or families—including handling difficult conversations and communicating comfortably over the phone and other digital channels.
  • General health insurance knowledge (billing, verification, benefits, cost-sharing, and eligibility) is highly preferred.
  • Prior experience with HIPAA regulations and securely handling Protected Health Information is preferred.
  • Highly resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and eager to thrive within a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
  • Comfort navigating CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ZohoCRM) and support ticketing workflows to ensure seamless, timely communication and follow-ups with families.
  • A strong collaborative spirit with a readiness to pilot new workflows, learn AI tools, and actively share constructive feedback.
  • A warm, empathetic nature paired with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional support and creating positive experiences for families.

The starting annual salary for this role is $57,000. We maintain consistent starting salaries and salary bands to ensure our team members have a clear path for growth within their roles, allowing their compensation to increase as they gain experience at InStride.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

jobs.description:
We are Local Infusion.

Local Infusion is the fastest growing infusion provider in the United States, with a mission to transform the specialty infusion industry, because patients deserve better. By providing both exceptional, patient-centered care and the proprietary, AI-driven technology powering it, Local Infusion accelerates access, simplifies workflows, and improves outcomes for everyone in the infusion journey — from patients and clinicians to health plans, health systems, employers, and pharma.

Clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients, bringing comfort, connection, and community back to healthcare. With Local Infusion, every patient and every care team is fully supported, every step of the way.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a seasoned healthcare collector with the experience and judgment to effectively manage complex, aged, and high-dollar insurance receivables. The ideal candidate can independently manage a high-volume portfolio, identify the root cause of non-payment, determine the appropriate recovery pathway, and escalate accounts appropriately using established payer and industry-standard processes. We're looking for someone who takes end-to-end ownership of assigned revenue, understands how to navigate payer barriers, and consistently moves accounts toward payment or final resolution.

What You'll Own

  • Manage assigned insurance AR with a primary focus on aged, high-dollar, and priority revenue

  • Meet established productivity expectations while maintaining a high standard of quality and accuracy

  • Perform meaningful collection activity designed to advance claims toward payment or final resolution

  • Research unpaid, denied, and underpaid claims to identify the underlying root cause

  • Resolve denials, rejections, underpayments, authorization-related issues, eligibility issues, and other payer barriers

  • Determine the appropriate resolution pathway, including corrected claims, reconsiderations, first- and second-level appeals, payer escalations, and internal escalations

  • Follow payer-specific requirements for timely filing, reconsiderations, appeals, and dispute resolution

  • Communicate with payers to obtain claim status, processing details, call reference numbers, and clearly defined next steps

  • Maintain concise, complete, and actionable account documentation

  • Establish appropriate follow-up dates and actively manage claims throughout the collection lifecycle

  • Identify recurring payer trends and systemic issues and escalate them for broader resolution

  • Partner cross-functionally with Billing, Authorization, Intake, Cash Posting, Patient Collections, and RCM leadership to resolve revenue barriers

  • Prioritize inventory based on financial exposure, aging, timely filing risk, and recovery opportunity

  • Maintain ownership of assigned inventory through payment or final disposition

What Success Looks Like

The successful collector demonstrates consistent ownership of assigned accounts and applies sound judgment to move claims toward timely resolution. This includes:

  • Conducting thorough claim research to identify the root cause of non-payment or underpayment

  • Selecting the appropriate resolution pathway based on payer requirements, claim status, and established escalation protocols

  • Maintaining complete, concise, and actionable documentation of findings, actions taken, payer responses, and next steps

  • Establishing appropriate follow-up timelines and maintaining consistent ownership through payment or final disposition

  • Recognizing when standard collection activity is no longer effective and initiating the appropriate reconsideration, appeal, payer escalation, or internal escalation

  • Identifying recurring payer or process trends and escalating systemic issues for broader resolution

  • Balancing productivity, quality, and financial impact while meeting established performance expectations

  • Demonstrating measurable contribution to aged AR reduction, cash recovery, and inventory resolution

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of healthcare insurance collections or AR follow-up experience, preferably within infusion, specialty pharmacy, physician practice, or another complex specialty environment

  • Demonstrated experience managing aged and high-dollar accounts receivable

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial and government payer processes

  • Experience resolving denials, underpayments, authorization issues, eligibility issues, and claim-processing errors

  • Working knowledge of corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, timely filing requirements, and payer escalation pathways

  • Ability to interpret EOBs, ERAs, payer correspondence, and claim-processing information

  • Strong account documentation and follow-up discipline

  • Ability to independently prioritize a large inventory based on risk, aging, and financial impact

  • Ability to work effectively within established productivity and quality standards

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and recognize when broader escalation is required

  • Experience with infusion or specialty medication billing and collections strongly preferred

How We Measure Success

Success in this role is measured by both productivity and outcomes. Key performance indicators include meaningful claim activity, documentation quality, adherence to follow-up expectations, aged AR reduction, cash recovery, and inventory resolution. Collectors are expected to maintain ownership of assigned accounts from initial assignment through payment or final disposition, while consistently meeting established productivity and quality expectations.

The Local Infusion Way

Local Infusion is a respectful upbeat team united by our mission of shaping the way specialty infusion care is delivered. We are highly ambitious but understand that in order to do a great job, we have to take care of ourselves; we expect that you will have time and energy devoted to your families, friends and hobbies.

As part of our team, full-time employees get:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance through our employer plan

  • Short and long-term disability coverage

  • 401(k) — as an early-stage startup, and we match!

  • 15 Days PTO — and we want you to take it!

  • Competitive paid parental leave and flexible return to work policy.

  • We invest in your career. Our company is growing quickly, and we'll give you the opportunity to do the same. You'll have access to a number of professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company's evolving needs and grow your career along the way.

We don’t discriminate—Local Infusion is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We fundamentally believe that a more diverse and inclusive team leads to a stronger company more able to achieve our vision.

What It's Like to Work at Local Infusion

jobs.description:
About the Role

This role owns the full design-make-test-model loop at an early-stage AI-driven protein and peptide engineering company: you will run and improve pocket-conditioned discrete diffusion models for sequence design and personally execute the binding kinetics that close the loop. You will sit on a lean core team reporting directly to the CEO, making this one of the highest-leverage scientific roles at the company.

What You'll Do

  • Improve and extend proprietary diffusion and companion folding models with architectural refinements, new attention heads, and hierarchical reasoning.

  • Operate an ML inference platform at scale and diagnose usage patterns across signups, churn, and customer segments.

  • Own fluid-handling robotics and plate automation (Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, or equivalent) and ship reliable, production-ready protocols.

  • Own BLI and SPR end-to-end: assay design, immobilization, regeneration, referencing, dilution series, kinetic fitting, QC, and failure-mode diagnosis.

  • Write detailed cloud-lab protocols and manage internal screening instrumentation.

jobs.excerpt: Maximus is looking for a Head of Growth & Marketing (VP).
jobs.description:
Maximus is looking for a Head of Growth & Marketing (VP).

Company: Maximus | Location: Remote (US) | Reports to: CEO | Type: Full-time, Executive


About Maximus

Maximus () is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year — with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

The Role

We’re hiring a VP of Growth to run the growth engine. The core of the job is high-velocity, highly analytical experiment design: finding new levers that work, across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product, and finding them faster than the current ones fatigue. You set the testing agenda and hold the bar on what counts as a good experiment.

The defining requirement is the ability to think in connected customer journeys, not siloed channels: how a persona is defined, how creative and messaging speak to that persona, how that creative shows up differently on Meta versus paid search versus influencers versus affiliates, what landing experience each arrival deserves, and how we ultimately convert and retain that customer. Channel, creative, and site experience are one system — and you own the system.

Two things come with this role that growth leaders almost never get to own. First, the conversion flow: not just the landing page — the entire quiz flow, every step from first click through credit-card entry. Second, pricing: price points, offers, discounts, and plan structure across the portfolio, where there’s enormous leverage waiting for someone with the analytical chops to find it. If you’ve spent your career optimizing ads against a funnel somebody else controlled, this is the opposite of that job.

This is a hands-on job. You’ll inherit a team and an agency roster and reshape both as the strategy requires — hiring where there are gaps, holding the agencies to outcomes. You’ll also spend lots of time in spreadsheets and Ads Manager, and lately in Claude, looking at the nitty-gritty yourself. You’ll report directly to the CEO and hold the senior-most marketing seat in the company. The role is revenue-accountable: you take the company’s revenue target and build the strategy across the product portfolio (Testosterone, Weight Loss, Growth Hormone, and future verticals) to hit it.

What You’ll Own

The experimentation engine: the core of the job. Design and run a high-velocity testing program across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product: hypothesis quality, test design, statistical rigor, and the speed from insight to rollout. Build the team’s operating rhythm (planning, budgeting, creative reviews, reporting) around that cadence.

Money allocation, decided by incrementality and LTV. Own where the money goes, and back every allocation with data: incrementality and lifetime value, not last-click ROAS. That means knowing how to measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, how to evaluate discounts analytically, and how LTV differs by product and channel in a business where the LTV math gets complicated. FP&A owns the forecast model; you own the levers inside it — spend, CAC, conversion, LTV by product line — and the results against it.

The conversion flow, end to end. The entire quiz flow through credit-card entry, not just the landing pages in front of it: messaging continuity from ad through intake to purchase, experimentation inside the flow itself in partnership with product and engineering, and the test discipline that keeps the wins real.

Pricing. Price points, coupons, offers, discount architecture, and plan structure across the portfolio, including long-term commitments — and the margin-versus-CAC tradeoff every one of these decisions moves. Discounting here is an analytical problem.

Lifecycle and CRM. Email and SMS as a real growth channel: cart-abandonment recovery, nurture for hesitant buyers, cross-sell across the portfolio, revival of lapsed customers. Run it with the same rigor as paid — experiments, holdouts, measured LTV impact. The customer should never feel a handoff, from ad to quiz or from checkout to inbox.

Persona-driven acquisition, creative, and the channel portfolio. The channel is a persona signal: the research-heavy buyer coming from branded search isn’t the validation-seeker coming from cold social. Define the persona for each channel and let it drive everything downstream. Own paid media, influencers, and affiliates, with enough diversification that no one platform dominates; own creative built for each persona, native to each channel, and judged on funnel outcomes. This is creative as a growth lever, not a brand job.

What You’ll Need

The bar, in one question. Be ready, at any point, to say where the next incremental dollar should go — more Meta spend, a deeper discount, a new quiz branch, an untested channel — and why. “I think it’ll lift the funnel” isn’t an answer; we want the test you’d run, the LTV math behind it, and what you’d cut to fund it.

  • Command of incrementality and LTV: this is what we’re hiring for. You can design the incrementality test and defend the math; you can explain how you’d measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, and how you’d evaluate a discount analytically; and you’ve dealt with a complex-LTV business firsthand — subscription, multi-product, or both.

  • Still hands-on. You get into the weeds yourself (the ad account, the funnel data, the models) and did so this quarter, not three jobs ago.

  • Connected-journey thinking. You can walk a funnel you owned end to end — persona, channel, creative, landing experience, conversion — and explain how each step informed the next.

  • Direct ownership of post-click conversion: landing experiences, quiz- or intake-style funnels, checkout, lifecycle (email and SMS) — with structured experimentation and results to show for it.

  • Pricing and offer experience: you’ve designed pricing, discount, or plan-structure tests and owned the revenue outcome.

  • 10+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years leading teams, with a track record scaling a DTC subscription business built on a high-consideration product — a premium-priced purchase people research before buying.

  • Ownership of a revenue number, not just a media budget — you built the plan tying spend to revenue and defended it to a CEO or a board.

  • A builder profile: you’ve restructured or built a marketing org, hired senior channel leads, and managed agencies to outcomes.

  • Nice to have: telehealth, regulated health, or wellness experience (health-claim ad policies, compliance-constrained creative), and experience marketing a multi-product portfolio with a distinct buyer per product.


What Success Looks Like

This role moves fast; we expect the engine to be running within the first quarter. Specific targets get set together in your first 30 days.

By month 3: there’s a real testing cadence live across ads, creative, pricing, and the quiz flow; CAC, conversion, and LTV are instrumented by product so we trust the numbers; and you’ve made the first budget reallocations based on measured incrementality.

By month 6: conversion through the full quiz-to-credit-card flow is up; persona-matched journeys are shipping (right creative, right landing experience, right quiz flow for each buyer type); the first pricing wins are banked; and at least one channel beyond Meta has scaled past the test phase.

By month 12 and beyond: you’ve delivered the revenue target, CAC and LTV have both moved the right way, the team and agency roster fit the strategy, and the CEO and board trust your numbers because they hold.

Maximus Offers World-Class Benefits:

  • At-cost employee access (50% off discount) to all Maximus protocols

  • Full Suite Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
    Premium Blue Shield Platinum PPO & HMO Health Plans (up to 80% coverage)

  • Best-in-class 401K options

  • Fully remote work. Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

Location

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

How you communicate and connect with people.

How you present yourself professionally.

Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.
